tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅// pradzñārbabyaktigarbhāyasyāhaskarabastirṇatsaryābatarmahāsargasyabatikabarṇasabidzayaḥ ༄༅// spyod 'jug sher le'i rgya cher 'grel mchan snying po'i don gsal nyin byed chen po zhes bya ba bzhugs so// (2) oṃ swasti/ 'khor 'das chos tshul nam mkha'i mu khyud can// rten 'brel sna tshogs snang ba 'ja' ltar gsal// ngo bo spros bral rang rig 'dus ma byas// 'phags bzhi skyed byed rgyal yum de la 'dud// rten 'byung smra ba'i khyu mchog zhi ba lhas// sher phyin bka' bstan kun gyi snying po'i don// zab rgyas ji bzhin ston pa'i man ngag 'di// ma rtogs log rtog the tshom bsal phyir bshad// de'ang ston pa rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyis gdul bya rnams la thugs brtse bas bcu phrag rigs pa'i gzhung lugs gsungs pa kun kyang gdul bya mngon mtho dang nges legs la sbyor thabs kho nar zad pas/ nges par legs pa'i lam tshang la ma nor ba theg (3) chen gyi mdo sde rin po che rnams yin kyang las dang po pas de don ji bzhin rtogs dka' bas/ bka' bde blag tu rtogs pa'i thabs zab mo rjes 'jug mkhas pa'i bstan bcos la rag las shing*/ de'ang theg pa che chung gi mdo sde spyi dang khyad par theg chen mtha' dag de las kyang sher phyin mdo yi dgongs don phyin ci ma log pa tshig nyung la don zab cing rgya che ba go bde bar ston pa spyod 'jug 'di 'dra ba rgya gar na'ang 'gran zla dang bral ba'i gzhung 'di 'chad na lam gyi yan lag sbyin sogs lnga thabs kyi cha gtso bo ston pa dang*/ thabs shes dbyer med sher le lus yongs rdzogs kyis tshul du 'chad do// de'ang le'u dang pos bsam pa sems bskyed dang*/ (4) lhag mas sbyor ba phyin drug ston pa'am/ yang na le'u dang po gnyis dang gsum pa'i stod kyi sems bskyed kyi sdom pa len pa'i sbyor ba/ ji ltar sogs tshigs bcad gnyis kyis dngos gzhi/ deng dus sogs nas rdzogs pa'i bar gyis mjug chog ston pa dang*/

yang*/ byang chub sems mchog rin po che// ma skyes pa rnams skyes gyur cig /skyes pa nyams pa med pa dang*// gong nas gong du 'phel bar shog /ces pa ltar/ dang po gsum gyis ma skyes pa bskyed/ bar pa gsum gyis mi nyams par bsrung*/ tha ma gsum gyis gong 'phel btang bar gsungs pa ltar ro// yang na phan yon le'us bsam pa sems bskyed/ gnyis pa dang gsum pas sbyin pa/ bzhi lngas tshul khrims/ lhag ma bzhis rang ming gi bstan to// yang na le'u dang po drug gis tshul khrims kyi bslab pa/ brgyad pas sems kyi bslab pa/ dgu pas shes rab kyi bslab pa bstan to// de yan chad kyi le'u brgyad dang bcu pa bcas dgu pos lam dang grub mtha'i rnam dbye ma bstan pas go sla ba'i dbang du btang nas 'dir bshad pa btang snyoms su bya la/ phyi ma lus dngos sher le 'chad pa la/ gzhung snga phyi mtshams sbyar te bstan bcos kyi lus rnam bzhag shes rab bskyed dgos pa'i rgyu mtshan mdor bstan pa dang*/ de'i yan lag rgyas par bshad pa/ dge rtsa (5) gzhan don du bsngo ba dang gsum las/ dang po ni/ de la bstan bcos 'dir brjod ma thag pa'i mtshan nyid can gyi sbyin pa la sogs pa 1$0000300yan lag 'di dag thams cad ni// thub pas 1$0000270ji ltar gnas pa'i rten cing 'brel bar 'byung ba dngos po'i de kho na nyid rab tu rnam par 'byed pa'i 1$0000300shes rab 1$00002701$0000220kyi 1$00002701$0000300don du gsungs te1$0000270// sbyin pa la sogs 'khor gsum mi dmigs pa'i sbyor bas yongs su sbyangs te bskal pa grangs med gsum sogs ring du goms pas ma rig pas bskyed pa'i rnam par rtog pa'i drwa ba mtha' dag bral nas sgrib gnyis spangs shing*/ bdag med gnyis thugs su chud pa'i rang bzhin phan pa thams cad kyi gzhir gyur pa don dam pa'i de kho na nyid kyi bdag nyid de bzhin gshegs pa'i chos kyi sku mngon par thob par byed pas shes rab ni nyer len rgyu'i gtso bo yin cing sbyin pa la sogs pa ni rkyen phal pa yin pa'i phyir ro// de yang ji skad du/

'phags pa shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa stong phrag brgya pa las/ rab 'byor 'di lta ste/ dper na nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor dang zla ba'i dkyil 'khor ni gling bzhir las (dbang )byed cing*/ shar nas lho lta bu gling bzhi'i rjes su 'gro'o// gling bzhi'i rjes su 'brang ste gling bzhi med na nyi zla mi srid de gling bzhi ma chags gong du nam mkha' stong par nyi zla mi srid pa bzhin no// (6) nyi zla med kyang gling bzhi yod de rdzogs ldan bzhin/ des na dang po gling bzhi yod na gdod nyi zla 'byung ngo*// rab 'byor de bzhin du shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa yang pha rol tu phyin pa lngar las (dbang )byed cing*/ pha rol tu phyin pa lnga'i rjes su 'gro'o// pha rol tu phyin pa lnga'i rjes su 'brang ste/ sbyin sogs lnga med pa'i sher phyin mi srid de/ sher phyin ni sbyin sogs phar phyin lnga'i ngo bo lus yin la snga ma lnga ni yan lag yin pa'i phyir ro// 'o na lus med na yan lag mi srid pa ltar sher phyin med pa'i sbyin sogs mi srid do snyam na/ sher phyin med na sbyin pa'i phar phyin sogs med kyang skyon med de rdzogs ldan dus nyi zla med kyang gling bzhi yod pa bzhin nyan rang gi sbyin sogs lta bu'o// shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dang bral na sbyin pa la sogs pa lngas pha rol tu phyin pa'i ming mi 'thob bo// rab 'byor 'di lta ste/ dper na 'khor los sgyur ba'i rgyal po dang bral na rin po che sna bdun gyis 'khor los sgyur ba'i ming mi 'thob bo// rab 'byor de bzhin du sbyin pa la sogs pa lnga yang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dang bral na pha rol tu phyin pa'i ming mi 'thob bo// zhes pa la sogs pa gsungs so// 'khor sgyur dang ma bral na sna bdun gyis 'khor sgyur gyi ming thob cing bral na mi thob pa bzhin sher phyin dang ma bral na sbyin

(7) sogs lngas kyang phar phyin ming 'thob bo// dpe dang po sher phyin mtshan nyid pa dang phyi ma btags pa ba'i dpe brjod pa yin snyam/ sher phyin mtshan btags kyi khyad par ji ltar zhe na/ dus skabs kyi dbang du byas na yang sa dang po thob nas 'khor ba'i pha rol phyin tsam ste/ 'phags pa'i 'chi dang na ba dang*// rga ba'i sdug bsngal rtsad nas spangs// zhes so// ngo bo'i dbang du byas na sa dang po yan chad kyi mnyam bzhag 'khor gsum dmigs med de sher phyin mtshan nyid pa yin te tshu rol 'khor ba 'khor gsum rnam rtog gi pha rol rtog med yin pa'i phyir/ 'jug pa las/ sbyin pa sbyin bya len po gtong pos stong*// 'jig rten 'das pa'i pha rol phyin ces bya// zhes dang*/ mngon rtogs rgyan las/ tshul rol pha rol mtha' la min// de dag bar na mi gnas pa// dus rnams mnyam pa nyid shes phyir// shes rab pha rol phyin par 'dod// ces gsungs te/ mnyam bzhag dmigs med 'dus ma byas 'gog bden yin la/ rgyud bla ma las/ 'dus ma byas rtog med 'gog bden 'di la dgongs nas lam bden rtag par bshad pa'i gnad 'di shes na 'khrul pa mtha' dag rang grol lo// dus skabs kyi mthar phyin pa min ste rjes thob tu rnam rtog 'byung ba'i phyir/ bsgrub bya de don dang ldan pa'i// gzhung lam la yang de sgra yin// zhes so// sangs rgyas pa'i gnyis med ye shes ni dus skabs kyis kyang mtshan nyid pa yin te mnyam rjes dbyer med yin pa'i phyir/ brgyad stong (8) don bsdus las/ shes rab pha rol phyin gnyis med// ye shes de ni de bzhin gshegs// zhes so// des na mi phal pa dang 'khor bsgyur gnyis mchog dman ma gtogs mi mtshan nyid pa yin pa 'dra ba ltar sa thob 'phags pa'i mnyam bzhag dang sangs rgyas kyi gnyis med ye shes gnyis sher phyin mtshan nyid pa yin par khyad med do// sa thob 'phags pa'i rjes thob rtog pa 'dus byas dang nyan rang 'phags pa'i mnyam rjes mtha' dag lam bden mtshan nyid pa yin te/

chos nyid bden pa mngon sum du mthong ba'i phyir/ rigs can gsum gyi tshogs sbyor gyi lam rnams lam mtshan nyid pa yin yang lam bden mtshan nyid pa min te/ bden pa ma mthong ba'i phyir/ 'on kyang nyan rang gi mngon rtogs 'phags lam la zhugs ma zhugs gang la'ang phar phyin gyi tha snyad med de mnyam bzhag 'khor gsum 'dzin rtog yin pa'i phyir dang*/ rjes thob tu rang nyid sangs rgyas 'thob 'dod dang sangs rgyas kyi sar bsngo smon med pa'i phyir ro// nyan thos rang sangs rgyas rnams la// pha rol phyin pa'i ming yang med// ces so// des na theg chen gyi lam lnga char la sher phyin gyi dngos btags ci rigs pa'i ming 'jug go /sa thob 'phags pa'i rjes thob kho na la 'jig rten pa'i phar phyin ngos 'dzin mi rung ste/ gsum po dag la chags skyes (9) 'gyur pa de// 'jig rten pa yi pha rol phyin ces bya// zhes gsungs pas chags pa la bden 'dzin mtshan 'dzin gnyis snang gi dbye ba du ma gsungs pas thams cad la thun mong du go la/ theg chen tshogs sbyor mnyam bzhag rang rig mngon sum yin pa'i phyir dang*/ rjes thob tu chos thams cad spros bral du gtan la phab pa'i rjes dpag tshad ma yin pa'i phyir dang*/ kun rdzob sems bskyed kyis sangs rgyas kyi sar smon pa'i phyir 'jig rten pa'i phar phyin gyi sgra tsam nges par 'jug la/ der 'jig rten pa'i phar phyin gyi sgra yang mi 'jug na/ 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa gnyis las gzhan mi srid pas theg chen tshogs sbyor gyi lam la lam sher phyin gyi tha snyad gtan nas mi 'jug par 'gyur la/ 'dod na/ bsgrub bya de don dang ldan pa'i/ gzhung lam dag la de sgra yin// zhes pa dang yang dngos 'gal lo// des na 'khor bsgyur la dngos ming dang sna bdun la 'khor bsgyur btags ming 'jug pa ltar sa thob 'phags pa'i mnyam bzhag dang sangs rgyas pa'i mnyam rjes dbyer med pa la dngos ming dang theg chen gzhung lam la btags ming 'jug pas/

mdo las de gnyis bkod par zad do// yang na yan lag ces pa 'das ma thag pa'i zhi gnas kyi bdag nyid kyi rgyun te/ zhi gnas (10) kyi yongs su dag par byas pa'i sems kyi rgyun la shes rab skye bas legs par sbyangs pa'i zhing las 'bras bu skye ba bzhin du'o// yang na gzhung don gtso bo ni 'di yin te/ yan lag 'di dag ces pa gong bstan sbyin sogs lnga kun rdzob kyi yan lag gtsor ston dang*/ 'og nas 'chad 'gyur shes rab don dam pa'i yan lag gnyis bstan te/ 'di dag ces pa gnyis tshig dang*/ 'di ni bden pa gnyis su 'dod// ces pas shes te/ 'jug par/ kun rdzob de nyid gshog yangs dkar po rgyas 'gyur zhing*// ngang pa'i rgyal po de ni skye bo ngang pa yi// mdun du brdar nas dge ba'i rlung gi shugs stobs kyis// rgyal ba'i yon tan rgya mtsho'i pha rol mchog tu 'gro// zhes gsungs pa ltar thabs shes kyi yan lag gnyis la brten nas mthar thug gi 'bras bu sangs rgyas sa yi sher phyin de 'thob dgos pa'i phyir ro// 'o na yan lag 'di dag ces gong gi sbyin sogs lnga'am bsam gtan kho nar 'jug pa min nam zhe na min te/ gong mar 'jug pa/ de ltar 'di dang yang 'di dang zhes dang*/ 'og mar 'jug pa 'di skad bdag gis thos zhes sogs dang*/ gnyis gar 'jug pa/ 'di la mos pa'i rgyu dag ni/ zhes sgrub pa dang rnam dag sgom lam gnyis ka go dgos pa bzhin/ 'dir tha ma ltar ro// gzhan du na yan lag de dag ces brjod (11) rigs te/ le'u dang po bsam pa sems bskyed phan yon dang bcas pa bstan nas/ sbyin pa ston pa le'u gnyis pa'i mgor/ rin chen sems de bzung bar bya ba'i phyir zhes le'u gong dang mtshams sbyar de sgra 'byung ba dang*/ le'u gsum par mtshams sbyar de sgra med de gnyis pa'i mgor yul gong ma la mchod pa dang*/ gsum par dman pa la bsngo ba sogs gnyis char sbyin pa'i ngo bo gcig pa'i phyir/

des na bcu pa bsngo ba yang sbyin pa'i khongs su 'du'o// rgyal ba'i sras kyi de lta bu zhes bzhi par mtshams sbyar ba'i tshig dang*/ lnga par mtshams sbyor med pa ni dran shes bag yod tshul khrims kyi ngo bor gcig pa'i phyir/ drug par/ legs spyad gang yin de kun kyang zhes dang*/ bdun par/ de ltar bzod pas brtson 'grus brtsams zhes dang*/ brgyad par/ de ltar brtson 'grus brtsams nas ni zhes pa ni 'das tshig kho nar zad la/ 'di sgra dus gsum spyi dang khyad par ma 'ongs pa la 'jug pa shes che bas 'di dag ces gong 'og gnyis ka la 'jug pa gdon mi za'o// gong gi bshad zin thabs kun rdzob kyi yan lag dang*/ 'og tu 'chad 'gyur shes rab don dam pa'i yan lag yin na/ yan lag can gang zhe na/ bden gnyis dbyer med de yan lag can te/ 'phang lo sogs shing (12) sogs las tha dad pa'i yan lag can shing rta med pa bzhin no// yang na thabs shes tshogs gnyis rgyu'i yan lag dang*/ 'bras bu gnyis su med pa'i shes rab yan lag can du go na'ang chog la/ bden gnyis dbyer med dam tshogs gnyis zung 'jug dang*/ snang stong dbyer med/ sku gsum gnyis med sogs gzhan sel rtog pa'i zhen stangs tsam zung 'jug yin par rlom pa ni gnad ma go ba ste/ dper na me tsha ba'o zhes rtog pa'i 'dzin stangs ni me rang mtshan myong ba min pa bzhin dang*/ rang rig gam rnal mngon gyis snang stong sogs kyi spros bral lam rtog bral rang gis nyams su myong ba ni snang stong dbyer med sogs te/ dper na lus dbang gis tsha ba nyams su myong ba bzhin no// 'o na kun rdzob dang don dam yan lag zung 'jug yan lag can dang*/ sbyin sogs yan lag dang*/ sher phyin yan lag can du 'chad tshe/ 'phang lo sogs las tha dad pa'i shing rta mi srid pa ltar/ kun rdzob dang don dam las tha dad pa'i zung 'jug med pa dang*/ sbyin sogs lnga las tha dad pa'i sher phyin med pas pha rol phyin lnga kho nar 'gyur zhe na/

brtags shing dpyad pa'i ngor ma grub mod/ 'on kyang rigs pas dpyad pa ma btang ba'i tha snyad ngor yan lag dang yan lag can/ las dang byed (13) pa po nye bar blang bya dang len pa po sogs grub cing*/ sbyin sogs lnga yan lag dang sher phyin yan lag can byed pa'i tshe snga ma rgyu dang phyi ma 'bras bur nges pas rgyu'i nus pa 'bras bur 'dus pa'i don dang*/ sbyin pa'i phar phyin sogs lnga yan lag dang sher phyin yan lag can byed na ngo bo gcig la ldog pa tha dad do// thabs sogs phar phyin phyi ma bzhi sher phyin gyi ngo bor gcig pa bzhin no// snga ma rgyu'i nus pa 'bras bur 'dus pa ltar na chu phran rnams yan lag dang rgya mtsho chen po yan lag can yin pa bzhin dang*/ phyi ma ltar na sor mo lnga yan lag dang*/ lag pa yan lag can yin kyang sor mo las tha dad pa'i lag pa gzhan yang yod rung ba bzhin no// des na sor mo yin na lag pa yin pas khyab/ lag pa yin na sor mo yin pa ma khyab pa dang*/ kha 'bab kyi chu yin na ma dros mtsho'i chu yin pas khyab/ ma dros mtsho'i chu yin na kha 'bab yin pa ma khyab pa dang*/ khams bcu bdun yin na chos khams yin pas khyab/ chos khams yin na khams bcu bdun yin pa ma khyab pa sogs mtha' yas so// 'o na bsam gtan yan lag sher phyin yan lag can byed pa'i tshe ji ltar snyam na/ snga ma ltar rgyu 'bras sam ngo bo gcig la ldog pa tha dad de snga ma'i bye brag yin pas so//

(14) 1$0000300de yi phyir na sdug bsngal 1$0000270gsum gyis sdug bsngal ba'i 'gro ba mtha' yas pa'i sdug bsngal 1$0000300dag1$0000270 1$0000300/zhi bar 'dod pas 1$0000270nyan rang gi stong nyid med dgag dang byang sems so skyes lam gzhug (zhugs ma )zhugs nas rgyun mtha'i bar rgyur gyur pa dang*/ sangs rgyas kyi sar 'bras bur gyur pa'i shes rab rnam pa gnyis las thog mar rgyu dang phyis 'bras bu'i 1$0000300shes rab bskyed 1$0000270par bya'o// bstan bcos mtha' dag gi lus rnam bzhag bstan to// gnyis pa la gzhi thos bsam gyis gtan la 'bebs pa/ lam sgom pas nyams su len pa dang*/ der rtsod spang las 'phros nas mthar 'dzin ma lus pa bsal ba dang gsum mo// dang po la gnyis/ gzhi bden gnyis kyi rang bzhin spyir bstan pa dang*/ lam tshogs gnyis la brten nas 'bras bu sku gnyis zung 'jug mngon du byed tshul bye brag tu bshad pa'o// dang po la yan lag ngos bzung nas bden gnyis kyi mtshon bya'i dbye ba/ mtshan gzhi ngos bzung ba/ de rtogs pa po gang zag gi dbye ba'i sgo nas grangs nges pa dang gsum las/ dang po ni/ sgrib pas na kun rdzob ste ma rig pa dang*/ rten pas na kun rdzob 'di yod pas 'di 'byung ba sogs dang*/ brdar btags pas na kun rdzob ste tha snyad du bya ba dang bcas pa 1$0000300kun rdzob 1$0000270kyi bden pa 1$0000300dang 1$0000270yod pa dang med pa dang gnyi ga dang gnyis ka (min )bkag (15) pa'i rang bzhin med pa gdod ma nas spros pa nye bar zhi ba 1$0000300ni don dam pa ste// 'di ni bden pa gnyis su 'dod 1$0000270ces pas yan lag ngos 'dzin pa yin la// bden pa bzhir bshad pa yang 'dir 'dus te/ 'di ltar sdug bsngal dang kun 'byung ba dang lam gyi bden pa rnams kun rdzob kyi bden pa dang*/ de'ang sa thob 'phags pa'i rjes thob 'dus byas kun rdzob dang*/

'phags pa'i mnyam bzhag 'gog bden ni don dam pa'i bden pa yin no// 'dis bden gnyis kyi mtshon bya ston to// gnyis pa ni/ 1$0000300don dam 1$0000270pa'i bden pa ni mtshan nyid thams cad las 'das pas rnam par rtog pa'i 1$0000300blo yi spyod yul min 1$0000270la// de yang rnam grangs pa'i dbang du byas na mtshan gzhi dang rnam grangs min pa'i mtshan nyid de dang po ltar na blos spyod yul min pa de chos can don dam yin te brtags shing dpyad pa'i blo ngor grub pa'i phyir/ yang na ma grub zhes gang bkod kyang khyad med do// rnam grangs min pa'i dbang du byas na mtshan nyid yin te/ rab rib mthu yi skra shad la sogs pa// ngo bo log pa gang zhig rnam brtags pa// de nyid bdag nyid gang du mig dag pas// mthong de de nyid de bzhin 'dir shes gyis// zhes pas rab rib lta bu 'khor ba'i 'khrul snang dag tsam 'phags pa'i mnyam bzhag (16) spros bral de'ang gzhan gyis rtog pa gzhan sel gyi zhen yul la don dam zhes brda mdzad tsam las blos spyod yul min zhes pa'ang blos spyod yul bkag tsam las ngo bo mtshan nyid las 'das pas mtshan nyid med do// 1$0000300blo 1$0000270la snang ba dang mi snang ba'i dbang gis dngos po dang dngos med bden pa dang bden pa min pa la sogs pa ji ltar rnam par bzhag pa thams cad 1$0000300ni kun rdzob yin par brjod 1$0000270do// 'dis tha snyad du snang ba sems sam/ sems kyi cho 'phrul du ston te/ sems tsam rnam bden pas phyi gnas don lus gsum/ nang yid 'dzin rtog gsum sems kun gzhi'i rdzas su gcig pa don dam par bden grub khas len pa de dbu ma rang rgyud pa dang*/ grags sde spyod pas kyang don dam par rdzas su mi grub kyang rim gyis pa'i gang zag bkri ba'i phyir tha snyad du bden sgrub bam sgyu ma rmi lam lta bur nges par khas len dgos te/

dper na don dam la sems tsam pas phyi don mi 'dod kyang tha snyad du phyi don mdo sde pa ltar khas len dgos pa bzhin no// rnam brdzun pas rnam gsum rnams kyi snang ba de don la sems gsal rig gi rdzas su khas mi len yang*/ mkhar gzhong la skra shad dam me long gi gzugs brnyan ltar don la bem shes ci'ang mi grub kyang don dam par gnyis med kyi shes pa gsal rig la brten nas sems kyi cho 'phrul tsam du gzung 'dzin gyis snang ba 'byung bar 'dod do// (17) rnam med pa'i lugs 'di rang rgyud pas khas mi len yang thal 'gyur pas tha snyad du nges par khas len dgos la/ 'o na rnam med pa dang khyad par ci zhe na/ thal 'gyur bas snang stong dbyer med chos nyid spros bral gyi rang rtsal du 'dod do// des na snang ba sems sam sems kyi cho 'phrul du 'dod pa theg chen phal cher mthun par shes par bya'o// mdo sde pa'i lugs ltar rang rgyud 'og mas kyang gzhal bya lkog na mo khas len pa ma gtogs rnam bden pa dang khyad med la/ 'on kyang tha snyad bye smra'i rjes 'brang btsun pa ngo bo nyid med pa'i lugs la yang tha snyad du shes bya gzhi lnga sgyu ma lta bu khas len pas snang ba sems su mi 'dod kyang don dam sems kyi gnas lugs spros bral 'dod pas dbu ma pa kun don la mi mthun pa med do// ('dis don dam bden pa dang kun rdzob gyi dbye ba'i mtshan gzhi 'am mtshan nyid tsam bstan la bden pa'i mtshan nyid bstan pa min te/ bden pa'i sgra med pa'i phyir/) gsum pa la'ang gang zag gi dbye ba/ blo khyad kyi gnod rim/ rtogs tshul mi mthun pa'i rtsod spang dang gsum las/ dang po ni/ bden pa gnyis po 1$0000300de la 1$0000270rtogs pa po 1$0000300'jig rten rnam 1$0000270pa 1$0000300gnyis mthong 1$0000270ste// zhi lhag gi ting nge 'dzin gang la yod pa'i 1$0000300rnal 'byor pa dang 1$0000270de med pa'i 1$0000300phal pa'o1$0000270//

(18) zhes pas don dam bden pa dang kun rdzob bden pa rtogs pa po gang zag dngos su bstan cing shugs la bden gnyis kyi grangs nges ston te rnal 'byor pa 'phags pas rnal mngon gyis don dam bden pa mngon sum dang*/ phal pa so skyes kyis 'khrul snang kun rdzob log rtog gis bden par 'dzin pa'i phyir grangs nges grub ste 'phags pas ma 'khrul ba yang dag pa dang*/ so skyes kyis phyin ci log tu mthong ba las gzhan bden brdzun gnyis yin dang gnyis min gyi chos mi srid pa'i phyir ro// gnyis pa/ 'jig rten pas kun rdzob dang 'phags pas don dam mthong ba'i rgyu mtshan ni/ 1$0000300de la 1$00002701$0000300'jig rten phal pa 1$0000270rnams 1$0000300ni1$0000270/ 1$0000300/rnal 'byor 'jig rten gyis gnod cing*/ 1$0000270/slar cig shos kyis ni rnal 'byor pa'i shes pa la gnod pa ma yin te/ mig ni rab rib can gyis dmigs pa yis// rab rib med shes la gnod min ji ltar// de bzhin dri med ye shes spangs pa'i blos// dri med blo la gnod pa yod ma yin// zhes gsungs pa yang rnal 'byor pa 'phags pa la dgongs pa yin no// phal pa 'ba' zhig la gnod pa ma zad 1$0000300rnal 'byor pa yang blo 1$0000270ste shes rab kyi 1$0000300khyad 1$0000270par dang ting nge 'dzin dang snyoms par 'jug pa la sogs 1$0000300kyis1$0000270// nyan rang byang sems sogs sa 1$0000300gong ma gong ma 1$0000270la gnas pa 1$0000300rnams kyis 1$0000270'og (19) ma 'og ma dag la 1$0000300gnod 1$0000270do// de'ang nyan thos 'phags pa'i mnyam bzhag stong 'dzin gnyis snang*/ rang rgyal 'dzin rtog byang 'phags spros bral rnams gong ma rnams lhag pa'i don dang nyan rang nang tshan mchog dman dang byang sems sogs mchog dman shugs kyis shes so// gnod ces pa ni zil gyis gnon zhes pa'i tha tshig go

/'di'i don skar ma dang zla ba'i 'od nyi ma'i 'od du 'dus pa bzhin 'phags pa 'og ma'i mkhyen pa gong mar 'du bas mi 'gal yang 'og ma las gong ma 'phags pa'i don to// 'dir rnal 'byor bye smra sogs la ngos 'dzin pa mi rung ste grub mtha' smra ba bzhi po la rnal 'byor pa'i brda dang tha snyad ma grags pa'i phyir dang don la'ang mi 'thad de so skyes grub mtha' 'dzin pas chos nyid rnal ma'i don mthong ba min pa'i phyir ro// de'ang tshad ma mdo las/ rnal 'byor rnams kyis bla mas bstan// ma 'dres pa yi don tsam mthong*// zhes pa dang*/ 'jug pa las/ so so'i skye bo rnams ni rtog pas bcings// mi rtog rnal 'byor pa ni grol bar 'gyur// zhes dang*/ 'og tu yang*/ rnal 'byor kun rdzob nyes med de// zhes so// des na rnal 'byor pa ni rigs can gsum gyi 'phags pa'i gang zag kho na ste nang sde'i grub mtha' smra ba 'og (20) mas don dam bden pa mthong mi srid cing dbu ma pas kyang spros bral go ba tsam yin gyi rtogs pa min pas rnal 'byor 'jig rten gyis don dam mthong bar gsungs pa dang dngos su 'gal lo// rnal 'byor pa'i blo'i khyad par las phal pa'i shes pa 'khrul pa yin no zhes ji ltar rtogs par nus zhe na/ gsum pa tha snyad snang tshul thun mong du bstan pa/ 'dzin stangs mi mtshungs pa'i rtsod pa 'byung tshul/ rtsod pa dngos rgyas par bstan pa dang gsum las/ dang po ni/ rnal 'byor pa dang phal pa 1$0000300gnyis ka yang 1$0000270sgyu ma dang rmi lam la sogs pa 1$0000300ni 1$0000270rang bzhin med par 1$0000300'dod pa'i 1$0000270phyir 1$0000300dpe 1$0000270des chos thams cad rang bzhin med pa nyid du rnal 'byor pas phal pa la ston pa yin no// phar phyin skabs rmi lam sogs chos thams cad bden med du bstan pa ni dpe yi ye shes te grub mtha' la zhugs ma zhugs thams cad kyis chos kun bden med ma rtogs kyang sgyu ma sogs bden med du rtogs pa yod de/

'di med na dbu ma'i lta ba ngo sprad thabs med de/ dper na tshang mang du me du'i 'brel ba ma nges na la rgyab tu me mi dpog pa bzhin no// so skye skabs rmi lam sogs bden med rang rig mngon sum gyi rtogs pa 'di rigs khams bde gshegs snying po'ang yin no// lam ma zhugs pa'am mtshan nyid theg pa la dpe'i ye shes med snyam pa ni ma go ba chen po'o// (21) 'o na sems can thams cad gdon pa'i bsam pas sbyin pa la sogs pa'i tshogs yongs su rdzogs pa'i phyir byang chub sems dpa' yang ji ltar 'jug par 'gyur te/ de rnams rang bzhin med pa yin pa'i phyir zhe na/ 1$0000300'bras bu 1$0000270rdzogs pa1$0000300'i 1$0000270byang chub thob pa'i 1$0000300don du 1$0000270don dam rigs pas 1$0000300ma dpyad 1$0000270par de'i rgyu tshogs gnyis la 'jug pa'i 1$0000300phyir 1$0000270te// de ltar gyur na de la 'di ni rten cing 'brel bar 'byung ba'i nges pa yod pa'i phyir rgyu dang 'bras bu la 'gal ba med do// don dam rigs pa'i dpyad bzod du chos thams cad spros bral nam mkha' lta bu la las 'bras mi grub kyang tha snyad tshad ma'i ngor las 'bras mtha' dag dbu ma pas kyang khas len dgos pa'i phyir te/ tha snyad khas ni ma blang bar// nged cag 'chad par mi byed do// zhes so// gal te sgyu ma la sogs pa dang mtshungs pa'i dngos po'i rang gi ngo bo rnal 'byor pas rtogs pa de nyid skye bo phal pas kyang rtogs na ji ltar gang du log par rtog pa yod par 'gyur zhe na/ gnyis pa ni/ 1$0000300'jig rten pa yis 1$0000270rgyu dang rkyen la brten pa'i 1$0000300dngos 1$0000270po'i rang bzhin 1$0000300mthong zhing 1$0000270mthong ba 'ba' zhig tu ma zad// 1$0000300yang dag 1$0000270pa ste don dam pa 1$0000300nyid du'ang rtog 1$0000270par 1$0000300byed kyi/1$0000270

/rnal 'byor pas mthong ba bzhin 1$0000300sgyu ma lta bur 1$0000270mthong ba 1$0000300min pas 'dir/1$0000270 (22) 1$0000300/rnal 'byor pa dang 'jig rten 1$0000270pa lhan cig 1$0000300rtsod 1$0000270de// 'di ni rnal 'byor 'phags pas chos thams cad bden med rtogs pa dang*/ so skye 'jig rten pas bden par rtogs pa gnyis 'dzin stangs mi mtshungs nas rtsod pa 'di'ang ngag gis dngos su rtsod pa kho na go mi dgos te/ don rtag pa'am mi rtag pa dang bden par grub mi grub dang*/ ngo bo stong mi stong 'dzin stangs mi mtshungs pa'i don te/ grub mtha' la ma zhugs pa rnams kyis ngag gis dngos su rtsod kyang mi shes so// dngos su rtsod pa po ni lhan skyes kyi bden 'dzin la kun btags kyi sgrub byed ltar snang bkod nas mu stegs byed dang nang sde grub mtha' smra ba kho nar zad do// des na gzhi gtan la 'bebs skabs nang sde rtsod spong kho na dang*/ lam sgom pa nyams su len pa dang gtan tshigs kyis sgro 'dogs gcod skabs phyi rol pa'i rtsod spong gtso bor bkod pa ni gzhung 'di'i lugs te/ phan tshun dngos shugs kyis bstan pa'i phyir/ spyir mgon po klu sgrub yab sras rnams kyis gzhan lugs bkag nas rang lugs bzhag pa gtso che la/ phyogs glang yab sras dang chos rje sa paṇa sogs kyi tshad ma 'chad skabs gzhan lugs dgag rang lugs bzhag rtsod spang gsum re mdzad cing*/ rgyal sras chen pos rang lugs bzhag pa dang*/ de la rtsod spong gnyis re mdzad pa las gong du dbu ma pa rang lugs kyi bden (23) gnyis rnam bzhag bstan nas 'di nas rtsod spang mgo bzung ba'o// gsum pa la phyi don smra ba mdo sde pa'i rtsod spong*/ rig pa smra ba sems tsam pa'i rtsod spang ngo*// dang po la rang mtshan don la ma grub na 'khrul grol gyi gzhi mi 'thad pas mngon sum dang 'gal ba spang ba/ lung dang 'gal ba spang ba/

ha cang thal ba spang ba dang gsum las dang po ni/ 'dir mdo sde pa'i rtsod spang gtso che yang bye mdo gnyis grub mtha' phal cher gcig pas rtsod spong phal cher mthun no// 'og lam la rtsod spong skabs bye smra gtso che ba yang shes par bya'o// de ltar gyur na yang gang skye bo ma lus pas thun mong du mngon sum gyi tshad mas mthong ba'i dngos po'i rang bzhin de don byed nus pa yin la/ de ltar ji ltar bsnyon par nus zhes gzhan gyi sems kyi dogs pa bsus nas lan du 1$0000300gzugs 1$0000270la 1$0000300sogs 1$0000270pa gang zhig 1$0000300mngon sum 1$0000270du gyur pa 1$0000300nyid kyang ni// 1$0000270'jig rten pa'i yongs su 1$0000300grags pas yin gyi tshad mas 1$0000270ngor mngon sum gyi gzugs la sogs pa yod pa ni 1$0000300min 1$0000270te// 1$0000300de ni 1$0000270khyod kyi lugs la don dam par bud med kyi lus sogs 1$0000300mi gtsang 1$0000270ba dang mi rtag pa 1$0000300la sogs 1$0000270pa yin pa 1$0000300la1$0000270// 'jig rten na 1$0000300gtsang 1$0000270ba dang rtag pa la 1$0000300sogs 1$0000270su 1$0000300grags pa bzhin du rdzun 1$0000270pa phyin ci log tu 'dzin pa yin no// (24) 'di'ang gtso cher snang stong sgyu ma lta bur bstan te/ mi gtsang ba sogs tha snyad du yod dgos pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa la phung khams skye mched yod par bstan pa dang 'gal ba spang ba/ rgyal ba mchod pa'i bsod nams 'byung ba sogs las 'bras bu mi 'thad pa'i rtsod spang dang gnyis las dang po ni/ 'di ltar phung po dang khams dang skye mched la sogs pa rang bzhin gyis yod par bcom ldan 'das kyis mdo las bstan pa dang*/ de dag skad cig ma la sogs pa'i rang bzhin yang bstan to zhe na/ dngos po la mngon par zhen pa'i 1$0000300'jig rten 1$0000270rnams stong pa nyid la rim gyis 1$0000300gzhug pa'i don du ni/1$0000270

1$0000300/mgon pos dngos 1$0000270po rnams 1$0000300bstan 1$0000270la 1$0000300de 1$0000270kho na 1$0000300nyid du1$0000270// phung po la sogs pa 1$0000300de dag 1$0000270rdul phran dang 1$0000300skad cig ma nyid 1$0000270kyang 1$0000300min 1$0000270no// phung khams skye mched mngon pa'i mdo las bye mdo gnyis kyi dbang du byas te shes bya gzhi lnga'am gsum rdzas su bstan cing*/ shes pa skad cig cha med dang*/ gzung ba rdul phran cha med gnyis don dam bden grub bstan pa yang*/ dgongs gzhi tha snyad du rmi lam lta bu la dgongs shing dgos pa skal med rim 'jug mkhan dbu mar gzhug pa'i don du de ltar dngos por gsungs so// rigs pa drug cu pa las/ dgos pa'i dbang gis rgyal ba rnams// nga dang nga yi zhes gsungs ltar// de bzhin phung khams skye

(25) mched rnams// dgos pa'i dbang gis gsungs pa yin// zhes so// don dam par stong pa nam mkha' lta bu mtha' gang du'ang ma grub bo// 'o na 1$0000300kun rdzob tu yang 'gal 1$0000270te sus kyang mthong ba mi nus so 1$0000300zhe na1$00002701$0000300// 1$0000270tshu rol mthong ba rnams kyi skad cig ma dang rdul phran cha med nyid rtog med kyi 1$0000300rnal 'byor 1$0000270ba'i rjes thob tu 1$0000300kun rdzob 1$0000270tsam du mthong bas 1$0000300nyes 1$0000270pa 1$0000300med de// 1$0000270chos thams cad tha snyad du rmi lam lta bu skad cig dang rdul phran cha med du mthong ba'i phyir 'di'ang rang rgyud man chad bye mdo'i rjes 'brang rnams shes pa skad cig cha med dang gzung ba rdul phran cha med nyan rang dang theg chen gnyis char gyi don dam pa 'dod cing*/ chos thams cad bden med ma rtogs bzhin du skad cig cha med rnal mngon gyis rtogs par 'dod la/ des na nyan rang gi mnyam rjes thams cad skad cig dang rdul phran cha med la bden 'dzin du 'dod pas kun rdzob tsam brjod thabs med pa'i phyir/ thal 'gyur bas 'phags pa'i mnyam bzhag snang med yin pas chos can thams cad bden med ma rtogs na skad cig cha med mngon sum gyis rtogs mi srid pa/ skad cig cha med mngon sum du rtogs na rnal 'byor pa 'phags bzhi gang rung yin pas khyab cing 'dir skad cig ma 'phags pa 'og ma (26) gsum gyi rjes thob yin na bden med yin pas khyab ste/ 'jug pa las/ 'gro ba g.yo ba chu yi nang gi zla ba ltar// g.yo dang rang bzhin nyid kyis stong pa mthong ba ltar// zhes chos la dmigs pa'i snying rje'i dmigs yul skad cig cha med de chu zla ltar bden med gsungs pa'i phyir/ rnal 'byor pa'i rjes thob kun rdzob tsam yin par grub bo// ci'i phyir kun rdzob tu yang skad cig ma la sogs pa rnal 'byor pa rnams kyis mthong gi

tshu rol mthong ba rnams kyis ma yin zhe na/ 1$0000300'jig rten 1$0000270pa 1$0000300la ltos 1$0000270te de'i dbang po las 'das pa mthong bas 1$0000300de 1$0000270kho na 1$0000300nyid mthong 1$0000270ba yin no// 'di'i don sngar bshad pa ltar rnal 'byor pa'i rjes thob kun rdzob rdul phran dang skad cig cha med de 'jig rten pa'i rags pa gcig tu bden 'dzin gyi blo la ltos na de kho na nyid don dam zhes bya ste rdul phran dang skad cig cha med du bden med mthong ba'i phyir/ 'dir tha snyad rnam 'jog tsam la mchog dman du bstan pa yin gyi don dam dngos min pas rnal 'byor pa'i kun rdzob dang 'jig rten la ltos pa'i de kho na nyid ni ming gi rnam grangs so// mdor na shes pa skad cig cha med dang gzung ba rdul phran cha med 'jig rten so skyes kyis bden par bzung la/ de dbu ma pa'i grub mtha' la ltos na tha snyad bden pa yin la/ der bden par mi 'dzin na kun rdzob tsam ste gong ltar ro// (27) 1$0000300gzhan du 1$0000270na mi sdug pa sgom pa'i dus su 1$0000300bud med 1$0000270kyi lus 1$0000300mi gtsang bar// nges 1$0000270par 1$0000300rtogs 1$0000270pa de 1$0000300'jig rten gyis gnod 1$0000270par 1$0000300'gyur 1$0000270te 'jig rten pas bud med kyi lus gtsang ba nyid du zhen pa'i phyir ro// gong du lhan skyes 'jig rten dang 'gal ba des rjes 'gro'i sgo nas bstan/ 'dir bde bar gshegs pa'i gsung rab dang 'gal ba'am bye mdo'i grub mtha' la 'gal spang dpe ldog khyab kyi sgo nas bstan pa'o// gnyis pa ni/ 'o na sangs rgyas kyang sgyu ma dang rmi lam lta bur 'gyur na/ de ltar na de la phan pa dang gnod pa dag la ji ltar bsod nams dang sdig pa skye bar 'gyur zhe na/ 1$0000300sgyu 1$0000270ma 1$0000300'dra 1$0000270ba1$0000300'i rgyal 1$0000270ba la mchod pa dang bsnyen bkur byas pa 1$0000300las 1$0000270sgyu ma lta bu'i 1$0000300bsod nams 1$0000270'byung ba 1$0000300ni1$0000270// dpe 1$0000300ji ltar 1$0000270na don dam pa'i 1$0000300dngos 1$0000270por 1$0000300yod 1$0000270pa'i rgyal ba 1$0000300la 1$0000270bsnyen bkur byas te don dam pa'i bsod nams bden grub skye ba 1$0000300ji 1$0000270lta ba 1$0000300bzhin 1$0000270no// de ltar na 'khor ba'i sems can rnams la ji ltar brjod ce na/

de rnams kyang de bzhin du brjod de lha'i bu sems can de rnams kyang sgyu ma lta bu'o// zhes sogs gsungs pa'i phyir ro// gsum pa ha cang thal ba la gnyis te/ sems can 'khor bar 'khyam mi srid pa dang*/ rgyal ba mya ngan las 'das mi srid pa thal ba spang ba'o// dang po la 'bras bu 'khor ba'i sems can (28) mi srid pa dang*/ rgyu las nyon mi srid par thal ba spang ba gnyis/ dang po ni/ 1$0000300gal te sems can 1$0000270rnams 1$0000300sgyu 1$0000270ma dang 1$0000300'dra na/1$0000270 rigs mthun btang ste 1$0000300shi nas ji ltar 1$0000270yang 1$0000300skye 1$0000270ba 'byung 1$0000300zhe na// ji srid 1$0000270sngags dang sman la sogs pa'i 1$0000300rkyen rnams tshogs 1$0000270par 1$0000300gyur pa// de srid 1$0000270du 1$0000300sgyu ma'ang 'byung bar 'gyur 1$0000270la/ de bzhin du ji srid du ma rig pa dang srid pa'i rang bzhin tshogs pa de srid du sems can gyi rgyud kyi sgyu ma yang 'byung bar 'gyur te/ rkyen rnams kyi 'jug pa yod pa'i phyir ro// der ma zad snod rung sems can yod na sangs rgyas yang gdul bya'i ngor kun rdzob tu rgyun mi chad par 'byung ngo*// gal te don dam par sems can med na 'khor ba ji srid du sems can gyi rgyun rnams ji ltar 'jug par 'gyur zhe na/ 1$0000300rgyun ring tsam gyis ji ltar na// sems can bden pa yod pa yin 1$0000270zhes 'dri ba'o// 'di ni shin tu ma nges te rmi lam dang sgyu ma sogs rmi lugs la yun ring thung sna tshogs 'byung ste sgyu ma mkhan rta glang gi sprul pa lta bu shin tu yun ring ba dang thung ba'i snang ba 'byung srid pa'i phyir/ rmi lam sogs la de ltar yun ring thung 'byung ba dang*/ 'khor ba'i snang ba'ang tshe snga phyi 'dod pa la bsam na gnyid sad pa sogs kyi rmi lam sogs thung snyam pa dang 'khor ba ring ba'i 'du shes 'byung mod nying 'khrul spang ba la ltos pa yin gyi/

(29) ma rig pa'i gnyid sangs ba la ltos na sad pa'i snang ba yang sgyu ma rmi lam dang khyad par ci yod/ dper na gnyid sad pa rmi lam gyi thog mar rlom na min te gos kyi gong ba dang mtha' gnyis mgo yi spyi gtsug dang rkang mthil min pa bzhin no// des na rmi lam dang sgyu ma sogs 'khrul snang rang nyid la ltos na 'khor ba dang 'dra bar thog mtha' mi rnyed de rmi lam rmis bzhin pa'i gnas skabs na/ dang po rmi lugs dang mthar sad lugs shes pa tha mal pa mi srid pa'i phyir ro// gnyis pa ni/ 1$0000300'o na sgyu ma'i skyes bu bsad 1$0000270pa 1$0000300sogs la 1$0000270srog gcod pa sogs med pa de bzhin du de las gzhan pa'i skyes bu bsad pa la sogs pa yang de ltar 'gyur te/ rang bzhin tha dad pa ma yin pa'i phyir zhe na/ sgyu ma'i skyes bu bsad pa dang 'di la ma byin pa len pa sogs la// 1$0000300sems med 1$0000270pa'i 1$0000300phyir na sdig 1$0000270pa 1$0000300med de 1$0000270mi dge ba'i dngos gzhi skye bar mi 'gyur ro// 'di cung zad zhib tu dpyad na sgyu ma shes na las kyi bag chags phra mo tsam bskyed/ sgyu ma ngo ma shes na sbyor ba'i sdig pa rang mtshan pa kho na dang*/ 'di'ang srog gcod pa po tha mal pa'i gnas skabs yin la/ rmi lam rmis bzhin pa zhig gi rmi lam ngo mi shes bzhin du las bsags na sad pa'i tshe rjes su yi rang yod na dngos gzhi dang (30) cha 'dra bskyed la/ rjes su yi rang med na bag chags kyi sa bon tsam bskyed cing dngos gzhi mi bskyed de/ rang rig mngon sum gyis sad pa'i tshe bden med mngon sum du rtogs pa'i phyir/ 'o na bag chags ni sa bon yin na de'i 'bras bu nam gyi tshe myong snyam na phyis rmi lam gyi tshe dang 'phags sa thob pa'i tshe myong ngo*// rmi lam ngo shes pa zhig gis rmi lam na las bsags na bag chags shin tu phra mo zhig ste bden 'dzin gtan ma skyes pa'i phyir/

'khrul pa sad pa'i tshe sgyu ma ngo shes pa bzhin no// des na dge tshul slong gis rtsed mo rtse ba na yang ltung bar bshad pa'i phyir ro// 1$0000300sgyu ma'i 1$0000270rang bzhin gyi 1$0000300sems dang (brtan rten )brten 'byung gi snang ba la dgongs so// de la so skyes las bsags na 'khor bar dbang med du 'khyams pa'i rgyu las mtshan nyid pa zag bcas su 'gyur ba'i phyir/ nyan rang dgra bcom dang byang 'phags kyis zag med kyi las bsags pa yang bag chags phra mo dang shin tu phra mo dang*/ yang nyan rang slob pa phal cher so skye dang 'dra la/ phal cher dgra bcom pa dang 'dra ba'ang bden 'dzin spong lugs kyis shes te rang gi rigs pas dpyad na shes par 'gyur ro// 'dul ba'i gzhung (31) las gzhi bsam sbyor ba mthar thug tshang ma tshang dpyad na/ mi lta bu bsad snyam pa gtan med kyang mgo bor rdo phog nas shi shor ba lta bu la sbyor ba lhod pa'i nyes pa tsam dang*/ lha sbyin bsad bsam nas mchod sbyin la phog na mchod sbyin shi rung*/ ma shi rung sbyor sdig kho na ste 'du shes nor ba'i phyir te mdzod las/ srog gcod pa ni bsam bzhin du// ma nor ba ni gzhan bsad pa 'o// zhes so// sdong dum la mir rlom nas bcad na sbyor sdig kho na las dngos gzhi mi 'gyur ste sems can min pa'i phyir dang bsam pa nor ba'i phyir dang mthar thug srog ma bcad pa'i phyir/ rang gis rang bsad na sbyor sdig kho na ste dngos gzhi srog 'gag pa dang srang mda'i mtho dman ltar rang skye ba gzhan len pa dus rnal lan gyi sgo (38) nas don bsdu ba gsum las/ dang po ni/ 1$0000300gang 1$0000270gi 1$0000300tshe 1$0000270rnam par shes pa smra ba 1$0000300khyod la sgyu ma nyid// med na'ang de1$0000270'i 1$0000300tshe 1$0000270'dir 1$0000300ci zhig 1$0000270la 1$0000300dmigs1$0000270// gnyis pa la nyes spongs dang*/ lan gnyis las dang po ni/ 1$0000300gal te 1$0000270yul gyi go sa 1$0000300de nyid du gzhan 1$0000270zhig 1$0000300yod 1$0000270de/ yul gyi 1$0000300rnam pa de 1$0000270nyid 1$0000300ni sems nyid yin 1$0000270no zhe na/ gnyis pa la sgrub byed rang rig 'gog pa dang*/ bsgrub bya kun gzhi 'gog pa gnyis las/ dang po la bden grub tha snyad tsam du'ang mi 'thad/ snang ba tha snyad du mi 'gog par bstan pa gnyis/ dang po la/ tha snyad kyi mngon sum dang 'gal ba/ lung dang 'gal ba/ dngos stobs kyi rigs pa dang 'gal ba bstan pa gsum las/ dang po ni/ de yang 'brel ba ma yin no zhes bstan pa'i phyir/ 1$0000300gang 1$0000270gi 1$0000300tshe sems 1$0000270rnam par shes pa 1$0000300nyid sgyu ma 1$0000270las gzhan ma yin 1$0000300na// de tshe gang zhig gang gis mthong 1$0000270// de bas na 'gro ba mtha' dag long ba nyid thob par 'gyur ro zhes dgongs pa yin no// 'dir tha snyad snang tsam dgag pa min te don dam par bem shes mtha' dag shes pa'i rdzas rang rig gcig pur 'dod pa la khas blangs nang 'gal ba bstan te/ long ba thob par 'gyur ba'i don mig long ba rkyang par go bar mi bya ste yul gzugs sogs ci'ang mi mthong (39) ba thal ba'i don to// 'o na tha snyad du mi 'gog pa 'gal zhe na/ gnad don 'di yin te dngos smra ba mtha' dag gi lugs la dngos su snang ba rags pa rdzun pa dang*/ phra mo skad cig dang rdul phran don dam par 'dod cing phra rags rdzas tha dad khas len ma nus pas gcig las 'os med pas phra ba don dam cha med la gzung 'dzin tha dad ma grub pa bzhin du rags pa kun rdzob kyi gnas skabs na'ang gzung 'dzin gcig tu 'gyur ba'i thal 'gyur bkod do// tha snyad tsam du snang ba sgyu ma lta bu rdzun pa khas len pa la ni dngos stobs rigs pas 'gog mi dgos so// gnyis pa ni/

gzhan rig gi dpe rang rig sgrub byed mi 'thad pa gnyis las/ dang po don dam lta ci tha snyad tsam du yang dran pa rang rig gi 'bras bu ma nges pa bstan pa ni/ smras pa/ 'di rigs pas stong zhing tshig tsam ma yin par rigs pa ni 'di yin te/ 1$0000300gal te 1$0000270shes pas 1$0000300rang rig 1$0000270pa 1$0000300yod 1$0000270pa 1$0000300min na1$0000270// yul myong ba na phyis su de dang dus gcig pa'i 1$0000300rnam 1$0000270par 1$0000300shes 1$0000270pa 1$0000300dran par ji ltar 'gyur 1$0000270te// nyams su ma myong ba dran na ni ha cang thal bar 'gyur bas so// de lta bas na rang nyams su myong ba'i 'bras bu dran pa dus phyis dmigs pa'i phyir/ rang rig pa'i shes pa yod do zhes dpog par bya'o// tha snyad du phyi don mdo sde pa ltar khas len skabs dngos yul bum pa lta bu nyams su myong ba na de dang dus mnyam du blo yang rang rig gis rang nyams su myong ba yin la/ de'ang skad cig snga ma snga mas phyi ma phyi ma la nus pa (44) bzhag nas phyis su sngar gyi yul dran pa ni sngar yul myong ba'i stobs kyi yin la/ sngar rang rig gis rang (nyid )nyams su myong ba'i stobs kyis bum 'dzin gyi blo yang ngas mthong snyam nas phyis dran pa yin no// mdor na mthar thug sems tsam ltar don dam pa'i dbang du byas na gzhan rig kyang rang rig gi khongs su 'du bas/ kun gzhi rnam shes skad cig snga ma gzhan gyi rang rig gi bag chags de phyi ma dran pas myong ba yin pas sngar gyi rang rig med na phyi ma dran pa 'byung ba mi srid pa'i phyir ro// rang rig dang dran pa gnyis rdzas skad cig tha dad rgyun gcig pa yin pas rang rig dang dran pa'i bar du/ skad cig dang zhag zla ba dang lo dang bskal pa mang po'i bar du chod srid do zhe na/ de la brjod par bya ste/ yul nyams su myong ba'i shes pa las 1$0000300gzhan 1$0000270gzung bar bya ba'i dngos po bum pa lta bu yul du gyur pa nyams su 1$0000300myong ba 1$0000270po blo nyid 1$0000300dang*/

1$0000270yul bum pa lta bu de dang yul yul can dus mnyam du 'brel ba dang*/ der ma zad sngar gyi yul de dang phyis kyi dran pa gnyis kyang tha snyad du yul yul can nam rgyu 'bras su 1$0000300'brel ba las1$0000270// sngar bum 'dzin gyi rnam par shes pa rang gis rang ma myong yang 1$0000300dran 1$0000270par 1$0000300'gyur 1$0000270te dper na 1$0000300byi ba'i dug bzhin no1$0000270// 'di ltar byi ba'i dug skad cig ma gcig la

(45) lus la 'phos nas yang dus gzhan du 'brug gi sgra'i rkyen 'phrad pa las rang rig pas bzhag pa'i dran pas bag chags kyi sa bon med par yang rkyen dang 'phrad pa nyid kyi phyis skad cig gzhan du rnam par 'gyur ba 'thob ste/ de bzhin du skabs su bab pa la yang skyon med do zhes dgongs so// mdor na don dam dpyad pa'i rigs ngor dran pa rang rig gi 'bras bu rtags ma grub cing tha snyad du rtags ma nges te/ 'jug pa las don dam par dran pa rang rig gi 'bras bu rtags ma grub ste dran pa dang*/ rang rig snga phyi rdzas tha dad pa'i phyir mig gis sgra bzhin no zhes pa ltar dang yang me shel dang chu shel las me chu 'byung mod/ 'jig rten na me chu yod tshad me shel dang chu shel gyi 'bras bu yin par ma nges pa bzhin no// des na tha snyad du'ang skabs 'dir dran pa rang rig gi 'bras bu'i rtags ma nges par bstan te don dam rigs pas ma dpyad par tha snyad tsam gyi snang ngor yang sngar gyi don myong ba'i 'bras bu dran pa dang*/ blo rang rig gis 'bras bu gnyis 'byung srid cing der ma zad/ dran 'gyur byi ba'i dug bzhin no// zhes pa'i don ni 'das pa myong zin yang dran gyi don min gyi sngar ma myong yang da lta dran pas gsar du shes pa'i don to// 'dun mos (46) dran ting shes rab ste zhes pa'i nang tshan/ dran pa de ni dmigs rnam mi brjed pa'i dran pa spyi'i mtshan nyid yin pas dug yin pa da lta gsar du shes pa'i shes rab sogs dang dus mnyam du 'byung ba'i dran pas gsar du dmigs pa'am shes pa yin pa'i phyir ro// gnyis pa ni/ slar yang rnam par shes pa tsam du smra bas rang rig pa grub par bya ba'i ched du rnam pa gzhan bstan pa'i phyir 1$0000300rkyen gzhan 1$0000270gzhan sems shes pa'i ting 'dzin bsgom pa 1$0000300dag dang ldan pa ni1$0000270// gzhan gyi sems kyi khyad par 1$0000300mthong 1$0000270ba'i 1$0000300phyir 1$0000270rnam par shes pa 1$0000300rang nyid rang 1$0000270la 1$0000300gsal 1$0000270zhe 1$0000300na1$0000270/

dad pas gzhan rig gi dper snang bas de ltar na 'di ni bsgrub bya rang rig la mkho ba'i sgrub byed kyi dpe ma yin no// 'ga' zhig thag ring gi spu nyag mthong na nye ba'i shing sdong ci ste mi mthong*/
