tha snyad du rnam gsum (48) gyi snang ba sems sam sems kyi bag chags snga ma'i cho 'phrul tsam khas mi len pa'i theg chen pa mi srid pa'i phyir dang*/ nang pa sangs rgyas pa'i grub mtha' 'og ma mtha' dag dang gong ma gsum dang 'gal med du rtogs dgos pa'i phyir dang*/ khyad par du sa skya pa rnams kyis sems tsam pa ltar du rnam shes tshogs brgyad dang snang ba sems su khas len dgos te/ rnam 'byor dbang phyug gis gsang sngags lam 'bras skabs sems tsam ltar snang ba sems su sgrub nas sems tsam pa'i lta ba (la )drangs nas/ sems nyid rten 'brel lam brjod bral sgrub nas dbu ma'i lta ba la drangs pa'i phyir ro// 'jug pa las/ kun gzhi yod cing gang zag nyid yod la// phung po 'di dag 'ba' zhig nyid yod ces// bstan pa 'di ni de ltar ches zab don// rig par mi 'gyur gang yin de la 'o// zhes so// yang tha snyad du snang ba sems sam sems kyi cho 'phrul du sgrub pa 'di dbu ma'am gsang sngags pa'i grub mtha' rlom pa dang*/ tha snyad tsam du'ang snang ba sems su mi grub bo snyam pa srid na'ang log rtog rgya che ste don dam dpyad pa'i rigs ngor phyi don snang ba dang sems gnyis char cir yang mi (49) grub cing bde bar gshegs pas nges don gyi mdo rgyud rnams las gsungs shing rigs pa'i dbang phyug rnam gnyis kyis tha snyad tshad ma'i ngor sems tsam rnam bden brdzun ltar legs par gtan la phab zin pas dus gsum gyi rgyal ba sras dang bcas pas tha snyad tsam du 'gog mi srid do// mdor na kun gzhi rnam shes bden grub 'dir 'gog gi tha snyad du bden med sgyu ma lta bu mi 'gog ste/ sems tsam skabs yin pa'i phyir dang bden pa kho na 'gog pa dngos su gsungs pa'i phyir ro// da ni zhar las byung ba kun gzhi sgrub byed rang rig bkag pa yongs su rdzogs par byas nas skabs su bab pa kun gzhi dngos dgag pa la sbyar ba'i phyir/

gnyis pa/ sgrub bya kun gzhi 'gog pa ni/ sems las sgyu ma gzhan yin par gyur pa'am/ gzhan ma yin par gyur pa'am/ gnyis ka'i rang bzhin yin pa'am/ gnyis ka'i rang bzhin ma yin pa zhes brtags na/ phyogs dang po ltar na sems tsam du 'dod pa'i grub mtha' dang 'gal bar 'gyur ro// phyogs gnyis pa la ni/ gang tshe khyod la sgyu ma nyid// med na'ang de tshe ci zhig dmigs// zhes pa'i nyes pa yin no// (50) phyogs gsum pa yang gcig la phan tshun 'gal bas mi srid pa'i phyir ro// phyogs bzhi pa'i dbang du byas te don dam pa na 1$0000300sems las 1$0000270yul 1$0000300sgyu ma 1$0000270de 1$0000300gzhan min 1$0000270te yul gyi rnam par snang ba shes pa dang rdzas gcig yin 1$0000300zhing*// gzhan min par 1$0000270ni gcig tu 1$0000300yang mi brtags 1$0000270te tha snyad du gzung 'dzin tha dad du snang ba'i phyir zhe 1$0000300na1$0000270/ de yang rigs pa ma yin te/ yul sgyu ma de 1$0000300dngos 1$0000270po rdzas su grub pa yin 1$0000300na ji ltar 1$0000270yul 1$0000300de 1$0000270sems las 1$0000300gzhan min 1$0000270te sems las gzhan du 'gyur te rdzas tha dad yul dang yul can yin pa'i phyir ro// tha snyad du snang tshul gzung 'dzin tha dad tsam las don gyi gnas lugs la gzung bar snang ba sems kyi rdzas yin pas/ 1$0000300gzhan min zhe na 1$0000270sems nyid kyang sgyu ma nyid yin pas don dam par 1$0000300dngos por med 1$0000270de don dam par yod pa ma yin pa yul sgyu ma brdzun pa de'i rang bzhin yin pa'i phyir ro// 'di ni rnam bden pas gzung 'dzin gyi rnam pa don la shes pa'i ngo bor rdzas gcig kyang tha snyad du gzung 'dzin tha dad 'dod pa dgag pa yin gyi rnam med pa'i lugs ma yin te de gong gi tshig don dang 'og gi mjug bsdus la brtags na shes pa'i phyir ro// gsum pa gang tshe 'khrul pa'ang yod min na sogs

(51) kyi rnal ma'i lan gyis mjug bsdu ba'i phyir/ dpe 1$0000300ji ltar 1$0000270na khyed kyi lugs la gzugs sgra sogs yul 1$0000300sgyu ma 1$0000270la 1$0000300bden 1$0000270pa'i dngos por yod pa 1$0000300min yang*// blta bya1$0000270ra 'os pa khas blangs pa 1$0000300de bzhin 1$0000270du nged kyi lugs la'ang 1$0000300lta byed 1$0000270kyi 1$0000300yid 1$0000270kyang don dam par dngos po med pa sgyu ma lta bu yin du zin kyang*/ tha snyad tsam du gzugs sgra sogs mthong bar byed nus pa yin no// gnyis pa rnam brdzun pa'i rtsod spang la rtsod lan gnyis las/ dang po ni/ gzhan yang rnam pa gzhan gyis don dam par yod pa'i rnam par shes pa sgrub pa'i ched du smras pa/ 1$0000300gal te 1$0000270gzung 'dzin gyi bag chags 'khrul snang brdzun pa 1$0000300'khor ba dngos po1$0000270'i 1$0000300rten can 1$0000270yin la/ dngos po ni don dam pa gzung 'dzin gnyis med kyi sems yin no zhe na/ gnyis pa ni/ sems la brten pa la 'khor ba zhes brjod na/ 'khor ba de ci dngos po yin nam/ dngos po med pa yin/ dngos po yin na sems yin nam/ de las gzhan yin/ dang po ltar sems yin na 'khor ba de spang bya ma yin par 'gyur te sems don dam la yod pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa ltar sems las gzhan yin na grub pa'i mtha' las nyams par 'gyur ro// 'on (52) te dngos po med pa yin no zhe na/ shes pa bden grub la rnam pa brdzun pa 'byung na/ 1$0000300de ni 1$0000270don byed pa'i nus pa med pas dngos po las 1$0000300gzhan du 1$0000270dngos med nam 1$0000300mkha' 1$0000270dang 1$0000300'dra 1$0000270ba1$0000300ra 'gyur 1$0000270ro// de ltar dngos med yin yang yod pa'i dngos por 'gyur ba'i sems gsal rig la brten pas des don byed nus par 'gyur ro zhe na/

rten dang brten pa'i dngos po ni rgyu dang 'bras bu'i ngo bo yin pas 1$0000300dngos med 1$0000270kyi 'khor ba ni dngos po sems lta bu gang gis kyang 'bras bur mi rung ba'i phyir 1$0000300dngos 1$0000270po sems 1$0000300la brten pas na1$0000270// 'khor ba dngos med kyi don 1$0000300byed 1$0000270pa 1$0000300dang ldan par ji ltar 'gyur 1$0000270te dngos po mo gsham la brten nas dngos med kyi bu skye ba mi srid pa bzhin no// de bas na 1$0000300khyod kyi sems ni 1$0000270gzung 'dzin gyi 1$0000300grogs med par1$0000270// gnyis stong gi shes pa 1$0000300gcig pu nyid du 'gyur ba yin 1$0000270no// 'dir tha snyad kun rdzob tsam du'ang dpyad ngor bden pa'i sems las brdzun pa 'khor ba 'byung ba mi srid pas da lta sems can gyi gnas skabs su'ang 'khor ba'i 'khrul snang gtan med du thal/ 1$0000300gang 1$0000270gi 1$0000300tshe sems ni gzung 1$0000270'dzin dang 1$0000300bral ba 1$0000270gnyis su med pa'i rang bzhin yin la// 1$0000300de 1$0000270yi 1$0000300tshe 1$0000270sems can 1$0000300thams cad de bzhin gshegs 1$0000270 (53) par 'gyur la/ 1$0000300de ltar 1$0000270khas blangs pa yin 1$0000300na yang 1$0000270'khor 'das thams cad 1$0000300sems tsam du1$0000270// don la grub bo zhes grub mtha' ngan pa rtog pas 1$0000300brtags 1$0000270pa la 1$0000300yon tan ci zhig yod 1$0000270de// sems can thams cad kyi rgyud la 'dod chags la sogs pa yongs su gnas pa'i phyir ro// skabs kyi gnad don ni 'di yin te mu stegs bye brag smra ba rnams kyi rtag dngos las rtag dngos 'byung zhing don byed rung bar 'dod la/ de ni bye smras 'dus byas thams cad skye can du khas blangs nas rtag pa 'gyur med 'gog la 'dus byas thams cad rkyen bzhi las skye bar 'dod la 'dus ma byas rtag dngos brtags 'gog dang brtags min nam mkha' gsum gyis zag bcas thams cad dang ma 'ongs pa'i 'dus byas thams cad 'gog pa dang thogs bcas thams cad go 'byed pa'i bya ba byed par 'dod la/

mdo sde pas rtag dngos gzhi mthun mi 'dod la/ 'dus byas bem shes thams cad dus gsum rdzas su mi grub/ da lta dngos po bden grub kyis skad cig mas don byed nus pa 'dod cing*/ sems tsam pas kyang rtag dngos mi 'dod pa mdo sde pa dang mtshungs la/ phyi (54) don mi 'dod cing sems skad cig cha med dngos po snga ma las phyi ma 'byung bas dngos po kho nas tha snyad du don byed nus par 'dod la rnam med pa'i 'dod pa ni gnyis med kyi shes pa don dam pa/ de la brten nas mkhar gzhong na skra shad snang ba ltar dngos med 'khor ba 'khrul snang 'byung bar 'dod do// dbu ma pas tha snyad du gnas lugs gsal stong zung 'jug rten 'brel sgyu ma lta bu brdzun pa las brdzun pa 'byung bar 'dod de/ ji ltar ston pa'i sprul pa ni/ rdzu 'phrul phun tshogs kyis sprul zhing sogs gsungs pa ltar ro// des na rtag dngos las rtag dngos dang*/ bden dngos las bden dngos dang*/ bden dngos las brdzun pa 'byung ba bcas/ dang po gsum mi 'thad cing*/ dbu ma ltar rten 'brel sgyu ma lta bu las 'byung ba tha snyad du 'thad la/ des na rnam med pa ltar rnam shes bden pa las 'khor ba gzung 'dzin gyi bag chags bden med 'byung ba tha snyad du'ang mi 'thad do// de'ang grangs can pas/ snang ba('i )lam du gang gyur pa// sgyu ma bzhin du shin tu gsog /zhes 'dod kyang gtso bo'i rnam 'gyur nyid yin cing*/ don dam gtso (55) bo'i rang bzhin gcig tu 'dod la/ bye mdo'i cha med don dam dang rags pa kun rdzob tu 'dod kyang cha med nyid rags par snang gi cha med min pa'i rags pa gzhan mi srid la/ rnam bden pa'i gzung 'dzin tha dad du snang ba brdzun par 'dod kyang gzung 'dzin gyi rnam pa shes pa'i ngo bo rdzas grub 'dod pas don kun rdzob kyi snang ba brdzun par gsungs kyang bden grub las ma 'das so// rnam brdzun pas snang gzhi mkhar gzhong lta bu sems bden pa dang*/

de la gzung 'dzin gyi bag chags snang ba skra shad ltar brdzun par 'dod pas dngos snang 'khor ba de dngos med rdzun par 'dod pas rnam bden pa dang khyad par che'o// mdor na don dam par chos thams cad bya byed grol bas cha med gnyis kyis kyang don byed pa mi srid pas bye smra nas dbu ma'i bar gyi bden gnyis mtshan nyid gcig go /gnyis pa lam tshogs gnyis la brten nas 'bras bu sku gnyis zung 'jug mngon du byed tshul bye brag tu bshad pa la lam tshogs gnyis zung 'jug dngos dang*/ de la dngos smra ba'i rtsod pa spang ba'o// dang po la rtsod pa'i sgo nas gzhung snga phyi mtshams sbyar ba/ lan gyi sgo nas lam

(56) bgrod tshul zhib tu bshad pa gnyis las/ dang po ni/ ci ste khyed dbu ma smra ba la yang mtshungs pa yin pas nyid du brjod pa'i phyir smras pa/ 1$0000300sgyu ma lta bur shes 1$0000270par gyur 1$0000300na yang*/ ji ltar 1$0000270'dod chags la sogs pa'i 1$0000300nyon mongs pa ldog 1$0000270par 1$0000300'gyur te1$0000270// 'thad pa ni 1$0000300gang 1$0000270gi 1$0000300tshe sgyu ma'i bud med la/ de byed 1$0000270pa po sgyu ma'i mkhan po 1$0000300nyid kyang chags 1$0000270pa 1$0000300skye 1$0000270bar 1$0000300'gyur 1$0000270ro zhe na/ gnyis pa la gnyis/ slob lam tshogs gnyis zung 'jug bshad pa dang*/ mi slob lam sku gnyis zung 'jug bshad pa'o// dang po la lam gol dman lam sngon song dang*/ theg chen lam dngos bshad pa gnyis las dang po ni/ de la lan ni/ sgyu ma'i bud med 1$0000300de byed pa 1$0000270po sgyu ma mkhan 1$0000300ni 1$0000270sgyu ma kho na rang rig mngon sum gyi bden med tsam rtogs kyi 1$0000300shes bya 1$0000270thams cad 1$0000300la// nyon mongs 1$0000270bden 'dzin dang de'i 1$0000300bag chags 1$0000270rnal 'byor mngon sum gyis 1$0000300ma spang pa// des na 1$0000270bud med 1$0000300de mthong ba na 1$0000270mthong ba po 1$0000300de// stong 1$0000270pa 1$0000300nyid 1$0000270kyi 1$0000300bag chags 1$0000270de goms pa 1$0000300nyams chung 1$0000270ba 1$0000300nyid 1$0000270kyis dngos po'i bag chags de stobs dang ldan pa yin no// 'o na lam la gtan ma zhugs pa sgyu ma mkhan (57) sogs kyi rmi lam sgyu ma sogs rang rig gis bden med rtogs pa de kun rdzob tsam dang kun rdzob bden pa gang yin zhe na/ kun rdzob tsam btags pa ba dang*/ kun rdzob bden pa mtshan nyid pa yin te rnal mngon gyis bden 'dzin gyi sa bon ma spang ba'i phyir ro// 'o na ji ltar de bzlog par 'gyur zhe na/

nyan rang gi lam la zhugs te gang zag dang chos kyi bdag med sgom ste 1$0000300stong nyid 1$0000270kyis bzhag pa'i 1$0000300bag chags goms pas ni1$0000270// me dang nye bar gyur ba'i grang ba'i reg pa bzhin du 1$0000300dngos po 1$0000270mtha' dag la bden par 'dzin cing zhen pa1$0000300'i bag chags spang 1$0000270bar 1$0000300'gyur zhing 1$0000270// drung nas 'byin par byed do// 'dis ni nyan thos dang rang rgyal gnyis dman lam la zhugs nas lam bgrod tshul tshig nyung la don rgyas par bstan pa ste/ dngos po bden 'dzin gyi bag chags drung nas 'byin pa ni 'phags lam las gzhan mi srid pa'i phyir/ mngon rtogs rgyan las/ nyan thos zhi ba tshol rnams kun shes nyid kyis nyer zhir khrid mdzad gang yin dang*// zhes pa ltar ro// 'di'ang bden 'dzin mtha' dag drung nas 'byin cing bden stong la mtha' gcig tu 'dzin pa las ma (58) 'das pas nyan rang gi lta ba mthar thug pa med dgag rang mtshan pa yin no// de la theg dman nyan rang dgra bcom la mnyam rjes kun tu bden 'dzin gtan med kyang nyan thos mnyam bzhag yul yul can stong 'dzin dang rang rgyal shes pa gsal rig tsam 'dzin pa tshogs sbyor nas dgra bcom bar rtogs pa mchog dman yod kyi rtogs rigs tha dad med pas mnyam bzhag gi lta ba mchog dman rjes thob kyi yon tan las dpag dgos so// theg chen yang de dang mtshungs pa 'og tu 'chad do// gnyis pa mos spyod pa'i lam dang*/ 'phags lam gnyis las/ dang po ni/ dngos po la mngon par zhen pa'am/ stong nyid bden med la mngon par zhen pa dag gnyi ga rtog pa las ma 'das pa khyad par med pa yin no zhe na/ dngos po dang dngos med dam bden pa dang bden pa med pa'i rang bzhin 1$0000300ci yang med ces 1$0000270mtha' bzhi rim gyis 'gog pa'i theg chen dbu ma'i dpyad sgom med dgag tsam po ba la yang yang 1$0000300goms 1$0000270par byas 1$0000300pas ni1$0000270// nyan rang lta bu rang bzhin med par mtha' gcig tu 'dzin pa'i blo 1$0000300de yang 1$0000270mtha' bral dbu ma'i lta ba rang rig ngo 'phrod cing 'jog sgom gyi gnas skabs na chu brgal zin pa'i

(59) gzings dang 'dra bar 1$0000300phyis 1$0000270theg chen tshogs lam 1$0000300nas 1$0000270zhugs te theg pa chen po'i stong nyid mngon du byed pa na 1$0000300spang bar 'gyur 1$0000270te/ nyan rang gi lta ba med dgag bden med du mtha' gcig tu 'dzin pa de'ang yod med sogs ci'ang min zhes spros pa rim gyis 'gog pas spros bral ji lta ba bzhin go nas 'jog sgom skabs rang rig mngon sum gyi spros bral ji lta ba bzhin sprin bar gyi nyi ma ltar rtogs pa na med dgag mtha' gcig tu 'dzin pa de'ang spang zhes pa'i don to// des na dman lam sngon song ba la theg chen gyi lam shes skye ba'i khyab te mngon rgyan las/ yul nges pa dang khyab pa dang*// zhes so// de yang phyi nas spong bar 'gyur zhes pa'i don nyan rang gi lhag med de grub mtha' 'og ma gsum dang nyan rang gis mthar thug tu 'dzin pa ni drang don yin pas de dus phyis su theg chen la 'jug dgos so zhes bstan pa yin la/ snga ma dag 'du shes med pa'i snyoms 'jug bzhin zhes 'og tu 'byung ba rang rgyud kyi gtan tshigs su bzung nas mthar thug theg pa gcig tu sgrub pa ni thal 'gyur gtan tshigs dang rang rgyud nor ba ste 'og tu rgyas par 'chad do// de ni dman lam sngon song (60) ltar yin la cig char ba theg chen gyi dbang du byas na bden med du 'dzin pa'i spros pa cig char gcod pas bden pa'i spros bral dang po rtogs nas phyis bden med spros bral rim gyis rtogs mi dgos te dbang rnon cig char ba yin pa'i phyir/ ji skad du/ kun rtog thams cad spang bya'i phyir// stong nyid bdud rtsi ston mdzad la// gang zhig de la zhen gyur na// de nyid khyed kyis shin tu smad// ces gsungs pas so// dman lam sngon song gi byang sems tshogs sbyor lam pa'i rjes thob tu stong nyid kyi stobs kyis dngos por bden 'dzin gyi bag chags ldog tu chug na'ang sa thob 'phags pa'i rjes thob na med 'dzin de la 'gog pa med pa'i phyir dang dman lam sngon du ma song ba la rjes thob tu dngos po med pa'i bden pa'am bden med la mtha' gang rung gcig tu mngon par zhen pa gang gis ldog par byed ce na/

gnyis pa ni/ sa thob 'phags pa'i rjes thob 1$0000300gang 1$0000270gi 1$0000300tshe 1$0000270bden pa'i dngos po 1$0000300gang zhig med do zhes1$0000270// dngos stobs kyis rigs pas 'gog par byas nas ji ltar gnas pa bzhin mnyam bzhag na rnal 'byor gyis chos nyid mngon (61) sum du mthong ba na rab rib can gyi skra'i dog pa ltar 1$0000300brtag 1$0000270cing dpyad par 1$0000300bya 1$0000270ba1$0000300'i dngos po 1$0000270rigs pa'i dpyad bzod du grub pa rjes thob tu 1$0000300mi dmigs pa1$0000270// 1$0000300de 1$0000270yi 1$0000300tshe dngos 1$0000270po 1$0000300med 1$0000270pa la bden pa'am bden med mtha' gcig tu 'dzin pa'i 1$0000300rten 1$0000270dngos po dang 1$0000300bral ba 1$0000270des na/ rjes thob kyi 1$0000300blo yi mdun na 1$0000270rten dngos po med pas dngos med de 1$0000300ji ltar gnas 1$0000270te gnas pa med do// sa thob 'phags pa'i rjes thob tu spros bral la nges shes drangs pa'i phyir dang*/ dngos med phan tshun rnam par bzhag 'jog gi rgyu 'bras yin pa'i phyir/ 'jug pa las/ phan tshun don la brten pa'i grub pa ni// grub min nyid ces dam pa rnams kyis gsungs// zhes so// 'di mnyam bzhag yin par rlom na 'khrul te brtag bya'i dngos po mi dmigs pa// zhes dang*/ blo yi mdun na ji ltar gnas// zhes gsungs pa rjes thob la dgongs shing byang 'phags mnyam bzhag na dpyad pa dang blo yod na ha cang thal ba'i phyir 'og gi gang tshe dngos dang sogs kyang sangs rgyas 'phags pa'i mnyam rjes dbyer med dang sa thob 'phags pa'i mnyam rjes res mos kyi don te/ 'jug pa las rgyu 'bras kyi sa bcu gcig bshad pa yang rjes thob la (62) dgongs kyi mnyam bzhag la dbye ba med pa'i phyir/ sa bcu pa las/ ji ltar bar snang bya rjes mkhas rnams kyis// brjod par nus ma yin zhing mi mthong ltar// de bzhin byang chub sems dpa'i sa kun kyang*// brjod mi nus na nyan pa ga la nus// zhes so// der ma zad byang sems tshogs sbyor mnyam bzhag tu rang rig ngo 'phrod pa nas sangs rgyas kyi sa yi bar glo bur dri bral gyi chos nyid mthong rgya che chung tsam las dbye ba mi nus pas sa gong 'og gi khyad par rjes thob yon tan che chung las dpog dgos pa'i phyir ro// nyan rang dgra bcom pas chos thams cad bden med rtogs pa dang byang 'phags kyis rjes thob tu chos thams cad bden med rtogs pa'i khyad par ci zhe na/

spros bral dang med dgag nges shes kyi khyad par bshad ma thag pa ltar dang*/ nyan rang gi chos thams cad bden med rtogs pa don gyi gnas lugs su mtha' gcig tu 'dzin cing skyon du mi 'dzin la/ byang 'phags kyis lam sgom pa'i nus pa ma rdzogs pas re zhig rjes thob tu spang ma nus pa yin pas 'dzin pa thams cad kun rdzob tsam du 'dzin la/ der ma zad byang sems so skyes kyis kyang 'dzin pa mtha' dag spong ma nus kyang thams cad skyon du go bas khyad par shin tu che'o// (63) de yang don bsdu ba ni dngos por bden pa mngon par zhen pa ni dman lam skabs chos thams cad stong pa nyid du goms pas spang bar brjod la/ stong pa nyid kyi zhen pa de yang spros pa mtha' dag dang bral ba'i sa nyid mngon du byed pa las spang bar 'gyur ro// gnyis pa la/ don dam chos sku mngon du mdzad tshul/ gzhan don kun rdzob tu gzugs sku snang tshul gnyis las/ dang po ni/ de ltar rnam par rtog pa thams cad chos kyi dbyings su nub pas sgrib pa gnyis mtha' dag las grol bar 'gyur ro zhes bshad pa sangs rgyas pa 1$0000300gang 1$0000270gi 1$0000300tshe dngos 1$0000270po 1$0000300dang dngos 1$0000270po 1$0000300med 1$0000270pa'i rang bzhin 1$0000300dag /blo yi mdun na mi gnas pa// de1$0000270'i 1$0000300tshe 1$0000270dgag sgrub kyi 1$0000300rnam pa gzhan med pas// dmigs pa med pa 1$0000270nyid dang rnam par rtog pa thams cad 1$0000300rab tu zhi 1$0000270ba ste mnyam rjes dbyer med pa yin no// gnyis pa la rnam par mi rtog bzhin du gzugs sku snang tshul/ 'bad rtsol med bzhin phrin las rgyun mi chad par 'byung tshul gnyis las dang po ni/ de ltar rnam rtog med na bcom ldan 'das kyis gzhan gyi don rdzogs pa ji ltar mdzad snyam pa la bshad pa/ bsam pa'i 'bras bu ster ba'i 1$0000300yid bzhin 1$0000270gyi 1$0000300nor bu 1$0000270dang 1$0000300dpag

(64) bsam 1$0000270gyi 1$0000300shing 1$0000270la rnam par rtog pa med kyang bsod nams che chung gi snod 1$0000300ji lta1$0000270 ba1$0000300ra re ba yongs 1$0000270su 1$0000300bskang ba/ de bzhin 1$0000270du 1$0000300gdul bya1$0000270ra dmigs nas sngon byang chub sems dpa'i gnas skabs na btab pa'i 1$0000300smon lam gyi/ dbang 1$0000270dang gdul byar rang rang gi dad pa'i rkyen gyi dbang 1$0000300gis 1$0000270skyes bu chen po'i mtshan dpe dang ldan pa'i 1$0000300rgyal ba'i 1$0000270longs sprul gyi 1$0000300skur snang ngo 1$0000270// 'di'ang rnam rtog med pa'i dpe rung gi mkhyen cha med par bstan pa ga la yin/ gnyis pa ni/ 'o na 'bad rtsol med par rgyun mi chad par 'byung mi rigs snyam na/ 1$0000300dper na nam mkha' lding gi 1$0000270rig sngags grub pas 1$0000300ni1$0000270/ rdo ba la sogs dngos po la 1$0000300mchod sdong bsgrubs nas 1$0000270mkha' lding grub pa de 1$0000300'das 1$0000270par 1$0000300gyur pa 1$0000270na// 1$0000300de 'das 1$0000270nas 1$0000300yun ring lon yang de1$0000270'i mthus// 1$0000300dug 1$0000270dang gdon 1$0000300la sogs pa zhi 1$0000270bar 1$0000300byed pa 1$0000270bzhin// 1$0000300byang chub 1$0000270thob pa'i phyir 1$0000300spyod 1$0000270pa rgya mtsho lta bu la bslab pa'i 1$0000300rjes su mthun par 1$0000270de'i 'bras bu 1$0000300rgyal ba'i 1$0000270sku gsum gyi 1$0000300mchod sdong bsgrub pa 1$0000270de 1$0000300yang*/ byang chub sems dpa'i 1$0000270mi gnas pa'i 1$0000300mya ngan las/ 'das 1$0000270par gyur te 'khor 'das ro mnyam mngon sum rtogs nas rnam rtog dang 'bad rtsol med (65) 1$0000300kyang 1$0000270gdul bya'i 1$0000300don rnams thams cad 1$0000270yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyis rtag khyab lhun grub tu 1$0000300mdzad 1$0000270do// sgyu ma'i sprul pas sgyu ma'i sngags sogs bshig pa med pa dang mtshungs she na/

sangs rgyas kyi sprul pa dang gtan mi mtshungs te/ sangs rgyas kyi mdzad pa bsam gyi mi khyab pa'i phyir ro// rgyas par rgyud bla las shes so// 'o na ye shes kyis shes bya ji ltar mkhyen zhe na/ ma dag pa'i 'khrul snang ni gzhung lugs chen po rnams las ldog par gsungs te/ 'jug pa las/ 'di na ji ltar sad bzhin de srid du// ma sad de srid de la gsum char yod// sad par gyur na gsum char yod min ltar// gti mug gnyid sad las de de bzhin no// zhes dang*/ ji ltar rmi lam bu shi la// de med snyam pa'i rnam rtog ni// de yod rnam par rtog pa yi// gegs yin de yang brdzun pa yin// zhes dang*/ de ltar stong pa'i dngos rnams la// thob pa ci yod shor ci yod// thams cad nam mkha' 'dra ba yi// bdag 'dra'i yongs su shes par gyis// zhes dang*/ mdo rgyan las/ gang zhig yod pa mi mthong med mthong ba// 'di 'dra'i mug nag rnam pa de gang zhig /ces dang*/ de phyir thar pa nor tsam zad (66) pa yin// zhes dang*/ mdo las/ rtag tu skye med chos de de bzhin gshegs// chos rnams thams cad bde bar gshegs dang 'dra// byis pa'i blo can mtshan mar 'dzin pa rnams// 'jig rten dag na med pa'i chos la spyod// ces sogs mdo dang bstan bcos rnams las mang du gsungs pa rnams kyis ni rang don chos sku mngon sum du rtogs pa'i tshe 'khrul snang mtha' dag zad de/ shes bya'i bud shing skam po ma lus pa// bsreg pas zhi ste rgyal rnams chos sku ste// de tshe skye ba med cing 'gag pa med// sems 'gag pa de sku yis mngon sum mdzad// ces gsungs pa ltar/ chos can gyi 'khrul snang mtha' dag ldog par bzhed do// de ni don dam gyi dbang du byas la kun rdzob ltar na rgyan las/ srid dang zhi ba mnyam nyid dang*// zhes dang*/ rgyud bla ma las/ chos kyi sku las ma g.yos bzhin// sprul pa'i rang bzhin sna tshogs kyis// zhes dang*/

rtsa sher las/ 'khor ba mya ngan 'das pa las// khyad par cung zad yod ma yin// mya ngan 'das pa 'khor ba las// khyad par cung zad yod ma yin// zhes dang*/ yum las kyang*/ gzugs stong pa'o// stong pa nyid gzugs so// gzugs las kyang stong pa nyid gzhan ma yin no// stong

(67) pa nyid las kyang gzugs gzhan ma yin no// zhes sogs gsungs pa yang nges don ltar na gzugs sogs chos can kun brtags dang chos nyid yongs grub dbyer med bstan pas don snga ma dang khyad par gtan mi 'dug kyang tha snyad du zung 'jug gtsor ston 'khor 'das ro mnyam du mkhyen tshul rang snang sangs rgyas kyi dgongs pa gzhan gyis bsam gyis mi khyab ste/ rnam 'grel las/ mig sogs dang ni gzugs de ltar// gzung ba'i mtshan nyid dpyad pa 'di// ma dag blo can la yin gyi// rnal 'byor rtogs pa bsam mi khyab// ces dang*/ las tshul bsam gyis mi khyab ste// thams cad mkhyen pa kho nas mkhyen// zhes gsungs pas sangs rgyas kyis tha snyad du mkhyen tshul 'di shin tu 'thad de/ rigs gter rang 'grel las/ gnyid kyis gnon pa'i gang zag gis sad pa'i gnas skabs kyang dpog mi nus na/ tha mal pas gnas 'gyur gyi ye shes shes re kan gsungs pa ltar ro// dper na bzo las mi shes pa rnams kyis bzo mkhas pas byed zin 'bras bu yod byad rnams bzang ngan tsam blta shes kyis bzo lugs bsam gyis mi khyab pa ltar ro// yang gzhan snang chos can mkhyen tshul gtsor ston gyi dbang du byas (68) na sher phyin las rnam pa gang dag dang rtags mtshan ma sogs mkhyen pa dang 'jug par gzungs kyi dbang phyug rgyal po'i mdo'i rjes su 'brang nas/ stobs bcus shes bya mtha' dag mkhyen tshul rgyas par bstan pa dang*/ snying rje chen pos 'khor ba ma stong bar du 'khor ba'i phyi mtha' gzigs par yang bstan to// 'ga' zhig zla grags kyi lugs la sangs rgyas kyi ye shes mi bzhed pas rgyun chad rab tu mi gnas pa rlom pa srid na'ang mun sprul kho na ste/ dbu 'jug rtsa 'grel tshar gcig tsam tshang bar bklags kyang ma nus par zad do// gzhan snang mkhyen tshul 'di'ang*/ sems can gyi ngor sangs rgyas rang la mkhyen pa de ltar 'dug snyam pa lta bu rang snang dang*/

bdag la de ltar gsungs byung snyam pa lta bu gzhan snang gnyis go dgos la/ mkhyen pa mngon sum dang rjes dpag gnyis las rjes dpag 'khor ba'i rtog pa sangs rgyas la mi srid pas mngon sum tshad ma kho nar zad de/ rnam kun mkhyen nyid ye shes ni// mngon sum mtshan nyid can du 'dod// ces gsungs pas so// rang snang du mngon sum gyis mkhyen tshul zung 'jug ltar chos chos can gnyis su med pa'i tshul gyis mkhyen pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa ltar 'thad de thams cad nges (69) don gyi mkhyen tshul lo// gzhan snang du gzungs kyi dbang phyug rgyal po'i mdo las gsungs pa ltar 'das pa dang ma 'ongs pa sogs chos can so sor ma 'dres pa ji lta ba bzhin mkhyen pa khas len te drang don gyi dbang du byas so// kha cig 'khrul snang 'di ji ltar snang bzhin mi mkhyen na thams cad mkhyen pa ma yin pa 'gyur bas dmyal ba sogs ngan song gi sdug bsngal dang lha mi sogs mtho ris kyi bde ba dang ldan pa 'dug snyam nas sems can gyi bde sdug thams cad ji lta ba bzhin mngon sum gyis mkhyen to snyam na/ 'di ni so skyes mig gis bur gzugs mthong ba'i tshe bu ram 'di mngar mo snyam pa dang*/ me 'bar ba mthong na me 'dir reg bya tsha 'o snyam pa 'di ni rgyu chos rjes dpag la mngon sum rlom nas thams cad mkhyen pa'i ye shes su sgro btags par zad de/ mngon sum gyi 'khor ba'i 'khrul snang zag bcas kyi bde sdug mtha' dag mngon sum mkhyen na mngon sum gyis myong dgos la de ltar na 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal mtha' dag ji lta ba bzhin sangs rgyas kyis myong dgos par thal ba bzlog tu med la/ 'khrul snang mi mkhyen na thams cad (70) mkhyen pa ma yin par 'gyur na/ rab rib can gyi nad zad pa na skra shad mi mthong bas mig dag pa'i gang zag long ba thal ba dang*/ sgyu ma'i 'khrul 'khor bshig pa na sgyu ma mi mthong ba'i gang zag dang*/

gnyid sad pa na rmi lam mi mthong ba sogs 'khrul shes can du thal ba bzlog tu med do// skyon med de skra shad mi mthong ba'i tshe mkhar gzhong dag par mthong ba'i phyir dang*/ sgyu ma med kyang dag pa'i snang ba 'byung ba'i phyir dang*/ rmi lam med kyang sad pa'i snang ba 'byung ba'i phyir snyam na/ 'o na 'khrul snang mi mkhyen pa ni thams cad mkhyen pa sgrub byed rnam dag ste 'khrul snang mthong ba po ni 'khor ba'i sems can yin la/ ma 'khrul ba'i gnas lugs mthong ba po thams cad mkhyen pa yin pa'i phyir ro// des na dpal ldan grags pa'i dgongs pa de bzhin du/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i mkhyen pa bsam gyis mi khyab par mi 'dod cing so skyes ji lta ba bzhin du 'khrul snang mkhyen dgos par 'dod pa ni gyi na tsam ste/ thams cad mkhyen pa'i las tshul dang*/ las dang las kyis 'bras bu dang*/ sngags dang sman gyi nus pa rnams sangs rgyas ma gtogs gzhan gyis gnas gyur gyi ye shes bsam gyis mi (71) khyab pa la blo kha gtan nas ma phyogs pas tha snyad kyi gnas tshul yang ma mthong bar zad do// yang 'ga' zhig dbu ma rang rgyud ltar na sangs rgyas rang snang la kun rdzob kyi snang ba gzung 'dzin tha dad par mngon sum du mkhyen kyang tha dad du mi 'dzin pas/ mnyam bzhag snang bcas zhal gyis bzhes pas thal rang gi khyad par mnyam bzhag snang bcas snang med kyis 'dod pa srid na'ang*/ rang rgyud pa'i 'dod tshul drang nges ma phyed par zad do// sangs rgyas thams cad mkhyen pa tha snyad du zhal gyis bzhes lugs thal rang khyad par med la/ rang rgyud pas sangs rgyas snang bcas zhal gyis bzhes pa yang gzhan snang kun rdzob tsam yin la/ don dam mthar thug gi sangs rgyas chos nyid spros bral kho na zhal gyis bzhes pa la thal rang khyad par med pa'i phyir ro// des na rong ston chen po sogs rang rgyud pa'i mkhas pa chen po'i gsung rab la zhib tu brtag na shes so// theg chen 'phags pa'i lta ba mthar thug skabs thal rang khyad par med de/

lta ba ngo sprad lugs dang lam sgom lugs rim gyis ba dang cig char ba'i khyad par tsam zad do// des na rang rgyud pa'i theg chen (72) gyi lam gyi gnas skabs su mnyam bzhag snang bcas gsungs pa yang thog mar lta ba gtan 'bebs skabs snang stong sgyu ma lta bu gtan la phab pa na stong nyid spros bral nam mkha' lta bu shugs kyis rtogs dgos pas snang stong sgyu ma lta bu sgom pa gtsor ston la dgongs kyi spros bral nam mkha' lta bu sgom rgyu med pa ga la yin/ thal 'gyur pas lta ba ngo sprod skabs spros bral nam mkha' lta bu dang po nas car phog tu ngo sprod pas spros bral sgom pa gtsor ston tsam yin gyi tha snyad tsam du snang stong sgyu ma lta bu mi sgom pa ga la yin/ gnyis pa de la dngos smra ba'i rtsod pa la spyi gzhung gnyis las/ dang po lam dang 'bras bu la rtsod spong go rim bzlog pa ni/ 'bras bu chos sku'i mjug thog tu rtsod pa ni stabs bde'i ched yin te rigs gter las/ mngon sum tshad 'bras kyi rjes su rjes dpag tshad 'bras bshad pa bzhin no// yang na brjod bya gtso che ba'am nyung ba sngon la bshad pa gzhung lugs spyi yi 'gros ltar dang po/ 'bras bu la rtsod pa spong ba ni/ brjod bya nyung ba sngon la blangs pa'i phyir ro// 'o na sngar gzhi'i skabs kyi rtsod spong dang 'di gnyis zlos par 'gyur zhe na/ mi zlos (73) te snga ma ni sangs rgyas bden par grub ma grub dang 'dir sangs rgyas la rnam rtog gam sems yod med kyi cha nas sems tsam man chad kyis spyir rtsod do// mthar sems yod med dang bden pa grub ma grub don gcig go /gnyis pa la/ bden stong rtog med kyi sangs rgyas la mchod pas bsod nams mi 'thad pa dang*/ stong nyid sgom pas rigs can gsum gyi lam bgrod tshul mi 'thad pa'i rtsod spong gnyis las dang po ni/ kun rdzob kyi 1$0000300sems 1$0000270dang sems las byung ba gang yang 1$0000300med pa1$0000270'i sangs rgyas de 1$0000300la mchod 1$0000270par 1$0000300byas pas/

ji ltar na 'bras bu 1$0000270dang 1$0000300ldan par 'gyur 1$0000270zhe na// 1$0000300gang 1$0000270gi 1$0000300phyir 1$0000270sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das 1$0000300bzhugs pa'am 1$0000270de 1$0000300mya ngan 1$0000270las 1$0000300'das 1$0000270pa'i ring bsrel la mchod pa gnyis kyi bsod nams 1$0000300mtshungs pa nyid du 1$0000270lung las 1$0000300bshad 1$0000270pa'i 1$0000300phyir ro1$0000270// kha cig dbu ma pa dag gis 'bras bu de kun rdzob dang*/ dngos smra ba lta bu la don dam par 'dod kyang rung 'dir dpyad pa btang snyoms su byas te/ sems med pa'i 1$0000300kun rdzob bam ni 1$0000270sems dang bcas pa 1$0000300de nyid du'ang rung ste de'i 'bras 1$0000270bu mnyam pa ni 1$0000300lung (74) las yin 1$0000270te// gang zhig bzhugs la mchod pa dang*// mi gnas mya ngan 'das pa la// sems ni mnyam par dang ba yi// bsod nams la ni khyad par med// ces pa la sogs pa gsungs so// 1$0000300dper na 1$0000270don dam par 1$0000300bden pa'i 1$0000270sems sems byung gi rnam rtog dang ldan pa'i 1$0000300sangs rgyas la 1$0000270mchod par byas pas// 1$0000300ji ltar 1$0000270bsod nams kyi 1$0000300'bras bur bcas pa 1$0000270khyed 'dod pa 1$0000300bzhin 1$0000270no// gnyis pa la spyi gzhung gnyis las dang po ni/ 'dir grub mtha' bzhi po'i lugs kyi 'phags bzhi'i lam bgrod tshul cung zad bshad na/ bye smras bden bzhi mi rtag sogs rnam pa bcu drug gi shes pa skad cig cha med dang gzung ba rdul phran cha med mnyam rjes gnyis kyi tshe na gzung 'dzin tha dad du rtogs nas 'phags bzhi rang rang gi lam bgrod par 'dod pas 'phags bzhi rtogs rigs gcig cing*/ mnyam bzhag na rtogs pa mchog dman tha dad de nyan thos dman rang rgyal 'bring po ste shes sgrib cung zad spong*/

theg chen gyis mi shes pa'i rgyu bzhi lta bu shes sgrib spong pas mchog tu 'dod pa ni mnyam rjes gnyis char yin la/ rjes thob skabs stong nyid gsum dang grangs med mthong*/ zhes pa ltar mchog dman 'dod la (75) khyad par du sangs rgyas kyi rjes thob shes bya thams cad mkhyen cing lhag med dbyings su 'phags pa gsum rig rgyun chad pa la khyad par mi 'dod do// lam bgrod tshul nyan thos chags bral sngon song dang rim gyis pa gnyis yod la thung mtha' tshe gnyis sam gsum dang*/ ring mtha' tshe rabs bco brgyad na dgra bcom 'thob la rang rgyal tshogs spyod phal cher nyan thos dang 'dra zhing 'phags pa rang rgyal tshogs spyod mi 'dod la/ bse ru'i rang rgyal bskal chen brgya tshogs lam na tshogs bsags nas sbyor lam stan thog gcig la mi slob lam rang nyid kyis tshe der slob dpon med pa mngon du mdzad de dper na sangs rgyas bzhin no// sangs rgyas ni bskal chen grangs med gsum du tshogs bsags nas sangs rgyas pa snga ma dang 'dra la ye shes kyi tshogs gsung rab thos bsam byed pa'i shes rab bo// 'o na byang 'phags dang rang rgyal rigs kyi slob lam la 'phags pa yod dam med ce na/ yod de/ mthong lam sdug bsngal chos bzod nas lam rjes shes bar skad cig bcu drug dang srid rtse sgom spang skor dgu spong ba'i bar chad med lam skad cig dgu rnam grol lam brgyad de bcu bdun bcas (76) skad cig sum cu rtsa gsum ni slob pa 'phags pa yin la/ skad cig sum cu rtsa bzhi pa mi slob lam de ma rdzogs par mnyam gzhag las ldang mi srid do// byang 'phags sam sangs rgyas kyang de dang 'dra la 'on kyang 'ga' zhig gis 'gog snyoms mngon du byed dgos pas mnyam bzhag las ldang bar 'dod la/ kha cig 'gog snyoms sgom mi dgos pas ldang ba med par 'dod do// 'di gnyis char chags bral sngon song yin pas bsam gtan bzhi pa rab mtha' la brten nas 'phags lam mngon du mdzad pa yin pas zhugs 'bras dang po gnyis mi 'dod la mtha' ma gnyis kyi rnam bzhag yod de/

mdo sde pa ltar na nyan rang bye smra dang 'dra ste rtogs rigs kyang rigs can gsum char gcig cing*/ khyad par ni khams gsum gyi sgom spong dgu dril nas spangs pa'i cig char ba dang rgyun zhugs dang phyir 'ong dang*/ phyir mi 'ong sngon song gi rang rgyal 'dod pa dang*/ theg chen 'phags pa la sa bcu'i rnam bzhag yod cing bskal pa grangs med gsum du tshogs bsags pa yang so skye dang 'phags lam gnyis char gyi tshe yin cing theg chen 'phags pa la chags bral sngon song gi rnam bzhag med do// sems tsam ltar na (77) nyan rang dang theg chen gyi lam bgrod tshul phal cher mdo sde pa dang 'dra la/ rtogs rigs nyan thos ni bye mdo dang 'dra la rang rgyal gyi khyad par ni rgyan las/ gzung don rtog pa spong phyir dang*// 'dzin pa mi spong phyir dang ni// rten gyi bse ru lta bu'i lam// zhes gsungs pa ltar/ rang rgyal gyi mnyam gzhag gzung ba rdul phran cha med la bden 'dzin spong zhing gzung ba des bzhag pa'i bag chags 'dzin rtog la bden 'dzin mi spong bar 'dod do// mnyam gzhag na'ang shes pa gsal shing rig pa la bden par 'dzin pa'i phyir ro// rang rgyal rjes thob tu gzung ba la btags 'dzin dang 'dzin pa la bden 'dzin yod cing*/ byang 'phags dang sangs rgyas 'phags pa'i mnyam gzhag na gzung 'dzin gnyis med kyi ye shes 'ba' zhig dang*/ byang 'phags rjes thob tu gzung 'dzin gnyis btags 'dzin rtog par 'dod do// sangs rgyas gnyis su snang yang gnyis su mi 'dzin par 'dod/ rang rgyud phal gyis 'di 'dra zer/ rang rgyud ltar na lam bgrod tshul phal cher sems tsam dang mthun cing*/ nyan thos kyi rtogs rigs sems tsam dang mthun la rang rgyal mnyam bzhag (78) skabs gzung ba rdul phran cha med du 'dzin pa spangs nas shes pa gsal rig la bden 'dzin dang bcas la rjes thob tu gzung ba la btags 'dzin dang rang gzhan gyi shes pa la bden 'dzin dang bcas pa ste/

'o na sems tsam dang khyad par ci zhe na/ rang rgyud pas don dam du myong ba gnyis med kyi shes pa mi 'dod pas mnyam bzhag gi 'dzin rtog shes pa bden grub tsam du 'dod kyi 'dzin rtog de (gzung 'dzin )gnyis med kyi shes pa'i steng gi bag chags la bden 'dzin mi 'dod pa ni khyad par ro// byang 'phags kyi mnyam gzhag chos nyid spros bral dang*/ rjes thob gzung 'dzin gnyis snang btags 'dzin rtog par 'dod la/ 'on kyang sems tsam dang rang rgyud gnyis kyis/ nyan thos kyi mnyam gzhag tu gzung 'dzin gnyis char la bden 'dzin dang rang rgyal gyi 'dzin pa blo rkyang pa la bden par 'dzin pa ni nyan rang blo stobs zhan pas de tsam las ma rtogs pa yin gyi/ gzung ba dang 'dzin pa don dam grub pa bye smra dang mdo sde pa ltar mi 'dod do// de'ang sems tsam pas gnyis med shes pa don dam 'dod kyang rang rgyal gyis 'dzin rtog la bden par gzung ba ni bag chags la bden par 'dzin pa yin pas 'dzin rtog kyang don gyi gnas lugs mi 'dod/ (79) rjes thob tu snang ba bden stong rtogs la theg chen gyi lam bgrod tshul 'og thal 'gyur dang mthun no// thal 'gyur ba la gangs can na 'dod pa du ma snang ste/ kun mkhyen klong chen pas yid bzhin mdzod las/ theg dman nyan rang dgra bcom 'thob pa la bye brag smra ba dang*/ mdo sde pa'i grub mtha' la brten nas lam nyams su len dgos pas mdo sde pa'i grub mtha' la brten nas dgra bcom thob pa rnams kyis bdag med gnyis rtogs la/ bye smra'i grub mtha' la brten nas dgra bcom thob pa rnams ni gang zag bdag med rkyang pas kyang grol bar gsungs shing theg chen gyis spros bral rtogs par 'dod do// theg chen pa'i rjes thob snang stong*/ theg dman dbang rtul gyi gang zag rkyang pa btags 'dzin dang chos bdag rdzas 'dzin dang*/ dbang rnon gyis bdag gnyis btags 'dzin no// de dag rang rgyal gyi rjes thob kyi 'khrul snang sems kho na dang nyan thos bden med shes par 'dod do// rje tsong kha pa chen po'i mnyam bzhag stong pa nam mkha' lta bu med dgag dang rjes thob tu chos thams cad bden stong sgyu ma lta bu rtogs pa ni 'phags pa bzhi char rtogs rigs gcig cing rtogs pa mchog dman du 'dod kyang nyan rang gi rtogs

(80) rigs dang bdag med rtogs tshul nges don du 'thad la kho rang gis kyang nges don du bzhed cing theg chen 'phags pa'i rtogs rigs re zhig pa'i drang don tsam du mngon la/ gsung rab gzhan du spros bral zhal gyis bzhed pa'i phyir ro// kun mkhyen go rams pas/ byams klu dgongs pa 'gal med du sgrub nas nyan rang gi bdag don gtso che bas bdag rgyud kyi phung po lnga char bden stong dang por sgom pas de ltar rtogs la rang rgyal gyis de'i steng du gzungs phung mtha' dag bden med rtogs pa ni/ gzung don rtog pa spang phyir dang*// zhes pa'i don yin la/ gang zag gzhan rgyud kyi rnam shes la bden 'dzin dang bcas pa ni/ 'dzin pa mi spong phyir dang ni// zhes pa'i don du 'dod la/ theg chen pas spros bral rtogs par bzhed do// gzhan thal 'gyur lugs cung zad mi 'dra ba snang yang phal cher rang rgyud lugs las ma 'das shing 'ga' zhig thal 'gyur du 'du ba'i phyir ro// go rams pas/ thal 'gyur la sbyar ba ma gtogs/ gzung don rtog pa spang phyir dang*// 'dzin pa mi spang phyir dang ni// zhes pa'i lung rang rgyud kho na ma gtogs sems tsam dang thal 'gyur la sbyar ba sogs mi snang ngo*// rang lugs ni nyan rang gis chos thams cad bden stong du rtogs la/ de yang zhib tu cung zad bshad (81) na/ sher phyin las/ nyan rang thun mong ba'i rnam pa bcu drug dang rang rgyal thun min gyi rnam pa bcu gcig bcas nyer bdun gsungs pa mtha' dag chos kyi bdag med kho na yin cing mdo dang bstan bcos gong 'og kun tu mi rtag sogs gsungs pa mtha' dag kyang bden stong du gsungs la mi rtag sogs bcu drug mngon pa'i gzhung las gsungs pa yang dgongs gzhi rjes thob nges pa drang tshul yin pas/ de'ang nyan thos kyis mnyam gzhag skabs stong pa'o snyam pa ni/ stong bdag med kyi rnam pa gnyis yin te/ gang zag gi bdag stong pa'i cha bdag med dang chos bdag gi stong pa'i cha nas stong pa ste ldog pa gnyis su phye'o// rang rgyal 'phags pa'i mnyam gzhag shes pa gsal rig tsam la 'dzin pa ni/

gang zag gi bdag 'dzin gtan min zhing chos kyi bdag 'dzin yin pas so// 'o na nyan thos kyi mnyam gzhag na chos dang gang zag gi bdag gnyis kyis stong la rang rgyal mnyam gzhag skabs chos bdag la bden med du 'dzin pa yod pa'i phyir nyan rang rtogs pa go log tu thal zhe na/ skyon med de nyan rang gnyis char mnyam gzhag na gang zag gi bdag 'dzin dngos gtan mi 'byung ba dang*/ chos bdag la bden par (82) mi 'dzin pa'i cha 'dra la/ rang rgyal gyis yul yul can tha dad med par shes pa gsal rig tsam du 'dzin pa ni gzung ba tha dad med pa'i 'dzin rtog rkyang pa yin pas chos bdag shin tu phra la/ nyan thos kyis stong pa yul dang stong 'dzin gyi blo gzung 'dzin tsam du snang ba ni gzung 'dzin ma spang pas rang rgyal gyi 'dzin rtog la ltos na chos bdag rags pa yin no// lhag ma rnam pa mi rtag sogs bcu bzhi ni rjes thob tu nges pa drang tshul kho na nges pas mnyam gzhag tu gtan mi 'byung la/ stong bdag med ni mnyam rjes gnyis char du 'byung bas/ mdor na mnyam gzhag tu stong bdag med kyis rnam pa gnyis su nges la rjes thob rnam pa bcu drug tu nges pa ni gdul bya 'khor du nye ba'i bsam pa la dgongs pa yin te/ dper na sher phyin las gzung 'dzin gyi rtog pa re la dgu re grangs nges pa dang 'dra'o// gzhi skabs nyer drug dang rnam rdzogs skabs nyer bdun sogs bshad pa de dag 'grel ba mkhan pos mngon pa dang sgo bstun nas bcu drug tu 'du bar mdzad do// des na nyan thos 'phags pa'i mnyam gzhag bye mdo nas rang rgyud man chad kyi 'dod pa ltar gyi chos can snang ba'i gzung 'dzin las ni 'das kyang*/ chos nyid stong pa'i gzung 'dzin las ma grol (83) bas yul can gyi blos stong sogs nges pa'i 'dzin pa dang bcas pa yin pas stong pa nam mkha' lta bu yul dang*/ stong pa'o snyam pa'i med dgag gi 'dzin stangs blo yin no// des na nyan thos 'phags pa'i mnyam gzhag stong pa med dgag gi gzung 'dzin dang bcas pa'o// rang rgyal 'phags pa'i mnyam gzhag chos can gyi gzung 'dzin las grol ba ma zad chos nyid stong pa'i gzung 'dzin las kyang grol bas stong pa'o snyam pa'i 'dzin stangs med la yul can blo gsal rig tsam gyi 'dzin stangs rkyang pa ste yul yul can tha dad du mi 'dzin no// 'o na sems tsam dang khyad par ci yod ce na/

sems tsam pas lta ba thos bsam gyis gtan la 'bebs pa na/ don la shes pa myong ba gnyis med bden grub tu zhen la de'i stobs kyis sems tsam pa kho rang gi lta ba la gnas bzhin pa'i gang zag la tshogs sbyor gyi lam mtshan nyid pa'ang skye mi srid na 'phags lam lta ci smros/ des na rang rgyal 'phags pa'i mnyam gzhag na 'khor rtsa bden 'dzin med de/ nyan rang gi thog mar thos bsam gyi lta bas gtan la phab pa na chos thams cad bden pa'i spros bral nam mkha' lta bu don dam dpyod pa'i rigs ngor gtan la phab cing*/ (84) bden 'dzin de rnams rags pa mgo non tsam rtags kyis dgag bya dang*/ nyan thos so skye dang 'phags pa mtha' dag gi lam gyis spang bya dang*/ byang sems so skyes dang mthong lam sdug bsngal chos bzod skad cig dang po'i lam gyis sa bon bcas spang bya yin la/ rang rgyal mnyam gzhag 'jog sgom skabs shes pa bden stong gsal rigs tsam du mnyam par bzhag pa'i phyir sems tsam rang rgyal 'dzin pa tsam gyi khyad par sems tsam pas gzung 'dzin gnyis med kyi shes pa don dam par 'dod la/ rang rgyal gyi rtogs pa ni 'dzin pa gsal rig tsam du snang ba yin gyi gzung 'dzin gnyis med kyi shes pa'i brda dang tha snyad gtan med la shes pa bden grub gtan mi 'dod pas des na khyad par shin tu che'o// byang sems 'phags pa'i mnyam gzhag ni bden pa'i spros bral tsam ma zad bden med du 'dzin pa tsam yang mi srid pas theg chen gyi lta ba ni spros pa mtha' dag dang bral ba yin no// des na nyan thos 'phags pa'i mnyam gzhag stong pa 'dzin pa'i spros bcas yin/ rang rgyal 'phags pa'i mnyam gzhag shes pa gsal rig 'dzin pa'i spros bcas/ 'phags pa 'og ma gsum gyi rjes thob thams cad gzung 'dzin du snang ba'i spros (85) bcas yin la/ sangs rgyas 'phags pa rjes thob spros bcas gzhan snang tsam du zad do// de thams cad bden pa'i spros bral min te bden grub yod med sogs mtha' gang du yang mi 'dzin no// gong gsal 'phags pa'i blo de dag gis bden med kyis yod med sogs gang rung 'dzin pa'i spros bcas 'dzin pa shin tu phra mo btso blag mkhan gyi dri ma phra ba ltar shin tu spang dka' ba theg pa chen po'i 'phags pa'i lam gyi spang bya mthar thug go

/'o na bden 'dzin gyi spros pa dang*/ bden med 'dzin pa'i spros pa gnyis la khyad par ci yod ce na/ dper na 'jig rten tha mal pa'i snang ba bag chags brten 'byung gi ngor bu skye shi gnyis ni bden 'dzin gyi spros pa/ rmi lam gyi bu skye shi gnyis sad pa'i snang ba la ltos na brdzun pa'i spros pa yin no// yang na rmi lam na rmi lam ngo ma shes pa'i tha mal pa'i rmi lam rmi bzhin pa na bden par 'dzin pa lta bu bden pa'i spros pa dang*/ so skye tha mal pa'i snang ba la bden par zhen pa ni bden pa'i spros pa yin la/ byang sems sbyor lam pa lta bu rmi lam la rmi lam du ngo shes pas rmi lam brdzun par 'dzin pa dang*/ sgyu ma mkhan gyi sgyu ma brdzun 'dzin pa sogs nyan rang (86) 'phags pa'i mnyam rjes thams cad dang byang 'phags kyis rjes thob kyi snang ba sgyu ma lta bu ni bden med 'dzin pa'i spros pa yin la de dag dang bral ba ni bden pa bden med kyi spros bral yin te/ 'jug pa las/ de blo la ltos gnyis char bden pa ste// don gsal mthong la gnyis ka'ang brdzun par 'dod// ces so// des na gzung don rtog pa spang sogs kyi don sems tsam dang dbu ma thal rang thams cad kyis khas len dgos kyang*/ dbu ma rang rgyud kho na la sbyor na drang don tsam gyi dgongs pa phyogs gcig tsam du zad de/ sher phyin mdo bstan bcos mtha' dag nges don mthar thug dbu ma thal 'gyur ltar 'thad pa'i phyir ro// gnyis pa la rtsod lan gnyis las/ dang po ni/ bye brag smra ba dang mdo sde pa rnams chos thams cad stong pa nyid du shes pas nyon shes kyi sgrib pa thams cad spong nas rigs can gsum gyi 'bras bu thob par mi bzod par/ de la skad cig bco lnga ni// ma mthong mthong phyir mthong ba'i lam// zhes pa ltar/ 'phags pa'i bden pa bzhi mthong ba dang bsgom pa ni rigs can gsum gyi 'bras bu thob pa de'i thabs su 'dod pas smras pa dang*/

'phags pa'i 1$0000300bden pa 1$0000270bzhi po sdug bsngal dang*/ kun 'byung dang*/ 'gog pa (87) dang*/ lam gyi mtshan nyid rnams 1$0000300mthong bas 1$0000270sdug bsngal las rnam par 1$0000300grol 1$0000270bar 1$0000300'gyur gyi// stong 1$0000270pa 1$0000300nyid 1$0000270de chos thams cad rang bzhin med pa 1$0000300mthong bas ci zhig bya 1$0000270zhe na// zhes pa bye mdo gtso bo rtsod la/ sems tsam rang rgyud thun mong du nyan rang gis bden pa mthong bas grol 'gyur gyi/ stong nyid mthong bas ci zhig zhes rtsod la/ sems tsam sangs rgyas kyi gnyis med shes pa bden pa mthong bas grol 'gyur gyi/ stong nyid mthong bas ci zhig bya zhes rtsod do// theg chen skabs rang rgyud pa'i rtsod pa med do// gnyis pa lan la lung dang*/ rigs pa gnyis/ dang po la lung drang pa dngos dang*/ zhar byung lung ma grub pa'i rtsod spong theg chen bkar bsgrub pa gnyis las/ dang po ni/ 1$0000300gang 1$0000270gi 1$0000300phyir 1$0000270shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i 1$0000300lung las 1$0000270stong pa nyid kyi rang bzhin gyi 1$0000300lam 'di ni// med par byang chub 1$0000270gsum po gang yang 1$0000300med par gsungs 1$0000270te/ yum bar ma las/ rab 'byor nyan thos kyi byang chub thob par 'dod pas kyang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di nyid la bslab par bya'o// rab 'byor rang sangs rgyas kyi byang chub thob par 'dod pas kyang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di (88) nyid la bslab par bya'o// rab 'byor bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub thob par 'dod pas kyang gzhung shes rab kyis pha rol tu phyin pa 'di nyid la bslab par bya'o// zhes rgya cher gsungs so// bye mdo la lung 'di drangs pa don med de de la theg chen ma grub pa'i phyir/ mu stegs byed la nang pa'i lung bzhin snyam na/

lung bye mdo kho na la min gyi rang rgyud man chad la drang dgos te/ nyan rang gis bdag med gnyis char rtogs pa'i lung yin pa'i phyir/ rang rgyud sems tsam gnyis la grub cing bye mdo gnyis la ma grub kyang mu stegs byed dang mi mtshungs te ston pa gcig yin pa'i phyir/ des na theg chen gyi lung sangs rgyas kyi bkar bsgrub pa zhar byung yin pa'ang gnad don du shes par bya'o// gnyis pa la grub par mtshungs pa dang*/ ma grub pa mtshungs pa gnyis las/ dang po ni/ theg pa chen po'i tshig 'di theg dman bye mdo gnyis kyis ma bzod nas 1$0000300gal te 1$0000270stong pa nyid du smra ba'i 1$0000300theg 1$0000270pa 1$0000300chen 1$0000270po sangs rgyas kyi bka' yin pa 1$0000300ma grub 1$0000270ste rang bzo yin pa'i phyir zhe 1$0000300na1$0000270// 'dir gzhan dang lan mtshungs pa'i sgo nas sun dbyung ba ni/ 1$0000300khyed kyi lung ni 1$0000270bcom ldan gyi bkar 1$0000300ji ltar grub 1$0000270ste theg chen bka' sgrub byed las tshad ma lhag pa (89) 'ga' zhig yod par ma mthong ngo*// rgyu mtshan 1$0000300gang 1$0000270gi 1$0000300phyir 1$0000270khyod dang kho bo cag 1$0000300gnyis ka la 1$0000270bdag gi lung 1$0000300'di 1$0000270lung nyid du 1$0000300grub 1$0000270la// khyod kyi lung ni de ltar ma yin no zhe na/ 1$0000300dang po 1$0000270ste khyod kyi lung de khas len pa'i sngon rol du grub mtha' la ma zhugs pa'am/ mu stegs byed kyi grub mtha' la gnas pa'i tshe 1$0000300khyod la 1$0000270theg dman 1$0000300'di 1$0000270lung du 1$0000300ma grub 1$0000270bo// gal te sangs rgyas kyi gsung rab nyid du bla ma dang slob ma brgyud pa las 'byung ba yin la/ de yang mdo sde la 'jug 'dul ba snang*/ chos nyid dang mi 'gal ba de sangs rgyas kyi bka' yin la/

gzhan theg chen ni bstan pa'i gtad rabs bdun lta bu bla slob brgyud pa dang sde snod gsum gyi rnam bzhag yod pa ma yin no zhe na/ 1$0000300rkyen 1$0000270te rgyu mtshan 1$0000300gang gis ni der yid ches 1$0000270pa'i rgyu mtshan bla slob kyi brgyud pa dang sde snod kyi rnam bzhag 1$0000300de ni theg 1$0000270pa 1$0000300chen 1$0000270po 1$0000300la yang mtshungs 1$0000270so// gnyis pa ni/ gal te yu bu cag rtsod pa dang bcas pa'i phyir de las gzhan pa gnyis la grub pa'i bdag nyid kyi lung ni blang bar bya ba yin la/ theg pa chen po ni de las bzlog pa yin no zhe na/ 1$0000300gzhan 1$0000270gang yang rung ba 1$0000300gnyis 1$0000270kyis 1$0000300'dod pas bden 1$0000270pa'i don yin 1$0000300na ni1$0000270/ (90) /1$0000300rig byed sogs kyang bden pa 1$0000270nyid du grub par 1$0000300'gyur 1$0000270te mu stegs byed gang yang rung ba du mas khas len pa'i phyir ro// gal te 1$0000300theg chen 1$0000270lung ma yin gyi 1$0000300rtsod 1$0000270pa dang 1$0000300bcas 1$0000270pa yin pa'i 1$0000300phyir 1$0000270dor bya yin no 1$0000300zhe na1$0000270// khyod kyi 1$0000300lung la 1$0000270khyod dang 1$0000300mu stegs pa rnams 1$0000270yang dag yin min du rtsod pa 1$0000300dang 1$0000270// khyod kyi khas blangs pa'i 1$0000300lung 1$0000270las nang sde 1$0000300gzhan 1$0000270pa rnams 1$0000300la yang rang 1$0000270gi sde pa las gyes pa rnams dang sde pa 1$0000300gzhan dag 1$0000270gis kyang*// 1$0000300rtsod 1$0000270pa dang 1$0000300bcas 1$0000270pa 1$0000300yin 1$0000270pa'i 1$0000300phyir dor byar 'gyur 1$0000270ro// de ltar lan dang sun 'byin pa mtshungs par brjod nas/

gnyis pa rigs pas dgag pa la/ rgyas par bshad pa dang*/ don bsdus nas stong nyid sgom par gdams pa'o// dang po la bden stong med dgag mngon sum du ma rtogs na dman 'bras kyang mi thob pa'i thal 'gyur dang*/ stong nyid spros bral rtogs na rang rgyud kyi gtan tshigs rjes 'gro'i sgo nas myang 'das chen po mngon sum mdzad pa'i tshul lo// dang po la bstan bshad bsdu gsum las/ dang po ni/ yang gzhan gyis khas blangs pa la khyad par gyi sgo nas sun 'byin pa brjod pa'i phyir bshad pa/ bcom ldan 'das kyi 1$0000300bstan 1$0000270pa'i 1$0000300rtsa 1$0000270ba 1$0000300dge slong nyid yin 1$0000270na// stong nyid ma yin pa'i bden

(91) pa bzhi mi rtag sogs mthong ba las nyon mongs spangs pa'i 1$0000300dge slong 1$0000270du gyur pa 1$0000300nyid kyang dka' bar gnas 1$0000270so// dge slong 'ba' zhig dka' ba ma yin par 1$0000300sems ni 1$0000270cha med la bden 'dzin gyi 1$0000300dmigs 1$0000270pa 1$0000300dang bcas 1$0000270pa 1$0000300rnams kyi 1$0000270lhag med 1$0000300mya ngan 1$0000270las 1$0000300'das pa'ang dka' bar gnas 1$0000270te/ mdor na/ dge slong nyid kyang dka' bar gnas// mya ngan 'das pa'ang dka' bar gnas// zhes pas nyan rang dgra bcom lhag bcas sogs dge slong yang thob mi srid cing*/ der ma zad lhag med kyi myang 'das thob pa'ang dka' bar gnas zhes bsdu tshig kyang 'ang gnyis 'byung ba ni theg dman gyi dgra bcom nyer zhi gnyis kyang mi thob na theg chen sangs rgyas kyang mi thob pa lta ci smos zhes pa'i don to// dper na mdzod la 'dun bzang gis yang sgra lhag brjod kyi rtsod spong grags pa'i bshes gnyen gyi 'grel bshad las/ lha sbyin la yang nor yod mchod sbyin la yang nor yod ces brjod pa de gnyis ma zad khyab 'jug bshes la yang nor yod ces gsum par gyur pa'i gang zag bsdu tshig yin zhes gsungs pa ltar bsdu tshig gsum yod na don tshan bzhi pa sogs bsdu sgra gzhung gi spyi 'grig yin pa ltar (92) bye mdo sems tsam bcas kyi lugs la rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyis kyang chos kyi bdag med ma rtogs kyang sangs rgya bar 'dod pa'i log rtog dgag dgos pa'i phyir/ des na 'og tu 'chad pa ltar theg chen gyi lta ba spros bral 'khor 'das mnyam nyid rtogs na theg chen 'phags par 'gyur bar rjes 'gro'i sgo nas bstan (pa )la skabs 'dir shugs kyis bstan to// 'o na gzugs stong pa'o// stong pa nyid gzugs so// gzugs las kyang stong pa nyid gzhan ma yin no// stong pa nyid las kyang gzugs gzhan ma yin no// zhes gsungs pas kyang sgra dag gis ci zhig bsdu zhe na/

chos can gzugs su gyur pa ni chos nyid stong pa nyid/ chos nyid stong pa nyid las chos can gzugs su snang ba yin no// 'o na chos chos can tha dad dam zhe na/ chos can gzugs las kyang chos nyid stong pa nyid gzhan ma yin la/ chos nyid stong pa nyid las kyang chos can gzugs gzhan ma yin no// 'o na chos chos can gcig gam zhe na/ de'ang min te gcig tha dad kyi spros pa dang bral ba'i phyir/ kyang sgra gnyis kyi gcig yin pa dgag pa shugs bstan to// de ni bsdu tshig gis dpe brjod tsam mo// des na bye smra'i dbang du byas na sangs rgyas longs sku mi 'dod pas (93) na rigs can gsum gyi dgra bcom thams cad lhag bcas lhag med gnyis las mi 'da' ba des na sher mdo lta bu chos thams cad stong nyid du ston cing thabs shes tshang la ma nor bar de sangs rgyas kyi bka' ma grub na bstan rtsa dpal rang byung gi bsnyen rdzogs ston pa sangs rgyas theg chen gyi don dam pa'i dge slong mi srid de dper na rgyu ma tshang ba'i 'bras bu bzhin/ theg chen gyi gzhung la ma brten na theg dman gyi mdo las theg chen pa'i lam tshang bar ma bstan pa'i phyir dang*/ theg dman gyi dbang du byas na dpal rang byung gi bsnyen rdzogs rang rgyal dang nyan thos lhag bcas don dam pa'i dge slong dang der ma zad tshur shog dang ston pa khas blangs dang gsol bzhis bsnyen rdzogs sogs sngon dang da chog la brten pa'i dge slong kun kyang mi 'thad pa thal/ chos 'khor bskor ba po sangs rgyas med pa'i phyir/ sher phyin mdo yi lung don rigs can gsum char gyis chos thams cad stong nyid ma rtogs na lhag med kyi myang 'das kyang dka' bar gnas te/ chos thams cad la sems ni bden 'dzin gyi dmigs pa dang bcas pa'i phyir/ mdo sde pa ltar na/ chos thams cad stong nyid ma rtogs na nyan rang dgra bcom sogs mi thob pa'i thal 'gyur (94) snga ma bye smra dang mtshungs shing stong nyid ma rtogs na theg chen gyi sangs rgyas kyang mi thob pa'i thal 'gyur kyang sgras shugs la bstan to// sems tsam pa dang rang rgyud gnyis la theg chen bka' sgrub mi dgos pas bstan rtsa dge slong med pa'i thal 'gyur yongs rdzogs mi dgos la/

bdag med gnyis ma rtogs na dngos bstan nyan rang dgra bcom mi thob pa'i thal 'gyur dgos la kyang sgras shugs bstan sangs rgyas mi thob pa'i thal 'gyur sems tsam pa la dgos kyang rang rgyud pa la mi dgos te sangs rgyas kyis chos nyid spros bral rtogs pa la thal rang khyad par med pa'i phyir ro// rang rgyud pa kha cig chos bdag phung po bden 'dzin gyi dmigs pa de'ang rags pas 'ching la phra bas mi 'ching ste glang chen sogs thag pas 'ching la spu nyag gis mi 'ching pa bzhin snyam na/ 'khor bar 'ching byed phyi rol na rang mtshan gyis grub pa zhig yod na de ltar bden mod/ 'di ni rigs pa ltar snang tsam ste/ thag pa 'ching ba ma nges te shig so sogs mi 'ching la/ spu nyag gis mi 'ching ba ma nges ste srog chags phra mo 'ching ba'i phyir/ mu stegs 'ga' zhig skra yi rtse mo brgyar zhig pa'i bdag phra mo khas len pa dang*/ 'ga' zhig (95) che ste mthe bong tsam chung ste yungs 'bru tsam dang*/ la la rang lus tsam/ 'ga' zhig nam mkha' lta bu/ la la'i ri rab bdag gi lus rtsi shing sogs ba spu chu mtsho rnams bshang gci khas len sogs du ma yod kyang*/ bdag lta can mu stegs byed lta log can rigs gcig tu bstan pa las yul che chung la bdag che chung bka' bstan bcos tshad ldan gang du 'dzin yul phra rags la bdag 'dzin che chung yang ma gsungs shing gal te de 'dra srid na 'khor ba rang mtshan pa'ang che chung du ma khas len dgos na ha cang thal lo// des na 'khor ba 'ching byed rang gi rnam rtog ste dper na ri dwags me yi brtul zhugs can me yis mi 'tshig la/ chu gnas kyi srog chags chus mi 'tshub cing gzhan 'ga' zhig mes 'tshig cing chus 'tshub ste/ dug rma bya la bdud rtsi 'gyur la/ 'o ma dug sbrul la dug 'gyur ba sogs/ mdor na chu phor gang la rigs drug gi mthong tshul du mar bshad pa ltar ro// des na sems tsam yan chad gzugs can phra rags gnyis bden grub rigs pas mi grub pas bye mdo'i lugs kyi rdul phran cha med don dam 'dzin pa dang*/

shes pa skad cig cha med sems tsam man chad kyis bden (96) 'dzin grub mtha'i log rtog de dag 'phags pa dgra bcom pa'i nyams myong dngos la sbyar ba ni/ dngos po'i gnas tshul dang*/ grub mtha'i log rtog shan ma phyed pa'i gtam du zad do// des na/ rnam rtog ma rig chen po ste// 'khor ba'i rgya mtshor ltung byed yin// mi rtog ting 'dzin la gnas na// mkha' bzhin sgrib pa med par spongs// zhes so// rang rgyud pa 'ga' zhig rdul lta bu phra mor bden par zhen na 'ching la mngon zhen med na mi 'ching bar 'dod pa dang*/ yang nyan rang dgra bcom pas chos thams cad bdag med rtogs na/ khams gsum 'khor ba la me'i 'obs dang dug sbrul gdug pa'i tshang srin po'i gling lta bu shin tu skrag par gsungs pa mi 'thad pa thal zhe na/ 'o na khyod 'dod pa'i nyan rang las kyang 'khor ba'i sems can tha mal pa de 'khor ba la shin tu skrag nas nges 'byung skye rigs par thal bden 'dzin shin tu rags pa'i phyir/ 'o na byang 'phags dang sangs rgyas gnyis kyang snga ma snga ma las phyi ma shin tu 'khor ba la skrag rigs pa thal/ nyan rang las byang 'phags dang sangs rgyas gnyis stong nyid rtogs tshul gong nas gong du khyad par du 'phags pa'i phyir zhe na/ 'dod de/ nyan rang 'phags pa'i nges 'byung (97) las byang sems 'phags pa'i nges 'byung shin tu che ste pha dpa' bo'i bu shul du lus pa ltar 'khor ba la 'jug par gsung pa ni/ pha rol po dgra bo la yon tan mthong ste dga' nas dgra nang mchong ste 'gro ba min gyi/ dgra la shin tu skyon mthong nas rang gi bu der snying rje skyes nas gnas der bzhag ma nus pa bzhin no// gnad don ni/ bden 'dzin gyi skrag pa ni tshor ba sdug bsngal rang mtshan pa yin la nyan rang dgra bcom dang byang 'phags rnams la de'i bag chags kyi skrag pa srid la sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das la bag chags kyang mi srid do// de'ang 'khor ba la skyon du mthong ba de la skyo ba ni nges 'byung yin la des drangs pa'i thugs rje ni sangs rgyas byang sems la yod cing skrag pa'i bag chags shin tu rags pa nyan rang dgra bcom la yod cing de yan chad sa bcu rgyun mtha' man chad la phra mo yod de/

sdug bsngal gyi bag chags yin pa gang zhig sangs rgyas la med de bag chags spangs zin pa'i phyir phrin las rtag khyab lhun grub tu 'byung ba'i gnad kyang 'di'o// nyan rang dgra bcom dang theg chen 'phags pa la nges 'byung gong nas gong du 'phags pa ni dper na smyon pa la/ smyo ma sangs ba'i (98) gang zag gis skyo shas snying rje skye ba bzhin no// rang rgyud man chad kyis nyan rang gis chos kyi bdag med ma rtogs pa dang*/ sems tsam man chad kyis rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyis chos bdag med par ma rtogs par 'dod pa ni nges don gyi lung dang dngos stobs kyi rigs pa dang 'gal lo// des na mu stegs byed gang gi bdag bcas kyi thar pa 'dod pa log rtog yin pa ltar rang rgyud man gyis chos bdag dang bcas thar lam kyang log rtog go /des na ji srid phung po'i 'dzin pa yod pa de srid du ngar 'dzin pa dang las dang de las byung ba'i skye ba la sogs pa yod pa yin no// rtsa sher dang dbu 'jug sogs las chos bdag mtha' bzhi skye ba 'gog pa dang*/ gang zag la rnam bdun shing rta'i rigs pas spyir shing rta tshig na bye brag yan lag mi tshig pa mi srid par bstan pa sogs dang*/ rtsa sher bden pa brtag pa'i rab byed stong nyid min na mchog gsum dang bden bzhi med pa'i thal 'gyur sogs stong nyid rtogs pa'i lung mtha' yas te/ gzhung rgyas pa mgo mjug tshang bar bltas na shes so// gnyis pa la lhag bcas dang lhag med kyi myang 'das mi 'thob pa'i thal ba rgyas bshad gnyis las/ dang po la cha med tsam la yang bden par 'dzin na sdug bsngal (99) rang mtshan pa myong dgos pa mngon sum gyis grub pa/ yang der bden par 'dzin na rgyu tshogs grangs tshang gi rtags kyis nyon mongs rang mtshan 'byung ba thal ba gnyis las dang po ni/ gal te bden bzhi mi rtag sogs mthong nas 1$0000300nyon mongs 1$0000270pa 1$0000300spangs pas grol 1$0000270bar 'gyur zhe1$0000300 na1$0000270/

'o na nyon mongs spangs ba rdor ting 1$0000300de'i// de ma thag tu 1$0000270rnam grol dgu pa'i skabs su grol ba 1$0000300der 'gyur ro1$0000270// de la the tshom ci zhig yod ce na/ 1$0000300nyon mongs 1$0000270pa 1$0000300med kyang 1$0000270khyed 'dod pa'i lhag bcas 'phags pa dgra bcom pa 1$0000300de dag la/ las kyi 1$0000270mtshan nyid kyi 1$0000300nus pa 1$0000270smin par 1$0000300mthong ba yin 1$0000270pas// de bas na nyon mongs pa spangs pa'i rjes la grol bar 'gyur ba ni ma yin no// chos kyi bdag med ma rtogs pa'i lugs la lhag bcas dgra bcom la bden 'dzin can gyi tshor ba yod pas sred pa rang mtshan pa yod pa thal ba brjod pa dngos bstan yin la/ shugs bstan la chos kyi bdag med rtogs par 'dod pa'i rang lugs ltar na rang rgyud kyi gtan tshigs su bstan pa yin pas nyan rang dgra bcom la bden 'dzin med pas sdug bsngal gyi sdug bsngal dang*/ 'gyur ba'i sdug (100) bsngal/ khyab pa 'du byed kyi sdug bsngal so skye bsam gtan bzhi pa nas srid rtse bar gyi bden 'dzin rags pa rtsa ba drung 'byin zin kyang 'di ltar 'du byed kyi sdug bsngal so skye la ltos na phra mo dang*/ byang 'phags la ltos na rags pa ldan la/ bden 'dzin min pas tshor ba'i bag chags la brten nas srid pa phra mo bag chags kyi tshul du 'byung bas na ma rig bag chags kyi sa/ zag med kyi las bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i 'chi 'pho ba/ yid kyi rang bzhin gyi lus dang bcas pa ni 'khor ba phra mo rmi lam ngo shes pas rmi lam nyams su myong ba dang sgyu ma shes pas sgyu ma myong ba bzhin phung lnga la nyan rang dgra bcom dang byang 'phags thams cad la 'dzin pa yod do// 'dir bag chags kyang sa bon kho na min te nyan rang dgra bcom dang byang 'phags kyis las nyon gyi bag chags mngon 'gyur dang*/ sa bon thams cad la bag chags zhes pa'i brda dang tha snyad zor yang ba'i dbang du byas so// de'ang rigs gcig kyang phra rags du mar shes dgos so// 'o na ma rig bag chags kyi sa gang zhe na/

bden 'dzin dang bcas pa'i chags sdang sogs ni nyon mongs can dngos dang*/ de'i bag chags bden med sgyu ma lta bu'i (101) chags sdang sogs nyon mongs dngos kyi bag chags dper na gla rtsi dngos phyung zin na'ang shog gu la gla rtsi'i dri bro ba ltar nyon mongs pa ma rig pa dang sred pa sogs kyi bag chags ni ma rig bag chags kyi sa'o// zag med kyi las ni bden 'dzin bcas pa'i dge mi dge lung ma bstan gsum ni zag bcas kyi las yin la de gsum nyan rang dgra bcom yan chad byang 'phags man chad 'phags pa 'og ma gsum gyi bden med sgyu ma lta bu bsags pa ni zag med kyi las so// zag med kyi las zhes bya ba gnyen po bdag med rtogs pa'i shes rab sogs zag pa med pa'i ye shes kyis 'phags lam phyi ma bskyed pa lta bu bsam na min te/ ma rig bag chags kyis lhan cig byed rkyen byas nas zag med kyi ye shes 'byung ba mi srid de mun pas lhan cig byed rkyen la brten te snang ba 'byung bar khas len na bzhad gad kyi gnas so// bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i 'chi 'pho ba ni dper na ma dag sprul sku'i zhing na ston pas mdzad pa bcu gnyis sogs kyi skye shi rang mtshan par snang ba dang*/ de'i 'khor so skye thams cad dang rgyun zhugs sogs 'phags pa 'ga' zhig gi skye shi (102) rang mtshan pa de 'dra med pa'i don to// mchog gi sprul sku'i dag pa'i zhing khams su 'dren pa 'od dpag med la gzhan snang gi skye shi rang mtshan pa med cing*/ bde ba can na nyan rang lhag med kyang 'gog pa las ldang nas brdzus te skye ba bzhes pa dang*/ longs sku'i zhing na ston pa longs spyod rdzogs sku gzhan snang du mi rtag pa skad cig ma tsam ma gtogs skye shi rang mtshan pa med la de'i 'khor du gtogs pa sa thob 'phags pa rnams la'ang skye shi rang mtshan med cing rang ngo na'ang 'dus byas mi rtag pa skye 'jig byed pa la bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i 'chi 'pho zhes bya'o// spyir sha khrag gdos bcas kyi lus ni 'dod lha mi dud 'gro yi dwags rnams kyi lus yin la/

dmyal ba dang bar srid dang rmi lam gyi lus yid lus yin par gsung yang snga ma dmyal ba'i yid lus dgongs pa gang yin dpyad dgos/ dwangs ma 'od lus bsam gtan bzhi dang*/ stong rig ting nge 'dzin gyi lus ni gzugs med khams pa dang nyan rang dgra bcom lhag med skabs dang byang 'phags sa bcu'i rgyun mtha'i bar ro// skabs 'dir yid kyi rang bzhin gyi lus ni nyan rang dgra bcom dang*/ byang 'phags kyi yid lus de'o// rdzogs pa'i

(103) sangs rgyas la ni gzhan snang du gzugs sku dbyibs dang kha dog ni rang snang 'dus byas kyi rgyu ba chad pas rdo rje'i sku yin no// de'ang ma rig bag chags kyi sa dang*/ zag med kyi las gnyis kun 'byung bden pa phra ba dang*/ bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i 'chi 'pho dang*/ yid kyi rang bzhin gyi lus gnyis sdug bden phra mo'o// bzhi brgya pa las/ mi rtag pa la nges par gnod// gang la gnod yod de bde min// zhes so// yang ma rig bag chags nyon mongs pa'i bdud dang*/ zag med kyi las lha bu'i bdud dang*/ bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i 'chi 'pho 'chi bdag dang*/ yid lus phung po'i bdud phra mo yin te/ chos thams cad bden stong du 'dzin pa'i rnam rtog phra mo yin pa'i phyir ro// phra ba'i rten 'brel bcu gnyis rtsir btub kyang rang gis dpyad na shes te/ mdor na so skye lam la zhugs ma zhugs thams cad dang*/ khyad par du nyan rang slob pa dang theg chen chos mchog man chad 'khor ba rags pa yin la/ nyan rang dgra bcom dang byang 'phags rgyun mtha' man chad la/ ser sna la sogs rnam rtog gang*// de ni nyon mongs sgrib par 'dod// 'khor gsum rnam par rtog (104) pa gang*// de ni shes bya'i sgrib par 'dod// ces gsungs pa'i bag chags bden med du 'dzin pa'i blo yod pa de 'khor ba phra mo yin cing*/ myang 'das mthar thug sangs rgyas nyag gcig ste/ rgyud bla ma las/ des na sangs rgyas ma thob par// mya ngan 'das pa mi 'thob ste// 'od dang 'od zer spangs nas ni// nyi ma lta bar mi nus bzhin// zhes so// nyan rang dgra bcom dang byang 'phags 'khor ba'i sems can min snyam pa thos pa chung ba gsar bu 'ga' re 'dug pas de rnams la phan tu re nas 'phros don cung zad bris pa'o// 'di dag rtsa ba'i dngos bstan rang rgyud 'dod cing theg gcig bsgrub pa nor te gong 'og kun tu legs par dpyad na shes so// gnyis pa ni/

1$0000300re zhig 1$0000270rtag pa dang gcig 'dzin gyi ma rig pa spangs pas yang srid 1$0000300nye 1$0000270ba1$0000300ra len 1$0000270pa'i 1$0000300sred pa ni// med ces 1$0000270bya la des na grol ba 1$0000300nges pa nyid 1$0000270du 'dod 1$0000300ce na1$0000270// de la brjod par bya ste gang gi phyir dngos po bden 'dzin gyi dmigs pa dang bcas pa'i lta ba dang ldan pa rnams la ma rig pa spangs pa ma yin te/ bden 'dzin de yod pas srid pa spangs pa yang yod pa ma yin pa'i phyir ro// gal te nyon mongs can (105) gyi sred pa spang ba yod du chug kyang nyon mongs pa dang mtshungs par mi ldan pa'i 1$0000300sred 1$0000270pa 1$0000300'di nyon mongs can min yang 1$0000270// nyon mongs can ma yin pa'i 1$0000300kun 1$0000270tu 1$0000300rmongs 1$0000270pa dgra bcom la mi shes pa'i rgyu bzhi yod pa khyod kyi 'dod pa 1$0000300de bzhin 1$0000270du khyod kyi rnal 'byor pa rnams la 1$0000300ci ste med 1$0000270de yod pa thal// gtan tshigs 'dis kyang sred pa spong bar mi nus te 1$0000300tshor ba'i rkyen gyis sred pa 1$0000270'byung ba 1$0000300yin 1$0000270pas// rgyu 1$0000300tshor ba 1$0000270la bden 'dzin nyams pa med par khyed ltar na dgra bcom pa 1$0000300de dag la yang yod 1$0000270do// 'di ni rgyu tshogs grangs tshang gi rang bzhin rtags thal 'gyur kho na ste/ bye smra'i lugs la ma rig gcig pu la nyon mongs can yin min gnyis su 'dod kyi sred pa sogs yin na nyon mongs can du khyab pa'i phyir ro// de la gang zag gi bdag dang chos bdag rags pa gong bu dang rtag 'dzin spongs pas rdul phran dang shes pa cha med tsam 'dzin pa la kha na ma tho ba med pa'i tshor ba yod na yang sred pa yod pa ma yin no zhe na/ cha med lta bu dngos po la bden pa mngon par zhen pa can la kha na ma tho ba med pa nyid kyang

(106) grub pa ma yin te kha na ma tho ba ni bden 'dzin no// 'o na bye smras chags sdang sogs nyon mongs can min pa mi 'dod pa ci phyir zhe na/ lhag bcas skabs nyan rang la mi shes pa'i rgyu nyon mongs can min pa'i ma rig pa yod pas shes bya thams cad mi mkhyen pa yin la sangs rgyas la de med pas thams cad mkhyen pa yin no// lhag med skabs mthar thug theg gsum du rig pa rgyun chad par 'dod pa'i phyir ro// de'i phyir gal te nyon mongs pa can ma yin pa'i mi shes pa yod kyang sred pa khas mi len pa de ltar na yang*/ chos thams cad stong pa nyid mthong ba dang bral bas bden 'dzin yod na sred pa rang mtshan pa yod pa rigs pa'i stobs kyis 'thob pa yin no// 'di la gangs can na 'chad tshul gsum snang ste/ gang zag rang rkya thub pa'i rdzas yod kyis drangs pa'i nyon mongs can min yang*/ gang zag ngo bo nyid kyis grub pa'i 'dzin stangs kyis drangs pa'i nyon mongs can min pa ma rig pa dang sred pa sogs ci ste med ces dang*/ 'ga' zhig gang zag gi bdag dang chos bdag rags pa gcig 'dzin gyi bdag 'dzin gyis drangs pa'i nyon mongs can min yang chos bdag spyir cha med (107) gnyis 'dzin gyi ma rig pa sogs ci ste med ces dang*/ yang 'ga' zhig gis 'khor bar dbang med du skye ba len pa'i rgyu nyon mongs can med kyang bdag rgyud kyis ma bsdus pa'i gzugs dang*/ gzhan rgyud kyis bsdus pa'i phung por bden 'dzin gyis drangs pa'i shes bya'i sgrib pa nyon mongs can min pa'i sred pa sogs ci ste med de yod dgos zhes pa gsum ni rang rgyud kyi gtan tshigs su bzhed do// lugs dang po ni mngon pa nas bshad pa'i nyon mongs 'jig rten pa'i bsam gzugs kyi ting 'dzin thob pa rnams kyis spangs pa dang spyir 'dra ba la mi rtag sogs bden pa'i rnam pa sgom tshul mngon pa nas 'byung ba ltar sgom pas 'dis ni srid rtse'i nyon mongs kyang spong ba'i cha nas 'jig rten zhi rags kyi rnam pa sgom pa'i 'bras bu las lhag cing 'phags pa'i gang zag dngos min te dbu mar bshad pa'i nyon mongs bden 'dzin spong ba'i gnyen po stong nyid ma sgom pas so// des na 'khor ba'i sems can rang mtshan pa min pa'i gang zag gsum pa zhig bzhed do// 'di shin tu bzhag dka' ste mkhas pa snga mas bkag zin to// lugs gnyis pa dang gsum pa brjod tshul

(108) tsam las don gcig pas/ nyan rang gi cha med gnyis bden med ma rtogs kyang cha med tsam rtogs na nyan rang dgra bcom mtshan nyid pa 'thob kyang ma rig bag chags sogs mi shes pa'i rgyu bzhi yod pa khyod khas len pa de bzhin du zag med kyi las/ yid kyi rang bzhin gyi lus/ bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i 'chi 'pho dang bzhi ma spong na thams cad mkhyen pa mi thob pas/ theg dman 'phags pa de dag theg chen la ci ste mi 'jug ste/ mthar thug theg pa gcig mdo pad dkar sogs las gsungs pa ltar nges don yin pa des na shes sgrib kyi sred pa dang nga rgyal sogs khyed cag nyan thos pa'i grub mtha' la ma grags kyang nges par theg dman nyan rang dgra bcom thob zin pa de dag la'ang ci ste med de yod ces mthar theg pa gcig tu sgrub byed rang rgyud du bkod do// 'dir rang rgyud kyi rtags ma nges te sa bcu'i rgyun mtha' na tshor ba yod kyang rnam grol tha ma'i tshe sred pa gtan mi skye ba'i phyir ro// mthar thug theg pa gcig gong du bsgrubs zin to// rang lugs ni/ sred 'di nyon mongs can min yang*// kun rmongs bzhin du ci ste med// ces pa'i don ni/ nyon mongs can gyi sred pa 'di ni zhes yar bcad/ nyon mongs can min yang kun rmongs bzhin du (109) ci ste med ces nyon mongs can min pa'i tshig kun rmongs la mar sbyor dgos te/ kun rmongs de shes sgrib yin pas nyon mongs can gyi dpe ma grub snyam na/ kun rmongs nyon mongs can min yang*/ spong byed gnyen po med pas nyan rang dgra bcom la yod pa bzhin/ sred pa spong byed kyi gnyen po chos thams cad bdag med dam bden med rtogs pa'i shes rab med par khas len pas sred pa'i rgyu tshor ba la bden 'dzin nyams pa med par yod na sred pa nyon mongs can ci ste med yod do// mdor na nyon mongs can yin min gyi cha nas 'dra mtshungs dpe bzhag pa min gyi spong byed gnyen po 'dra ba'i cha nas kun rmongs nyon mongs can min yang nyan rang la yod pa dang dngos smra bas khas len pa de bzhin du rigs can gsum char la sred pa nyon mongs can ci ste med de yod do zhes dngos smra ba la thal 'gyur bkod pa yin no// zlog phyogs kyi sgo nas nyan rang sogs kyis chos thams cad bdag med stong nyid med dgag bden stong mngon du rtogs pa sogs gong spyi don skabs ltar shugs kyis bstan te mjug sdud skabs/

des na stong nyid sgom par bya zhes gsungs pa'i phyir ro// des na lugs dang po dang rang lugs gnyis ka'i nyan rang gis (110) chos thams cad bdag med rtogs pa la khyad med cing*/ 'on kyang rang lugs theg gsum rtogs rigs mi mnyam/ lugs bar pa gsum char dang klong chen pa'i lugs cha shas bcas nyan rang gis chos kyi bdag med ma rtogs shing gong smos ltar gtan tshigs rang rgyud do// tha ma rang lugs 'gog byed gtan tshigs snga phyi gnyis thal 'gyur yin zhing lugs bzhi'am lnga char rgyu tshogs grangs tshang gi gtan tshigs tsam gcig go /'dir bsdus pa'i don ni/ dus gang gi tshe rgyud grol ba yin na yang bden 'dzin gyi las yang srid kyi 'bras bu ster ba la nus pa dang ldan par mthong ba yin la/ sred pa dang rgyu tshor ba yod pa yin pa na/ de'i tshe nyon mongs pa sred pa spangs pa la'ang the tshom za bas ji ltar grol bar nges par bya/ de lta bas na stong pa nyid med par ji ltar dge slong nyid legs par gnas par snang bar 'gyur te mi 'gyur ro// gnyis pa lhag med rgyas bshad la/ bden 'dzin dmigs bcas kyi lam sgom kyang phyi rol pa bzhin thar pa mi thob pa bstan pa ni/ sems ni dmigs dang sogs kyi don brjod pa'i phyir/ cha med dam mi rtag pa la bden 'dzin 1$0000300dmigs pa dang ni bcas pa'i sems 1$0000270de yang rgyu lam gyi gnas skabs na 'phags (111) pa'i bden pa bzhi'am de bsgoms pa'i 'bras bu 'gog pa lta bu yul 1$0000300'ga' zhig la ni 1$0000270rtag par mngon par zhen pas 1$0000300gnas par 'gyur 1$0000270la// chos thams cad 1$0000300stong nyid dang ni bral ba'i sems 1$0000270bden 'dzin gyi dmigs pa'i zhags pas bsdams te re zhig 1$0000300'gags pa 1$0000270srid na yang de ni 1$0000300slar yang 1$0000270'khor bar 1$0000300skye 1$0000270bar thal bar 1$0000300'gyur te1$0000270// dper na mu stegs byed 'ga' zhig 1$0000300'du shes med pa'i snyoms 'jug 1$0000270la thar lam dang 'bras bu 'du shes med pa pa la thar par rloms nas sgom pa na 'jug shes drug re zhig 'gag pa slar yang sems dang sems las byung ba rnams skye ba na ngan song du skye ba 1$0000300bzhin 1$0000270no// 'di ni mthar thug theg gcig sgrub byed min te/

gong du sgrub zin pa'i phyir/ dpe dang yang shin tu mi 'grig ste/ 'du shes med pa'i snyoms 'jug gam/ 'du shes med pa pa gnyis gang ltar yang snyoms 'jug las ldang ba na slar yang theg chen lam la mtshams sbyor ba min te snyoms 'jug pa ni nyams pa srid cing ma nyams na'ang 'du shes med pa'i lha gnas su skye nas slar yang lan grangs gzhan la myong ba'i las kyis dmyal bar ltung bar bshad pa'i phyir ro// dper na mu stegs byed 'ga' zhig bdag (112) med mi sgom par 'du shes med pa'i snyoms 'jug thar lam du zhen nas sgom pas 'bras bu 'du shes med pa pa thar pa rloms kyang 'khor bar phyir ldog pas lam log yin pa ltar/ thal 'gyur ltar na chos kyi bdag med ma rtogs na/ gang zag gi bdag med rtogs mi srid pas/ chos bdag cha med gnyis bden med ma rtogs pa'i nyan rang dgra bcom tsam yang mi srid pas bye mdo nas rang rgyud man chad la thal 'gyur bkod pa'o// 'di mthar thug theg pa gcig tu sgrub byed yin na 'gog pa'i (snyoms 'jug dper 'os te )snyoms 'jug las ldang ba na 'khor bar ldog mi srid cing*/ phyir mi 'ong bas da dung dgra bcom thob dgos la/ dgra bcom pa ni lhag med la 'jug dgos shing lhag med las ldang nas theg chen la 'jug pa'i phyir dang rgyal sras chen pos kyang 'phags pa dgra bcom pa rnams la 'du shes med pa'i snyoms 'jug bzhin zhes shin tu ma gus pa mi khom pa'i gnas dang mtshungs pa'i tshig gis smad par mdzad mi 'os pa'i phyir/ des na 'di ni nges don gyi mdo'i dgongs pa ma lon pa'i dngos smra ba'i grub mtha' 'dzin pa la smod tshig go /gsum pa don bsdu ba ni/ 1$0000300des na 1$0000270nyon mongs spangs pa'i (113) dge slong nyid dang sdug bsngal spangs pa'i mya ngan 'das pa nyid thob par 'dod pas chos thams cad 1$0000300stong 1$0000270pa 1$0000300nyid 1$0000270ni 1$0000300bsgom par bya1$0000270'o// de bsgoms pas ni nyon mongs pa spang ba dang mya ngan las 'das pa yang 'thob par 'gyur gyi/

gcig tu bden bzhi mi rtag sogs bsgoms pas ni ma yin no zhes pa'i don no// tshigs bcad gsum 'di ni mkhas pa snga ma 'gas slob dpon gyi min par 'dod/ 'ga' zhig yin par 'dod de gang ltar yang go sla'o// gal te khyod kyi lung sangs rgyas kyis gsung pa'i mtshan nyid can ma yin no zhe na/ 1$0000300ngag gang 1$0000270zhig 1$0000300mdo sde la 'jug 1$0000270pa 1$0000300de// gal te sangs rgyas 1$0000270kyi 1$0000300gsung 1$0000270yin par 1$0000300'dod na1$0000270// rnam pa thams cad du mi mnyam yang 1$0000300theg chen 1$0000270gyi brjod bya 1$0000300phal cher khyed cag gi /mdo dang mtshungs 1$0000270pa 1$0000300'dod 1$0000270pa 1$0000300min nam ci1$0000270// yang stong nyid la sogs pa'i phyogs 'ga' zhig mi mthun pas sangs rgyas kyi gsung ma yin zhe na/ 1$0000300gal te 1$0000270de'i phyogs su 1$0000300ma gtogs 1$0000270pa 1$0000300gcig gis ni1$0000270// theg chen 1$0000300thams cad skyon dang bcas 1$0000270par 1$0000300gyur na1$0000270// khyod kyi 1$0000300mdo 1$0000270yang dag par ldan pa'i lung la sogs pa stong pa nyid chen po dang tshul 1$0000300mtshungs 1$0000270 (114) par ston pa 1$0000300gcig gis 1$0000270theg pa chen po 1$0000300thams cad ni// rgyal bas gsungs pa cis ma yin 1$0000270te yin no// 1$0000300ngag gang 1$0000270zhig 1$0000300'od srung chen po la sogs pas 1$0000270kyang 1$0000300gting dpog 1$0000270par 1$0000300ma gyur pa// de ni khyod kyis ma rtogs pas// gzung 1$0000270bar 1$0000300bya 1$0000270ba 1$0000300min par su zhig gis byed1$0000270// 'di dngul chu thogs med kyis gong theg chen bka' sgrub skabs bshad pa ltar zhi lhas gsungs yin min gang ltar yang 'brel chags shing tshig don la brtags na gsung min pa 'dra'o// gnyis pa myang 'das chen po mngon du byed tshul rjes 'gro'i sgo nas bstan pa ni/

da ni theg pa chen po'i stong pa nyid kyi dbang du byas nas bshad pa/ phyin ci log tu 1$0000300rmongs pas sdug bsngal can 1$0000270'khor ba'i sems can rnams kyi 1$0000300don du// chags 1$0000270pa'i mtha' 1$0000300dang 'jigs 1$0000270shing skrag pa'i 1$0000300mtha' 1$0000270gnyis 1$0000300las grol ba'i1$0000270// snying rje'i gzhan dbang gis 1$0000300'khor bar gnas pa grub 1$0000270par 1$0000300'gyur ba// 'di ni 1$0000270mtha' bzhi spros pa dang bral ba'i 1$0000300stong 1$0000270pa 1$0000300nyid 1$0000270'khor 'das dbyer med bsgoms pa'i 1$0000300'bras bu yin 1$0000270no// 'di ni tshogs sbyor na theg chen gyi lta spyod nyams su len pa'i 'bras bu 'phags lam sa dang po nas bzung sangs

'dir dpyad sgom gzhung bshad ltar byed pa ni khyad par ro// 'phags yul mkhas pa'i legs bshad 'di lta bu ma brten par de yan chad kyi gzhung du 'phags bzhi'i mngon rtogs bstan pa bod kyi mkhas (118) pa sus kyang ma mthong bar zad do// spyi don gnyis pa/ da ni lam sgom pa nyams len gyi rim pa 'chad na spyi gzhung gnyis las/ dang po tshogs lam skabs kyi nyams len bstan na lam gong ma'i nyams len de nyid gong 'phel tsam las gzhan med pas lam sgom pa nyams len du mthong sgom mi slob lam gyi tha snyad med de/ lam gyi lus yongs rdzogs gzhi'i skabs bstan zin pa'i phyir/ des na rje bla ma'i zhal nas so skyes mthong lam ma thob bar gyi lam rim spyod 'jug las rgyas par bstan la/ sa thob nas sangs rgyas kyi sa man chad kyi lam rim cha tshang dbu ma 'jug pa las bstan pas theg pa chen po'i lam rim cha stod cha smad cha tshang ba yin pas dbu ma thal 'gyur pa'i lugs kyi lam rim chen po tshang la ma nor ba'o zhes gsungs pa ni shin tu 'thad do// lam sgom pa de yang mngon rtogs skye rim ltar na gang zag gi bdag med sgom pa sngon du bstan te nyes pa che ba'i phyir dang*/ 'jig rten ltar snang la rags pa'i phyir ro// don gyi gnas lugs la gang zag gi bdag med chos kyi bdag med las rags pas sngar rtogs la/ chos bdag phra mo cha med phyis rtogs pa 'dod pa ni bye mdo'i shan zhugs pa yin pa 'dir mi 'dod do// (119) dbu ma thal 'gyur ltar na bdag phra rags ril po lta bu gong bu dang rdul phran gnyis dang der 'dzin la bdag 'dzin phra rags mi 'dod kyi bden 'dzin dang mtshan 'dzin gnyis snang gsum la phra rags su 'dod do// kun brtags rags pa dang lhan skyes phra ba mi 'thad pa thal/ lhan skyes kyi bdag med sgom pa sngon du bstan pa'i phyir zhe na/ lhan skyes sngon la bstan pa ni/ gtso bo phra rags kyi sgo nas min gyi skye rim yin te rgyu lhan skyes la brten nas de sgrub byed ltar snang bkod nas lhan skyes je rags su btang ba'i phyir ro// kun brtags spang sla ste bag chags mi brtan pa'i snang ba yin pa'i phyir rmi lam bzhin no// gnyis pa la gang zag gi bdag med sgom pa dang*/
