'thob bya sangs rgyas med pas shin tu 1$0000300bden te1$0000270/ yum las/ thob pa yang med ma thob pa yang med ces sogs rgya cher gsungs pa'i phyir/ 1$0000300'on kyang rmongs pas 1$0000270rnam par sgro btags pa las 'thob bo gang zag dang 'thob bya sangs rgyas kyang tha snyad tsam du yod par 1$0000300'dod 1$0000270do// gal te rmongs pa zhes pa ni ma rig pa yin na de ji ltar khas len par byed snyam pa la bshad pa/ rmongs pa ni rnam pa gnyis 'khor ba la 'jug pa'i rgyu bdag tu bden par 'dzin pa dang nyon mongs pa can gyi sems sems byung dang*/ de nye bar zhi ba'i rgyu chos thams cad bden med du rtogs (132) pa dang*/ dge sems sems bskyed lta bu dang yang ma sgrib lung ma bstan ni rkyen gyi dbang gis ci rigs pa 'gyur ba'o// gnyis pa ni/ de las snga ma dang po nyid nas spong yang sems can thams cad 1$0000300kyi sdug bsngal nye bar zhi 1$0000270ba'i 1$0000300don du1$0000270// phyi ma 1$0000300'bras bu 1$0000270sangs rgyas thob pa1$0000300'i rmongs pa 1$0000270las 'bras yid ches kyi lta ba dang*/ snying rje chen po sogs ni re zhig 1$0000300bzlog 1$0000270par 1$0000300mi bya 1$0000270ste// chu 'dod pa'i snod bzhin du don dam pa rtogs par nye bar mkho ba'i phyir ro// 'o na bdag tu rmongs pa bden 'dzin sogs kyang bzlog par mi bya ste/ de'i dngos po bdag gis 'dod pa'i don bsgrub pa'i phyir ro snyam pa la bshad pa/ gsum pa ni/ 1$0000300sdug bsngal 1$0000270gsum gyi 1$0000300rgyu yi 1$0000270nga'o snyam pa bdag bden par 'dzin pa'i 1$0000300nga rgyal ni1$0000270// gzhi med la 1$0000300bdag tu 1$0000270nga rgyal ba'i 1$0000300rmongs pa 1$0000270rab tu 'jug pa1$0000300sa 'phel 1$0000270nas 'khor ba las mi thar 1$0000300bar 'gyur 1$0000270ro// bzhi pa ni/

bdag la chags pa'i ngar 'dzin pa 1$0000300de las kyang 1$0000270me'i tsha ba bzhin 1$0000300bzlog 1$0000270tu 1$0000300med ce na1$0000270// tho yor la mir 'dzin pa ltar glo bur bas 'khrul rtog yin pas bzlog sla ste gnyen po 1$0000300bdag med bsgom pa 1$0000270ni de bzlog pa'i 1$0000300mchog yin 1$0000270te dngos 'gal yin pa'i phyir dper na mun khang du mar me btegs (133) pa bzhin 1$0000300no1$0000270// gnyis pa chos bdag med bsgom pa la spyi gzhung gnyis/ dang po ni/ de yang gang zag gi bdag med bsgom tshul grub mtha'i dbang du byas na bye smras gdags gzhi shes pa skad cig cha med dang gzung ba rdul phran cha med la gang zag sgro btags te dper na rdul rdzas brgyad 'dus la bum pa lta bu gang zag tu btags pa kun rdzob tu 'dod la/ don dam par 'phags pa'i mnyam bzhag na gzung ba dang shes pa rdul phran cha med dang skad cig cha med mngon sum du mthong bas na bdag btags yod tsam yang mi 'dzin par gzhan rig rkyang par 'dod do// mdo sde pas 'phags pa'i mnyam bzhag la gzhal bya lkog na mo'i rnam bzhag mi 'dod pas rang gzhan med par gzigs pas rnal 'byor rtogs pa bsam mi khyab par 'dod kyang don du gzung 'dzin las ma 'das par sngar bshad pa ltar ro// bye mdo gnyis la chos bdag med rtogs pa'i tha snyad gsal kha med kyang*/ chos bdag kyang rags pa gong bu med par 'dod pa tsam mo// sems tsam pas nyan thos kyi bdag med bsgom tshul mdo sde pa ltar dang*/ rang rgyal gzung ba bden pa med par rtogs pa yang sngar bshad pa ltar dang*/ theg chen (134) pas gzung 'dzin gnyis med kyi ye shes mnyam bzhag bsgom tshul gong du bstan pa ltar la phyin ci ma log pa'i yongs grub gnyis med shes pa mi rtag pa dang 'gyur med yongs grub stong nyid bden grub tu rtag par gnas par 'dod kyang yul yul can gzung 'dzin rang mtshan mi 'dod do// rjes thob tu gang zag gi bdag btags yod dang*/

chos bdag ni gzugs can phra rags thams cad dang shes pa rags pa gcig 'dzin btags yod du 'dod la gzung 'dzin tha dad 'dod pa ni grub mtha' 'og ma gsum phal cher 'dra la theg chen phal cher thal 'gyur dang gcig la gong du bshad pa ltar ro// thal 'gyur rang lugs rigs can gsum char gyis chos thams cad bden stong mngon sum du rtogs pa gzhir bzhag nas mnyam bzhag na gzung 'dzin yod med kyi khyad par sngar bshad pa ltar sgom zhing rjes thob tu grub mtha' 'og ma rnams rim gyis drangs pa'i phyir 'og ma dang mthun par gang zag gi bdag med sngar dang*/ chos kyi bdag med rjes su bsgom par gzhung 'dir bshad par mdzad la/ bzhi brgya pa las kyang*/ bsod nams min pa dang po bzlog /bar du bdag ni bzlog bya zhing*// phyis nas lta ba kun bzlog pa// gang gis shes

(135) de mkhas pa yin// gsungs pas/ thog mar skyes bu chung ngu'i lam rim las 'bras yid ches kyi lta ba dang*/ bar du bdag 'dzin rags pa bden 'dzin kun bzlog ste 'khor ba la nges 'byung tshad med skyes na skyes bu 'bring gi lam rim dang*/ mthar chos kyi bdag 'dzin phra mo 'dzin stangs kun spong nas snying rjes kun nas bslang ste byang chub kyi sems rin po che skye bar bstan pas skal dman rim 'jug gi lam rim bstan pa dang*/ sngar rgol yang phyi nang gi grub mtha' mtha' dag dngos su bstan pa yang 'di dang mthun no// de'ang rtsa sher snga rgol gtso bo nang sde kho na snang zhing skal dman rim 'jug gi lam bstan pa'i zhor la phyi rol pa'i log rtog kyang grub mtha' 'og mas bzlog zin pas de dag shugs bstan yin cing skal ldan cig char ba'i lam rim kho na gtso bor bstan no// dbu 'jug las/ sems bskyed lnga pa man gyis rim gyis pa'i lam dang drug pa'i skabs snga rgol phyi nang thams cad bstan pa 'di dang mthun la cig char ba'i lam rim bstan pa rtsa sher dang mtshungs so// gnad kyi don 'di yin te/ mngon mdzod kun btus/ sde bdun mdo dang bcas pa'i skabs nas bstan pa (136) ltar dngos smra bas bem shes don dam par rdzas su grub par 'dod pa rim gyis bkri ba'i lam yin te/ des 'dul ba grub mtha' 'og ma rang rang la grags pa chos bdag la bden 'dzin bcas pa'i lam yin te/ mu stegs mchog la bdag bcas kyi thar pa'i lam bstan pa bzhin no// dbu 'jug las/ kun gzhi yod cing gang zag nyid yod la// phung po 'di dag 'ba' zhig nyid yod ces// bstan pa 'di ni de ltar ches zab don// rig par mi 'gyur gang yin de la 'o// zhes gsungs pa ltar ro// de lta bu drang don la blo sbyang ba'i gang zag gam dbang rnon cig char ba la mdzod kun btus sogs nas dngos po yod pa skad du bstan pa de dag dgongs gzhi sgyu ma lta bu dang*/

dgos pa bden 'dzin can rim gyis drangs pa'i phyir dang*/ dngos la gnod byed dbu ma'i rigs ngor chos thams cad rdul tsam yang mi grub bo// des na rim dang cig char gang gi skabs su yang grub mtha' 'og ma'i lam rim 'dor dgos pa min no// thal 'gyur rang lugs la/ dpyad sgom dang*/ 'jog sgom gnyis/ dpyad pas chos bdag med sgom pa la lus dran skabs dang po lus ma grub de nas lag sogs nas rdul cha med par rim gyis (137) ma grub pa tsam gzhung 'dir bstan pa ni/ sems tsam pa'i rjes su 'brang ste gang zag rim gyis pa drangs pa'i phyir yin la/ rtsa sher dang dbu 'jug ltar las byed po/ yan lag dang*/ yan lag can sogs rten nas brtags pa'i rigs pa phra mos gtan la phab la/ spyi med na bye brag med pa khyab byed ma dmigs pa spyir bdag med na/ bye brag phung po 'gog pa dang*/ rgyu byed po ma grub na 'bras bu las su bya ba bum pa lta bu med pa dang*/ rgyu bud shing med na 'bras bu du ba med pa rgyu ma dmigs pa'i rtags dang*/ las su bya ba bum pa med na rgyu byed po ma grub pa dang*/ me med na bud shing med pa 'bras bu ma dmigs pa dang*/ bdag gcig dang phung po du ma lta bu khyab byed 'gal ba dmigs pa dang*/ lus rang mtshan las tha dad pa'i spyi rdzas grub ma dmigs pa ni snang rung rang bzhin ma dmigs pa'i gtan tshigs sogs rigs pa stobs ldan re res cig char du 'gog pa yin no// yang chos bdag spyi dang gang zag gi bdag bye brag kyang mtha' gcig tu khas len pa dka' ste shing rta bye brag dang*/ yan lag spyi khas len dgos shing lus bye brag dang*/ (138) yan lag spyi bdag phung po'i bye brag phung po bdag gi spyi khas len dgos na ha cang thal lo// des na chos bdag spyi dang gang zag gi bdag bye brag tu bshad pa na spyir chos thams cad chos tsam gcig kyang bdag gi sgra dang 'brel ba'i tshe gang zag gi bdag chos bdag gi bye brag min te gzugs tsam gyi sgra gzugs phung du 'jug kyang*/

skye mched kyi sgra dang 'brel ba'i tshe mig gi yul kho na la gzugs kyi skye mched yin gyi gzugs phung mtha' dag gzugs kyi skye mched min pa dang*/ shing tsam gyi spyi sgra gcig kyang*/ sha pa dang shug pa lta bu chig grogs 'brel ba'i tshe sha shug phan tshun spyi bye brag min pa bzhin no// gong gi bdag phung spyi bye brag don dam rigs pas ma dpyad pa'i ngor snang ba gang zag gi bdag spyi dang phung po bye brag tu 'dzin na spyi bdag med na bye brag phung po ma dmigs pa ni khyab byed ma dmigs pa yin la/ yang na bdag gcig tu 'dzin la/ phung po du mar 'dzin na bdag gcig tu mi grub ste/ phung po du ma dang gcig pa'i phyir/ zhes khyab byed 'gal ba dmigs pa yin te/ rtsa sher las/ gal te phung po bdag yin na// skye dang 'jig pa can du 'gyur// zhes gsungs pa phung (139) po dang bdag gcig yin na bdag rtag pa dang gcig mi grub ste/ mi rtag pa dang du mar thal ba brjod pa bzhin no// pha med na bu med pa dang*/ bu med na pha ma grub pa ni rgyu 'bras ma dmigs pa'i gtan tshigs dang*/ pha ri tshu ri g.yas g.yon ring thung sogs ma grub pa gang du 'du zhe na/ rnam par bzhag 'jog gi rgyu 'bras yin pa de'ang rgyu 'bras ma dmigs pa'i gtan tshigs kyi khongs su 'du'o// 'jig rten dang bstan bcos la grags pa'i dbang gis tho yor dang gang zag ma grub pa'i dpe bzhag pa ni/ grub mtha' 'og ma ltar gang zag gi bdag rags pa med pa sngon du bdag med gzhan sel gyis rtogs zin de dper byas nas chos bdag med da gdod sgrub par bzhed la/ thal 'gyur ltar na chos dang gang zag gi bdag 'dzin la phra rags mi bzhed cing bdag med rtogs tshul la'ang snga phyi med de nyes dmigs che chung gi sgo nas dang po gang zag gi bdag med gtan la phab nas phyis chos kyi bdag med grub mtha' 'og ma ltar gtan la phab pa dpyad sgom gyi go rim yin no// des na spyir chos thams cad spyi dang gang zag bye brag bshad tshe de ltar nges pa yang

(140) yin no// thal 'gyur rang lugs la gang zag gi bdag med dang chos kyi bdag med gtan la 'bebs tshul rtsa sher dang dbu 'jug gnyis las chos dang po gang zag bdag med rjes su bstan nas go rim bzlog ste bshad pas sgom pa dang rtogs tshul snga phyi go rim mi bzhed de/ dbang rnon cig char la dgongs so// gnyis pa gzhung don la dran nyer dang po gsum rgyas par bshad/ chos dran gyi sgo nas don bsdu/ dang po la/ lus tshor sems gsum las dang po la/ spyir lus ma grub pa rgyas par bshad/ bye brag pho mo ma grub pas don bsdu ba'o// dang po la lus ma grub pa dang*/ yan lag ma grub pa gnyis/ dang po la gnyis/ don dam par lus ma grub pa/ tha snyad du snang tshul sgyu ma'i dpe bstan pa'o// dang po la rgyas bshad/ don bsdu gnyis/ dang po la lhan skyes kyi lus ma grub/ kun btags kyis lus ma grub pa gnyis las/ dang po ni/ gal te 'di ltar lhan skyes yan lag can gyi lus bdag tu 'dzin pa'i yul yin no snyam pa la bshad pa/ rkang pa la sogs pa yan lag 'ga' zhig bcad na rim gyis lus zhig par (141) 'gyur te yan lag mtha' dag bcad zin pa'i shul du lus cung zad kyang med pa'i phyir dang*/ lag sogs yan lag yan 'gar ba de la yang dpyad na gang zag gzhan gyi lus su khas blangs pa med pa'i phyir 1$0000300lus ni rkang pa 1$0000270min no des 'og ma kun dang des 'gre de bzhin du 1$0000300byin pa min 1$0000270la// 1$0000300brla dang rked pa'ang lus ma yin 1$0000270zhing*// 1$0000300lto 1$0000270ba 1$0000300dang rgyab kyang lus min te// brang dang dpung pa'ang lus ma yin 1$0000270la// 1$0000300rtsib logs 1$0000270dang 1$0000300lag pa'ang lus min te// mchan khung 1$0000270dang 1$0000300phrag pa'ang lus ma yin// nang khrol rnams kyang 1$0000270lus 1$0000300de min la// mgo dang mgrin pa'ang lus min na// 'di la lus ni gang zhig yin1$0000270// de ltar lhan skyes rang mtshan gyi lus ma grub mod kyi yan lag thams cad la khyab pa'i yan lag can gyi lus spyi rang mtshan las rdzas tha dad pa yod pa yin no snyam pa la bshad pa/

lus dang dbyer med gcig tu 1$0000300'dres 1$0000270te gnas pa'ang 1$0000300min logs su'ang 1$0000270rang dbang can 1$0000300'gar med pa1$0000270sa na/ sems 1$0000300de ni cung zad 1$0000270tsam yang yod pa 1$0000300min 1$0000270pa 1$0000300de'i phyir1$0000270// gsum pa ni/ 1$0000300sems can 1$0000270rnams chos thams cad 1$0000300rang bzhin 1$0000270med pa'i mtshan nyid da lta sems can gyi gnas skabs na yang rang bzhin gyi 1$0000300mya ngan 1$0000270las 1$0000300'das 1$0000270pa rang gi sems nyid mtha' bral chos sku chen po yin no// 'di ni rang sems chos sku spros bral 'jog sgom ngo sprod pa'o// da dung 'og tu yang 'byung ngo*// gnyis pa ni/ de ltar yid rnam par dpyad nas mig la sogs pa'i rnam par shes pa

(157) rnams dpyad pa'i ched du sems tsam ltar 1$0000300shes bya 1$0000270skyes pa 1$0000300las sngar shes 1$0000270pa 1$0000300yod na1$0000270// shes pa 1$0000300de ni 1$0000270yul med pas 1$0000300ci la dmigs nas skye1$0000270// bye smra ltar 1$0000300shes dang shes bya lhan cig 1$0000270tu snga phyi med par dus cig car skye 1$0000300na1$0000270/ shes pa 1$0000300de ni 1$0000270yul dang 'brel ba med pas 1$0000300ci la dmigs nas skye// 'on te 1$0000270mdo sde ltar 1$0000300shes bya'i phyis 1$0000270su shes 1$0000300yod na// de tshe 1$0000270shes bya 'gag zin pas 1$0000300shes pa gang las skye 1$0000270ste// de lta bas na yul la sogs pa'i tshogs pa las kyang shes pa don dam par mi grub bo// dang po 'di ni sems tsam dang mthun te rnam bden pa ltar na yul dang yul can rdzas gcig yin pas dus snga phyi med kyang shes pa snga phyi yod do// dang po kun gzhi'i bag chags kyi stobs kyis mig sogs kyi shes pa 'byung zhing de'i stobs kyis dbang po'i nang na yod pa'i gdugs kyi grib ma ltar yul grub par bshad pas shes pa sngar dang shes bya phyis su bshad rung ba'i phyir dang*/ yang na kun gzhi dang po nas yod pa la brten nas phyis yul gyi bag chags sad pa'i phyir ro// rnam med pa ltar na sngar gyi shes pa'i bag (158) chags la brten nas/ phyis su 'khrul snang 'byung bar bshad pas bag chags bzhag pa po shes pa sngar dang de'i yul snang phyis 'byung bar 'dod pa'i phyir ro// bar pa bye smra dang tha ma mdo sde pa la sbyor ro// yang na gtso cher lhan skyes kyi bden 'dzin 'gog pa yin pas de 'dra'i spros pa ma byas kyang rung ngo*// 'dir nyon yid ni bdag lta yin pas de steng chos nyid ngo mi 'phrod la/ sgo lnga'i shes pa phyi rol du g.yeng ba yin pas der yang ngo sprad mi nus la/

kun gzhi rnam shes ni 'jug pa shin tu phra bas so skye las dang po pas ngos mi zin no// des na 'dir yid kyi shes pa'i steng dang por gtso cher chos sku ngo sprad pa yin te kun rdzob sems bskyed sogs dge ba'i chos thams cad gtso bo yid shes la brten dgos pa'i phyir ro// 'o na 'dir tshogs brgyad kyi tha snyad yod dam zhe na/ 'dir gtso cher sher phyin gyi mdo'i dgongs 'grel yin pas dngos bstan gzhung na tshogs drug gtso bor bstan mod/ yang na/ yid ni dbang rnams la mi gnas// sogs kyis nyon yid dang*/ nang na'ang sems min phyi min zhing*// sogs (159) kyis rtog bcas yid shes dang*/ shes bya las sngar shes yod na// sogs kyis kun gzhi dang sgo lnga'i shes pa rang bzhin gyis ma grub pa bstan pa yang 'thad par mthong ste/ yid dang sems dang rnam shes gsum ni tshogs brgyad kyi ming yin pa'i phyir dang nyon yid dang po dang*/ de nas yid shes/ de nas kun gzhi sogs phra rags kyi sgo nas nyes dmigs che chung ltar rim gyis ngo sprod pa 'thad pa'i phyir ro// gnyis pa chos dran gyi sgo nas don bsdu ba ni/ da ni chos dran pa nye bar bzhag pa bstan pa'i phyir/ 1$0000300de ltar 1$0000270rang gi rgyu las sngar ram dus mtshungs pa'am phyis nas skye ba med pas 'du shes dang 'du byed kyi mtshon pa'i 'dus byas dang 'dus ma byas kyi 1$0000300chos rnams thams cad kyi 1$0000270ngo bo 1$0000300skye 1$0000270zhing 'byung 1$0000300ba 1$0000270dang rang bzhin gyis grub pa cung zad kyang 1$0000300rtogs par 'gyur 1$0000270ba 1$0000300ma yin 1$0000270no// de'ang chos dran pa nyer bzhag spyi yin te gong du lus tshor sems gsum yang chos yin pa'i phyir/ de rgyas par bstan zin pas chos dran dngos kyi tshe gong gi don bsdu nyung tsam las rgyas par ma bstan to// rtsa ba'i gsum pa de la rtsod pa spang ba las 'phros nas mthar 'dzin ma

(160) lus pa spang ba la gnyis/ spyi don dang*/ gzhung don no// dang po ni/ gal te sogs rkang pa dang po gnyis kyis gong gi gzhi bden gnyis mi 'thad pa'i rtsod pa dang*/ de yang sogs rkang pa gnyis kyis lam tshogs gnyis gtan la phab pa dang lam sgom pa nyams len mi 'thad pa'i rtsod pa yin te 'di yan chad kyi gzhi lam thams cad la spyi rtsod do// 'di ni gzhan sems sogs shlau ka gcig rtsod pa dang po la 'dod lan btab bo// rtsod pa gnyis pa'i lan/ rtog dang brtag pa sogs dang po shlau ka gcig gis dri ma bkru ba bzhin las dang po pas dpyad skabs yul yul can rmi lam lta bu tshul gsum tshang ba'i gtan tshigs kyis chos thams cad skye med du gtan la phab par bstan la/ de nas gang tshe sogs tshigs bcad gcig gis dpyad pa thug med du thal ba'i rtsod pa bkod/ de'i lan dpyad bya sogs tshigs bcad gcig gis dpyad pa rdzogs nas yul ma dmigs na yul can gyis 'dzin yul ma rnyed nas rtog pa thams cad rang yul du nam mkha' la sprin deng ba lta bu song nas 'jog sgom skabs spros bral rtogs pa de myang 'das su bstan no// mdor na dpyad pa ma rdzogs par yul can gyis blos (161) dbu ma rtsa 'jug sogs las bshad pa ltar stong nyid gtan la phab dgos kyi dpyad pa rdzogs nas zhi lhag zung du 'jug pa chos nyid blo 'das la mnyam par 'jog dgos te/ dpyad don ni nyams su len dgos pa'i phyir deng sang chos nyid mngon sum rtogs pa 'phags pa yin par rlom pa dang 'jog sgom yin na gsang sngags yin par rlom pa de dag dbu ma'i dpyad sgom rjes dpag tshad ma rnam grangs pa'i don dam tsam las mthar thug gi lta bar zhen nas tshogs sbyor gyi mnyam bzhag med pa gzhan sel dgag rtog kho na khas len pa ni dbu ma'i sgom don snying po bor ba'i dbu ma pa de dag kha bshad chu'i sbu bar song ba de sel ba'i phyir 'dir cung zad zhib tu spros pa'o// des na blos chos nyid rtogs mi srid de gzung 'dzin yin pa'i phyir ro// bsdu don ni/

gnyis pa la dngos dang*/ grub don stong nyid snying rje'i snying po can sgom par gdams pa'o// dang po la gnyis/ rtsod pa spang nas rang lugs 'thad ldan bstan/ de las 'phros nas gzhan lugs dngos smra ba'i log rtog mtha' dag bzlog pa'o// dang po la rtsod lan gnyis/ dang po la gnas lugs stong nyid yin na bden pa gnyis ma grub par thal ba/ don dam blo (162) las 'das pa de'i dngos 'gal gzhan blos rtogs nas myang 'das thob mi srid pas lam sgom pa don med du thal ba gnyis/ dang po ni/ 1$0000300gal te de ltar 1$0000270chos thams cad ma skyes shing ma 'gags par bstan na/ kun rdzob dang ni don dam ste// 'di ni bden pa gnyis su 'dod// ces pa mi 'thad de 1$0000300kun rdzob 1$0000270kyi bden pa 1$0000300med 1$0000270pas 1$0000300de la bden 1$0000270pa 1$0000300gnyis ga la yod 1$0000270de don dam gcig pu nyid yin no zhe na/ gnyis pa ni/ lam nyams su len nas chos nyid don dam bden pa rtogs te myang 'das 'thob pa yang mi 'thad de// 1$0000300de yang kun rdzob 1$0000270ni rnam par rtog pa 1$0000300gzhan gyis 1$0000270yul mthong tshad phyin ci log smig rgyu la chur rtog pa ltar brdzun pa rnam par bzhag 1$0000300na 1$0000270don dam bden pa de nyid lam sgom stobs kyis mngon sum du rtogs pa na blo gzhan gyi yul don dam bden pa gzhan rtogs pas blos yul rtogs tshad phyin ci log tu khas blangs pas don dam pa rang bzhin gyis stong yang blos yul du byas pas kun rdzob tu 'gro ba'i phyir/ chos thams cad rang bzhin med pa'i mtshan nyid don dam pa'i bden pa mi dmigs pa'i sbyor bas rtogs kyang lam sgom pa po 1$0000300sems can 1$0000270rnams 1$0000300mya ngan 1$0000270las 1$0000300ga la 'da' 1$0000270ste de yang blos yul du byas pa'i phyir te/

blos ma (163) 'dzin pa'am mi mthong ba'i chos mi srid pa'i phyir zhe na/ gnyis pa lan la gnyis las/ dang po la gnas lugs don dam la bden gnyis mi srid pa'i 'dod lan theb pa ni/ sgrub pa po dbu ma pas rtsod pa dang po'i lan brjod pa sangs rgyas rang snang la yang kun rdzob yod dgos snyam pa 1$0000300'di ni 1$0000270mya ngan las 'das par gyur pa'i sems can gzhon nu don grub lta bu las 1$0000300gzhan 1$0000270pa 'khor ba'i sems can tha mal pa'i 1$0000300sems 1$0000270kyi 1$0000300rnam 1$0000270par 1$0000300rtog 1$0000270pa 1$0000300ste 1$0000270sangs rgyas la kun rdzob yod snyam pa 1$0000300de ni 1$0000270mya ngan 'das par gyur pa sangs rgyas 1$0000300rang 1$0000270snang 1$0000300gi kun rdzob min 1$0000270te 'di rang nyid rnam par rtog pa thams cad bral ba'i phyir ro// dper na rab rib can nad las grol ba na skra shad dang dung ser 'dzin gyi snang ba log pa dang*/ skyes bu gnyid sad pa na rmi lam gyi snang ba bzlog pa bzhin no// gal te rang la kun rdzob de yod pa ma yin pa de lta na ni gzhan gyi kun rdzob sangs rgyas kyi kun rdzob nyid du ji ltar 'gyur/ des na kun rdzob ji snyed pa'i chos mi mkhyen na sangs rgyas thams cad mkhyen pa ma yin par 'gyur snyam pa la/ dri ma bag chags dang bcas pa spang ste 1$0000300phyis 1$0000270mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas pa (164) na/ gang rkyen las byung ba'i mtshan nyid kyi chos 1$0000300de 1$0000270dag sangs rgyas kyi sar rtog pas 1$0000300nges 1$0000270par byed pa yin 1$0000300na 1$0000270kun rdzob 1$0000300de yod de1$0000270// sangs rgyas pa gang gi tshe rgyu bag chags zad pas 'bras bu 'khrul snang de yang yod pa 1$0000300min na 1$0000270sangs rgyas pa de'i tshe 1$0000300kun rdzob 1$0000270kyi 'khrul snang gtan 1$0000300med pa nyid 1$0000270de nam mkha'i me tog bzhin no// 'khrul snang mi mkhyen pa tsam gyi thams cad mkhyen pa min par mi 'gyur te/

mig dag pa'i gang zag long ba min pa bzhin/ des na gnas 'gyur pa'i ye shes bsam gyis mi khyab pa dang 'khrul snang ldog tshul rgyas par gong du bshad zin to// 'di ltar mya ngan las 'das pa blo'i yul du byas nas gzhan gyi rnam par rtog pa tsam gyis de mya ngan las 'das par mi 'gyur ba kho na ni ma yin te/ 'di rang nyid ni rnam par rtog pa'i spros pa nye bar zhi ba'i phyir ro// dper na shā ri'i bu lta bu la chags pa dang bcas pa'i sems kyis chags bcas su dmigs pas rang nyid kyi nyon mongs pa'i sgrib pa spangs pa'i 'dod chags dang bral ba yang 'dod chags bral ba ma yin par mi 'gyur ro// de ltar bas na rnam par rtog pa thams cad dang bral ba'i phyir gzhan gyi kun rdzob kyis dmigs na yang rang nyid 'dir don dam par mya ngan las 'das (165) pa nyid yin no// de'i phyir chos thams cad rang bzhin gyis rnam par rtog pa dang bral ba'i phyir ma skyes pa dang ma 'gag pa'i rang bzhin yin pa'i phyir/ rang bzhin gyis mya ngan las 'das pa dang gdod nas zhi ba yin no zhes brjod do// des na bden gnyis rnam par bzhag pa kun rdzob yin no zhes zla grags kyis kyang rigs pa drug cu pa'i 'grel par gsung ba ltar kun rdzob gzhan snang tsam yin gyi rang snang don dam par bden pa gcig kyang grub pa min te/ mdo las/ skye ba med pa'i bden pa gcig nyid la// 'di na kha cig bden pa bzhi zhes zer// byang chub snying por gshegs na bden gcig kyang*// grub pa med na bzhi lta ga la yod// ces dang*/ rdo rje gcod pa las/ gang dag nga la gzugs su mthong*// gang dag nga la sgrar shes pa// log pa'i lam du zhugs pa yi// skye bo de dag nga mi mthong*// zhes so// don dam par kun rdzob med pa'i 'dod lan no// gnyis pa la gnyis/ tha snyad du grags pa la brten nas blos don dam gtan la 'bebs rung ba/ dpyad pa rdzogs na dpyad blo'i spros pa rang yal 'gro ba tsam myang 'das thob pa'i tha snyad 'thad pa'o//

(166) dang po ni/ de ltar 'dir gang zhig gang gis 'gog par 'gyur te/ rnam par dpyod pa yang med par 'gyur la/ de lta bas na cang mi smra bar gnas par bya'o zhe na/ 1$0000300rtog 1$0000270pa ste sgro 'dogs pa'i blo dbu ma'i rigs pa 1$0000300dang 1$0000270der 1$0000300brtag par bya ba 1$0000270'khor 'das kyi chos 'di 1$0000300dag 1$0000270yul yul can 1$0000300gnyis po phan tshun 1$0000270gcig la gcig tha snyad tsam du 1$0000300brten pa yin 1$0000270pas// 1$0000300ji ltar 1$0000270'jig rten dang bstan bcos la 1$0000300grags pa'i 1$0000270tha snyad tshad ma 1$0000300la brten nas1$0000270// dgag sgrub kyi 1$0000300rnam par dpyad pa 1$0000270gzhi lam 'bras gsum gyi rnam bzhag 1$0000300thams cad brjod 1$0000270pa yin no// gnyis pa la gnyis/ dpyad pa thug med du thal ba'i rtsod pa dang*/ lan no// dang po ni/ kho na re/ 1$0000300gang 1$0000270gi 1$0000300tshe rnam par dpyad pa1$0000270ra bya ba 1$0000300yi// rnam dpyod kyi 1$0000270rigs pa1$0000300sa ni 1$0000270yul rnams la 1$0000300dpyod 1$0000270de rang bzhin med par nges par 1$0000300byed na// de tshe rnam 1$0000270par 1$0000300dpyod 1$0000270byed kyi blo 1$0000300de yang ni// rnam dpyod 1$0000270ni blo gzhan gyis dpyad dgos pa'i 1$0000300phyir na 1$0000270mthar 1$0000300thug pa med 1$0000270do zhe na/ gnyis pa ni/ 1$0000300dpyad 1$0000270par 1$0000300bya 1$0000270ba 'khor 'das kyi chos thams cad 1$0000300rnam par dpyad 1$0000270de gtan la phab par 1$0000300byas na// rnam dpyod 1$0000270kyi blo 1$0000300la ni 1$0000270rnam par dpyad pa'i gzhi'am 1$0000300rten 1$0000270yul 1$0000300yod 1$0000270 (167) pa 1$0000300min 1$0000270la// 1$0000300rten 1$0000270yul 1$0000300med 1$0000270pa'i 1$0000300phyir 1$0000270na yul can sgro 'dogs byed pa'i blo 1$0000300mi skye ste 1$0000270yul ka ba med na ka 'dzin gyi blo mi skye ba bzhin// blo 1$0000300de yang 1$0000270rang yul du 'gro ba de la 1$0000300mya ngan 1$0000270las 1$0000300'das pa brjod 1$0000270de// don dam par tha snyad thams cad log pa'i phyir ro// thams cad du bya ba med pa'i phyir rang bzhin gyi zhi ba de nyid la mya ngan las 'das par brjod de/

'jug pa las/ gang tshe skye med de nyid yin zhing blo yang skye ba dang bral ba// de tshe de rnams brten las de yi de nyid rtogs pa lta bu ste// zhes dang*/ gang tshe gang zhig med do zhes// brtag bya dngos po mi dmigs pa// de tshe dngos med rten bral ba// blo yi mdun na ji ltar gnas// zhes dang*// gang tshe dngos dang dngos med dag /blo yi mdun na mi gnas pa// de tshe rnam pa gzhan med pa// dmigs pa med pa rab tu zhi// zhes so// rje tsong kha ba'i zhal nas/ snang ba rten 'brel bslu ba med pa dang*// stong pa khas len bral ba'i go ba gnyis// ji srid so sor snang ba de srid du// da dung thub pa'i dgongs pa rtogs pa med// nam zhig res 'jog med par cig char du// nges shes yul gyi

(168) 'dzin stangs kun 'jig na// de tshe lta ba'i dpyad pa rdzogs pa lags// zhes so// de ltar dpyad pa rdzogs nas dbu ma'i lta ba la nges pa rnyed na de nas zhi lhag zung 'jug ces bya ba 'jog sgom gtso che ste/ lta ba spros bral ngo 'phrod zin pa'i phyir ro// des na nyan thos lta ba mtha' gcig tu med dgag 'dzin la/ byang sems dpyad sgom skabs med dgag tsam ste/ 'dzin stangs dngos med dgag pa las ma 'das kyang*/ mtha' gcig tu mi 'dzin te rim gyis 'gog pa'i phyir/ med dgag tsam mo// byang sems 'jog sgom spros bral dngos yin no// des na phar phyin theg pa'i lta ba med dgag tu rlom pa srid na'ang gyi na tsam ste 'dzin stangs dngos la lta bar rlom pa ste/ go yul spros bral yin pa'i phyir/ dper na la la me dpog pa na la la me rang mtshan yod snyam gyi rtog pa gzhan sel 'dzin stangs des me rang mtshan mthong ba min pa bzhin no// de yan chad gzhi lam nyams su len tshul rtsod spang bcas bstan zin to// gnyis pa la mthar 'dzin ma lus pa ldog pa dngos dang*/ chos thams cad skye 'gag med pas don bsdu ba'o// dang po la thams cad la dpyod (169) pa rten 'brel chen mo'i rigs pas dpyad/ rgyu la dpyod pa rdo rje gzegs ma/ ngo bo la dpyod pa gcig du bral/ 'bras bu la dpyod pa yod med skye 'gog dang bzhi las/ dang po la log rtog bzlog pa dang*/ nyes spang dgag pa'o// dang po la dam bca' bstan pa dang*/ gtan tshigs gnyis/ dang po ni/ dngos smra ba 1$0000300gang gi ltar na 1$0000270tshad ma dang rnam par brtag par bya ba'am gzhal bar bya ba 1$0000300'di gnyis bden 1$0000270par 'dod pa// 1$0000300de nyid shin tu 1$0000270bsgrub par 1$0000300dka' bar gnas 1$0000270te// gnyis pa la rten 'brel min pa'i dngos po mi 'thad/ rten 'brel yin na rang bzhin med pa'o// dang po la sems tsam ltar shes pa rdzas grub las don yul snang bar 'dod na bsgrub bya shes pa yod pa'i sgrub byed mi rnyed/

mdo sde ltar shes bya las blo skye bar 'dod na rten 'brel min pa'i rang bzhin sgrub byed mi rnyed pa gnyis las dang po ni/ sems tsam ltar 1$0000300gal te shes 1$0000270pa tshad ma'i 1$0000300dbang las 1$0000270te stobs kyis 1$0000300don 1$0000270gzhal bar bya ba 1$0000300grub 1$0000270pa ltar na// de'i 1$0000300shes 1$0000270pa bden grub 1$0000300yod 1$0000270pa 1$0000300nyid la rten ci 1$0000270zhig 1$0000300yod 1$0000270de rang gis rang rig pa ni med la// tshad ma gzhan tshol na yang thug pa med par 'gyur ba'i phyir ro// (170) gnyis pa ni/ 1$0000300'on te 1$0000270mdo sde pa ltar 1$0000300shes bya 1$0000270dang po grub pa 1$0000300las shes 1$0000270pa 1$0000300grub 1$0000270na// 1$0000300shes bya 1$0000270don 1$0000300yod 1$0000270pa nyid 1$0000300la rten ci 1$0000270zhig 1$0000300yod1$0000270// de rang bzhin ma grub pa bstan zin to// snga rgol 'di'ang dngos po bden grub khas len pa'i phyi nang gi grub mtha' thams cad do// gnyis pa ni/ 1$0000300de ste 1$0000270shes pa'i stobs kyis shes bya dang shes bya'i stobs kyis shes pa 'jog pas 1$0000300phan tshun 1$0000270gyi 1$0000300dbang gi1$0000270sa 1$0000300yod 1$0000270par 'dod na// de'i tshe 1$0000300gnyis ka yang ni med par 'gyur 1$0000270te phan tshun brten pa yin pa'i phyir gcig ma grub pas gnyis ka yang mi grub bo// 'dir rang bzhin mthun pa'i dpe bstan pa ni/ 1$0000300gal te 1$0000270mi 'ga' zhig gis bu skyed pa na phar 'gyur gyi 1$0000300bu med 1$0000270pa'i snga rol du 1$0000300pha 1$0000270yod pa 1$0000300min na1$0000270// ji srid du pha med pa de srid du 1$0000300bu nyid gang las byung ba yin// bu med 1$0000270pa ste ma skyes 1$0000300par ni pha 1$0000270yang 1$0000300med pa de bzhin 1$0000270du shes pa dang shes bya 1$0000300de gnyis 1$0000270ka yang 1$0000300med pa nyid 1$0000270yin no// pha bu gnyis dang po 'di grub pa'am rgyu mtshan brjod ma shes pa ni gcig kyang don la ma grub kyang 'khrul ngor yod tsam gyi don to// gnyis pa dpe don mi mtshungs pa la rtsod lan gnyis las dang po ni/

1$0000300myu gu sa bon (171) las skye 1$0000270bar 'gyur 1$0000300zhing*// sa bon 1$0000270yod pa'ang myu gu yod pa'i rtags 1$0000300de nyid kyis rtogs 1$0000270pa 1$0000300bzhin 1$0000270du// 1$0000300shes bya las skyes 1$0000270pa'i 1$0000300shes pa yis 1$0000270shes par bya ba 1$0000300de yod par ni cis mi rtogs 1$0000270zhe na// gnyis pa lan ni/ 'di dpe dang 'dra ba ma yin no zhes bstan pa'i phyir/ 1$0000300myu gu las gzhan 1$0000270tha dad pa'i gang zag gzhan gyi 1$0000300shes pa yis 1$0000270myu gu shes par byas nas/ 'di na 1$0000300sa bon 1$0000270sngon song 1$0000300yod ces 1$0000270rang gis go bar byed cing gzhan la 1$0000300rtogs 1$0000270par 1$0000300'gyur na// gang 1$0000270gi 1$0000300phyir shes bya de rtogs pa1$0000270ra byed pa'i gang zag gi 1$0000300shes pa yod 1$0000270pa 1$0000300nyid gang las rtogs 1$0000270te rang rig pa med pa'i phyir gzhan gyis kyang shes pa min te thug pa med pa'i phyir ro// de lta bas na bden pa'i dngos po yod par khas len pa'i phyogs la shes pa dang shes bya rang bzhin gyis grub pa dpyad pa nus pa ma yin te/ kun rdzob rmi lam lta bu brtags pa'i phyogs la ni ji ltar grags pa bzhin du tha snyad la brten nas nus pa yin no zhes nges so// rten 'brel chen po'i rigs pas dpyad zin nas/ gnyis pa rgyu la dpyad pa rdo rje gzegs ma'i rigs pa la (172) gnyis/ rgyu med rgyang 'phen pa'i log rtog bzlog pa/ rgyu 'gal rtag smra dbang phyug pa sogs kyi log rtog bzlog pa'o// dang po la rgyu med tha snyad tsam du'ang mi 'thad pa dang*/ rgyu dang 'bras bu tha snyad tsam du chos nyid kyi rigs pas sgrub pa'o// dang po la spyir chos thams cad rgyu med du 'dod pa mi 'thad/

bye brag 'ga' zhig rgyu med du mi 'thad pa'o// dang po ni/ rgyu med par smra ba rnams na re/ 'gro ba sna tshogs ni rgyu med pa nyid yin te/ de skad du'ang*/ padma ge sar la sogs pa// rnam pa sna tshogs su yis byas// rma bya'i mdongs la sogs pa yi// sna tshogs khra mo su yis sprul// zhes 'byung bas so snyam pa la brjod pa/ 1$0000300re zhig 'jig rten 1$0000270gyi skye bo thams cad kyis kyang 1$0000300mngon sum gyis 1$0000270sna tshogs pa'i 1$0000300rgyu rnams thams cad mthong ba yin 1$0000270no// gnyis pa ni/ me tog padma'i sdong bu la sogs pa rnams la rgyu sngon du song ba med do zhe na/ 1$0000300padma'i sdong bu 1$0000270dang lo ma dang 'dab ma dang yal ga dang ze'u 'bru la 1$0000300sogs 1$0000270pa'i 'bras bu 1$0000300dbye 1$0000270ba tha dad pa 1$0000300ni/ rgyu yi dbye ba 1$0000270tha dad pa1$0000300sa bskyed pa yin 1$0000270te// gzhan du rgyu med na nges pa med par thams cad du thams cad (173) 'byung ba thal ba'i phyir ro// gnyis pa la/ rgyu tha dad kyis 'bras bu tha dad skye ba mi 'thad pa/ spyir rgyus 'bras bu skye ba mi 'thad pa gnyis/ dang po ni/ 1$0000300rgyu 1$0000270yi 1$0000300dbye 1$0000270ba 'di dag 1$0000300gang gis byas 1$0000270pa yin 1$0000300zhe na1$0000270// rang rang gi 1$0000300sngar gyi rgyu1$0000270'i khyad par gyi 1$0000300dbye 1$0000270ba 1$0000300nyid las so1$0000270// 'o na thug med du thal zhe na/ de ltar phyi ma phyi ma'i khyad par rnams snga ma snga ma'i khyad par las 'byung zhes lan brjod par bya la/ thug pa med par mi 'dod pa cung zad tsam du yang 'gyur ba ma yin te/ 'khor ba la thog ma med pas sngon gyi mtha' shes par 'gyur ba ma yin zhes khas blangs pa'i phyir ro// gnyis pa ni/

1$0000300ci phyir rgyu yis 'bras 1$0000270bu 1$0000300skyed 1$0000270par 1$0000300nus 1$0000270she na// gcig nas gcig tu brgyud pa'i 1$0000300sngar gyi rgyu yi mthu nyid las 1$0000270so// 'di ni me yi tsha ba dang chu yi gsher ba sogs chos nyid yin pa ltar dngos po'i chos nyid do// gnyis pa rtag pa'i rgyu mi 'thad pa la gsum las/ dbang phyug gi ngo bo ma grub/ snod bcud kyi snang ba de'i 'bras bu ma grub/ rtag dngos kyis 'bras bu 'byin na ha cang thal bar bstan pa'o// dang po la dri ba dang*/ de'i lan mi 'thad pa gnyis (174) las dang po ni/ 'dir dbang phyug rgyur smra ba dag na re/ rgyu de yod du chug kyang de ni dbang phyug gi blo sngon du btang ba de nyid kyis lus can dang*/ gnas la sogs pa thams cad byas pa yin no zhes rtog pas de'i phyir de ltar 1$0000300dbang phyug 1$0000270snod bcud 1$0000300'gro ba'i rgyu yin 1$0000270par sems 1$0000300na/ re zhig dbang phyug 1$0000270nyid 1$0000300gang yin 1$0000270pa 1$0000300smros 1$0000270shig /gnyis pa la/ 'byung bzhi dang*/ nam mkha' dang*/ bdag dang*/ bsam gyis mi khyab pa mi grub pa bzhi las/ dang po la don la byed pa po tsam ('thad )tha dad kyang tha snyad rmongs pa dbang phyug gi mtshan nyid dang 'byung bzhi shin tu 'gal ba gnyis las dang po ni/ gal te de dag na re/ 1$0000300'byung 1$0000270ba 1$0000300rnams 1$0000270yin no 1$0000300zhe na1$0000270/ kho bo cag kyang 'byung ba de rnams la snga ma snga mas phyi ma phyi ma 'bras bu'i tshul gyis 'gro ba'i rgyu nyid du 'dod pas 1$0000300de ltar 1$0000270yin par zad 1$0000300mod1$0000270// don gyi dbye bas stong pa'i 1$0000300ming tsam la yang ci zhig ngal 1$0000270bar byed// gnyis pa ni/ 1$0000300'on kyang sa 1$0000270la 1$0000300sogs 1$0000270pa 'di dag 1$0000300du ma 1$0000270yin pa 1$0000300dang 1$0000270// skye ba dang 'jig pa yin pas 1$0000300mi rtag 1$0000270pa dang blo'i 1$0000300g.yo 1$0000270ba 1$0000300med 1$0000270pa dang brten par bya ba'i rang bzhin gyi 1$0000300lha min zhing*/

'gom 1$0000270par 1$0000300bya 1$0000270ba 1$0000300nyid dang mi (175) gtsang 1$0000270ba dang 'brel ba1$0000300sa de ni dbang phyug nyid ma yin 1$0000270te// khyod 'di ltar gcig pu yin pa dang rtag pa nyid dang g.yo ba sngon du 'gro ba dang lha'i 'gro bas bsdus pa dang gtsang zhing mchod par 'os pa'o zhes 'dod pa de dang 'gal ba'i phyir ro// gnyis pa ni/ gal te sa la sogs pa dbang phyug ma yin na 'o na nam mkha' dbang phyug yin no zhe na/ 1$0000300dbang phyug 1$0000270nam 1$0000300mkha' min 1$0000270te blo yi 1$0000300g.yo 1$0000270ba dang bya ba 1$0000300med 1$0000270pa'i 1$0000300phyir 1$0000270ro// gsum pa ni/ bdag yin no zhe na/ 1$0000300bdag min 1$0000270te 1$0000300sngar nas bkag zin 1$0000270pa'i 1$0000300phyir 1$0000270ri bong gi rwa dang 'dra'o// bzhi pa ni/ gal te dbang phyug de tshul mthong blos bsam gyis mi khyab pa yin no zhes 'dod na 1$0000300bsam 1$0000270bya 1$0000300min pa yi byed 1$0000270pa 1$0000300po yang 1$0000270med la// 1$0000300bsam 1$0000270par bya ba 1$0000300min 1$0000270pa de nyid 1$0000300brjod pas ci zhig bya 1$0000270ste bsam mi shes na brjod pa ga la shes/ gnyis pa la/ dris lan gnyis las/ dang po ni/ rgyu byed pa po bsam yul las 'das te ma shes na 1$0000300des bskyed 1$0000270par 1$0000300'dod 1$0000270pa'i dngos po de1$0000300'ang gang zhig yin1$0000270// gnyis pa la rtag pa'i rgyu 'bras bskyed bya skyed byed 'gal/ mi rtag pa'i 'bras bu rang rgyu'i (176) bskyed tshul lo// dang po ni/ rgyu 'bras dang po ngo shes nas rgyu 'dis 'bras bu 'di bskyed ces brjod dgos kyi rgyu gtan ngo ma shes te bsam pa'i yul min na des 'bras bu 'di'o zhes sus shes/

gzhan yang gal te dbang phyug gis 'bras bu bskyed na rtag pa'am mi rtag pa bskyed/ dang po rtag pa 1$0000300bdag 1$0000270ces bya ba 'byin par 'dod 1$0000300na 1$0000270bdag 1$0000300de 1$0000270rtag par khas blangs pa 1$0000300dang sa 1$0000270dang chu dang me dang rlung dang nam mkha' dang dus dang phyogs la 1$0000300sogs 1$0000270pa yang rtag par khas blangs pa 1$0000300dang*/ dbang phyug 1$0000270rang gi 1$0000300ngo bo'ang rtag 1$0000270par khas blangs pa 1$0000300min nam 1$0000270ci// des na rtag pa yin na bya ba byed mi rung zhing gal te bya ba byed na mi rtag par 'gyur ro// gnyis pa ni/ mi rtag pa bskyed na'ang dbang phyug min te/ mig la sogs pa'i 1$0000300shes pa 1$0000270ni 1$0000300shes bya 1$0000270gzugs sogs la dmigs pa 1$0000300las skye 1$0000270ba 1$0000300dang 1$0000270// 'khor ba 1$0000300thog 1$0000270ma 1$0000300med 1$0000270pa'i dus nas 'ong ba'i sems can rang rang gi 1$0000300bde sdug 1$0000270thams cad ni dge ba dang mi dge ba'i 1$0000300las las yin 1$0000270la// dbang phyug 1$0000300de yis gang zhig bskyed par smros 1$0000270shig /mdor na rtag pa la rgyu mi dgos la/ mi rtag pa ni tha snyad du rang rang gi rgyu las skye (177) bas rgyu dbang phyug ga la yin/ gsum pa ha cang thal ba la 'bras bu kun ye yod du thal ba/ rtag tu 'bras bu bskyed dgos par thal ba/ rkyen la ltos na rang nus gtan med du thal ba/ rkyen gyis bsgyur na gzhan dbang can du thal ba/ 'bras bu 'byung na dbang phyug rgyu min par thal ba bcas lnga'o// dang po ni/ 1$0000300rgyu 1$0000270ste byed pa po 1$0000300la 1$0000270rtag pa yin pas 1$0000300thog ma yod 1$0000270pa 1$0000300min na1$0000270// de'i tshe 1$0000300'bras bu'i thog ma 1$0000270yang 1$0000300ga la yod 1$0000270de// 'bras bu thams cad ye grub yin pas sngar yod kho na las gsar skye gtan mi srid pas da lta 'di skye ma 'ongs pa na 'di 'byung gi tha snyad gtan med du thal lo// des na res 'ga' snod bcud kyi 'gro ba mi srid par 'gyur ro// de ltar yin du zin kyang rtag tu mi byed de ltos nas byed pa yin no zhe na/

gnyis pa ni/ 'bras bu thams cad du 1$0000300rtag tu ci'i phyir byed 1$0000270pa 1$0000300min te1$0000270// dbang phyug 1$0000300de ni 1$0000270lhan cig byed pa'i rgyu 1$0000300gzhan la ltos 1$0000270rigs 1$0000300pa min te 1$0000270rtag pa yin pas skye ba'i rgyu rtag tu tshang pa'i phyir/ rnam 'grel las/ ma tshang med rgyu de la ni// 'bras bu gang gis ldog par gyur// zhes gsungs pa bzhin no//

yod pa'i phyir ro// lnga pa ni/ gal te 'bras bu sgrub par 1$0000300byed na'ang dbang phyug ga la yin 1$0000270te rang gi mtshan nyid rtag pa dang 'gal ba yin pa'i phyir te bya ba byed na mi rtag par 'gyur ba'i phyir ro// gsum pa ngo bo la dpyod pa gcig du bral la phra rags kyi cha med kyi tha snyad 'jug pa'i gzhi gsum ste dngos po gtan med song ba'i cha med dang*/ dngos smra bas de bas chung thabs med pa'i dngos po phra mo la cha med zer ba dang*/ 'khor 'das kyi dngos po brtan g.yo mtha' dag dum bu gcig tu gyur nas dngos po des ma khyab pa'i cha gzhan med pa gtso bo lta bu che ba'i mthar thug pa'o// dang po gnyis sngar gyi rigs pas khegs pa/ rags pa'i gtso bo rigs pa gzhan gyis 'gog pa gnyis las/ dang po ni/ dpyod pa ba 1$0000300gang dag rdul phran rtag 1$0000270par 1$0000300smra ba// de dag kyang ni sngar 1$0000270rdul de'ang phyogs cha'i dbye ba yis sogs kyis 1$0000300bzlog zin 1$0000270to// gnyis pa la 'dod pa brjod pa/ de dgag pa gnyis/ dang po la gnyis las mdor bstan pa ni/ 1$0000300gtso bo rtag pa 1$0000270g.yo ba dang mi g.yo ba'i 1$0000300'gro ba yi 1$0000270yongs su (180) gyur ba'i 1$0000300rgyu yin par ni grangs can 1$0000270pas 1$0000300'dod 1$0000270do// gnyis pa rgyas bshad la gnyis/ gtso bo dang*/ rnam 'gyur ro// dang po ni/ gtso bo zhes bya ba ni 1$0000300snying stobs 1$0000270te bde ba dang 1$0000300rdul 1$0000270te sdug bsngal 1$0000300dang mun pa 1$0000270dang btang snyoms 1$0000300zhes// bya ba'i yon tan mnyam 1$0000270par 1$0000300gnas 1$0000270pa na/ 1$0000300gtso bo zhes bya 1$0000270bar 1$0000300rab 1$0000270tu 1$0000300brjod de 1$0000270rang bzhin gyi gnas skabs yin la// gnyis pa ni/

1$0000300mi mnyam 1$0000270pa ni 1$0000300'gro ba 1$0000270sna tshogs pa yongs su gyur pa 1$0000300yin par brjod 1$0000270do// gang gi tshe skye bu yul la longs spyod pa'i 'dod pa skye ba de'i tshe skyes bu'i 'dod pa rang bzhin gyis yongs su shes nas sgra la sogs pa 'byin pa'i ngo bo yongs su gyur pas nye bar 'gyur ro// de'i tshe rim pa ni 'di yin te/ rang bzhin las ni chen po de las ni// ngar 'dzin de las tshogs ni bcu drug yin// bcu drug po yi nang nas lnga po rnams// de las kyang ni 'byung ba lnga rnams yin// de'i don ni 'di yin te/ rang bzhin las chen po ni gtso bo las chen po yin la/ chen po zhes pa ni glo bur du 'byung ba'o// de las ngar 'dzin pa dang*/ de las tshogs bcu drug ste/ (181) dbang po bcu gcig dang de tsam lnga'o// de la las kyi dbang po lnga ni/ kha dang*/ rkang pa dang*/ lag pa dang*/ 'dom dang*/ rkub ste rim pa ltar smra ba dang*/ 'gro ba dang*/ ster ba dang*/ 'khrig pa dang*/ bshang ba'i las rnams la dbang byed pa yin no// blo'i dbang po lnga ni/ rna ba dang*/ lus dang*/ mig dang*/ lce dang*/ sna'o// thams cad la khyab pa ni yid kyi dbang po'o// de tsam lnga ni/ sgra dang*/ reg bya dang*/ gzugs dang*/ ro dang*/ dri de tsam mo// yang sgra las nam mkha' dang*/ reg las rlung dang*/ gzugs las me dang*/ ro las chu dang*/ dri las sa rnams 'byung ba yin no// dang po rang bzhin ni rgyu nyid yin te 'bras bu ma yin no// chen po dang ngar 'dzin pa dang sgra la sogs pa lnga ni 'bras bu yang yin la rgyu yang yin no// dbang po bcu gcig po rnams dang nam mkha' la sogs pa lnga po rnams 'bras bu nyid yin la rgyu ni ma yin no// skyes bu ni rgyu dang 'bras bu gnyis ka'i rang bzhin spangs pa yin no// yang brjod pa rtsa ba'i rang bzhin rnam 'gyur min la/ chen po sogs bdun rang bzhin rnam 'gyur yin/

(182) bcu drug po ni rnam par 'gyur ba ste// skyes bu rang bzhin ma yin rnam 'gyur min// zhes so/ gtso bo de yang 'bras bu ma lus pa nus pa'i rang bzhin nyid yon tan gsum gyi rang bzhin kho na las 'bras bu sgrub par byed pa yin te/ gzhan du na/ ji ltar de la yod pa ma yin pa 'bras bu sna tshogs pa'i gzugs skyed par byed de/ de skad du yang*/ ma lus nus pa'i tshogs rnams kyi// rang bzhin 'ba' zhig kho na las// 'bras bu'i khyad par 'jug pa ni// dngos po de'i rang bzhin no// gal te rgyu yi bdag nyid la// nus pa'i ngo bor 'bras med na// de nyid bskyed par nus min te// med phyir nam mkha'i me tog bzhin// zhes zer ro// gnyis pa la/ rang bzhin dgag pa/ rnam 'gyur dgag pa gnyis/ dang po la yon tan gsum gyi bdag nyid gtso bo gcig mi grub/ yon tan re re yang ma grub/ des na rnam 'gyur yang don gyis khegs pa dang gsum mo// dang po ni/ de dag thams cad nam mkha' la mngon par bris pa'i ri mo bzhin du snang ba yin zhes dgongs nas grub pa'i mtha' smra bas sun dbyung ba'i phyir bshad pa/ gtso bo 1$0000300gcig la 1$0000270rdul gyi 1$0000300rang bzhin 1$0000270 (183) dang mun pa dang snying stobs kyi rang bzhin 1$0000300gsum nyid ni// rigs 1$0000270pa 1$0000300min 1$0000270pas 1$0000300des na 1$0000270gtso bo 1$0000300de yod 1$0000270pa 1$0000300min 1$0000270no// gnyis pa ni/ 1$0000300de bzhin 1$0000270du 1$0000300yon tan 1$0000270gsum yang 1$0000300yod 1$0000270pa 1$0000300min te// de yang so sor rnam pa gsum 1$0000270gsum du 'gyur te re re la gsum gsum med na gtso bo rang gi mtshan nyid dang 'gal ba'i 1$0000300phyir 1$0000270ro// gsum pa ni/ de ltar 1$0000300yon tan 1$0000270rnams 1$0000300med 1$0000270pa 1$0000300na sgra 1$0000270la 1$0000300sogs 1$0000270pa'i rnam 'gyur gyi dngos po dag 1$0000300kyang*// yod 1$0000270pa 1$0000300nyid 1$0000270du brjod pa ni 1$0000300shin tu rgyang ring 1$0000270bar 1$0000300'gyur 1$0000270te sgra la sogs pa rnam 'gyur nyer gsum re re yang rdul mun snying stobs gsum gsum gyi rang bzhin yin pa'i phyir/

'jim pa med pa'i bum pa mi srid pa bzhin no// gnyis pa la/ bem shes go log gi rgyu 'bras mi srid/ grags pa'i dngos po sngar bstan rigs pas kheg des na don dam par rgyu 'bras mtha' dag mi srid pa dang gsum mo// dang po ni/ gzhan yang khyed ltar rgyu 'bras go log tu thal te 1$0000300sems med 1$0000270pa'i rang bzhin gyi 1$0000300gos la sogs pa la1$0000270// sems kyi bdag nyid 1$0000300bde 1$0000270ba la 1$0000300sogs 1$0000270pa la srog 1$0000300yod pa srid pa'ang min la1$0000270/ (184) /gnyis pa ni/ 1$0000300dngos 1$0000270po sgra la sogs pa 1$0000300rnams 1$0000270bde ba sogs 1$0000300de rgyu'i rang bzhin 1$0000270nam ngo bo nyid yin 1$0000300na1$0000270// dran pa nyer bzhag gi skabs su sgra dang gzugs 1$0000300dngos po 1$0000270dag 1$0000300rnam 1$0000270par 1$0000300dpyad zin 1$0000270pa 1$0000300min nam 1$0000270ste yin no// gsum pa ni/ tha snyad tsam du yang 1$0000300khyod kyi rgyu yang bde 1$0000270ba dang sdug bsngal la 1$0000300sogs 1$0000270pa 1$0000300nyid 1$0000270du 'dod pa de ni ma yin te/ bde ba la sogs pa 1$0000300de las snam 1$0000270bu dang zas la 1$0000300sogs 1$0000270pa'i dngos po 1$0000300'byung ba'ang med 1$0000270la// 1$0000300snam 1$0000270bu dang tsandan la 1$0000300sogs 1$0000270pa 1$0000300las ni bde 1$0000270ba la 1$0000300sogs 1$0000270pa min na/ rgyu snam bu la sogs pa 1$0000300de med 1$0000270pa'i 1$0000300phyir na 1$0000270'bras bu 1$0000300bde 1$0000270ba la 1$0000300sogs 1$0000270pa 1$0000300med 1$0000270de// de dag gi 'bras bu yin pa'i phyir ro// bzhi pa 'bras bu dpyod pa yod med skye 'gog la gnyis/

rgyas bshad dang*/ don bsdu ba'o// dang po la gnyis/ rgyu la 'bras bu yod par 'dod pa dgag pa dang*/ med pa dgag pa'o// dang po la dgag pa dngos dang*/ rtsod spang gnyis/ dang po la gnyis/ rgyu la rtag pa'i 'bras bu yod pa mi 'thad/ gcig tu yod na ha cang thal ba'o// dang po la gsum/ rtag pa'i 'bras bu shes bya'i khong na med/ cis kyang yod na rtag tu snang ba thal (185) ba/ cha gnyis srid na rtag pa'i dam bca' nyams pa'o// dang po ni/ 1$0000300bde 1$0000270ba la 1$0000300sogs 1$0000270pa gtso bo'i klong na 1$0000300rtag pa nyid du yang 1$0000270// dus 1$0000300nam 1$0000270du 1$0000300yang 1$0000270ni 1$0000300dmigs pa yod 1$0000270pa 1$0000300ma yin 1$0000270no// gal te yod na sdug bsngal ba'i gnas skabs su bde ba de myong dgos na'ang de mi srid pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa ni/ kho na re/ 1$0000300bde 1$0000270ba la 1$0000300sogs 1$0000270pa'i 1$0000300gsal ba 1$0000270bye brag phra mo 'ga' zhig sdug bsngal ba'i gnas skabs su rtag tu 1$0000300yod 1$0000270pa 1$0000300nyid 1$0000270du 'dod do zhe 1$0000300na1$0000270// 'o na sdug bsngal ba lta bu gnas skabs thams cad du bde ba de 1$0000300myong ba'i 1$0000270sgo nas 1$0000300ci 1$0000270yi 1$0000300phyir 'dzin 1$0000270pa 1$0000300ma yin 1$0000270te myong dgos pa'i phyir ro// gsum pa la rtag pa yin na cha gnyis med pas khyab/ phra rags gyur na mi rtag nyid du nges/ rnam 'gyur bzhin du rang bzhin mi rtag par thal ba/ des na 'bras bu gsar skyes 'grub pa dang bzhi'o// dang po ni/ kho na re/ sdug bsngal ba'i gnas skabs su bde ba 1$0000300de nyid phra mor gyur 1$0000270pa yin te nyin mo'i skar ma la sogs pa bzhin bde bar mi dmigs so zhe 1$0000300na/1$0000270

khyod 'dod pa'i bde ba 1$0000300de 1$0000270bde ba stobs dang ldan pa'i dus su 1$0000300rags 1$0000270pa 1$0000300dang 1$0000270sdug bsngal stobs ldan gyi dus su (186) 1$0000300phra ba'ang ji ltar yin1$0000270/ rtag pa'i rang bzhin bde ba gcig la phra rags du ma mi srid pa'i phyir ro// gnyis pa ni/ gal te rim gyis rags pa spang nas phyis phra bar 'gyur gyi dus cig car du phra rags lhan cig tu 'byung ba ni ma yin no zhe na ni/ dang po 1$0000300rags pa1$0000270'i ngo bo de 1$0000300dor nas phra bar 'gyur bas1$0000270/ bde sdug sogs gtso bo'i yon tan 1$0000300phra rags de dag mi rtag 1$0000270pa 1$0000300nyid 1$0000270yin no// gsum pa ni/ 1$0000300de bzhin 1$0000270du chen po la sogs pa'i rnam 'gyur nyer gsum gyi 1$0000300dngos po thams cad 1$0000270kyang 1$0000300ni/ mi rtag nyid du cis mi 'dod1$0000270// kho na re/ phra ba dang rags pa'i gnas skabs rnam 'gyur gyi ngos nas tha dad pa yin gyi/ gnas skabs can gyi gzhi bde ba rang bzhin la ni tha dad pa med do zhe na/ gsal ba'i ngo bor gyur pa'i bde ba 1$0000300rags pa de 1$0000270rang bzhin gyi phra ba 1$0000300las gzhan min na1$0000270// rang bzhin gyi 1$0000300bde ba 1$0000270yang 1$0000300gsal ba 1$0000270phra rags su 'gyur ba bzhin du 1$0000300mi rtag 1$0000270pa 1$0000300nyid 1$0000270du 'gyur ro// bzhi pa ni/ kho na re/ 1$0000300gal te 1$0000270rnam pa thams cad du bde ba zhig ste gsal ba gtan 1$0000300med par 1$0000270'gyur ba yin na 1$0000300'ga' yang na1$0000270ི// slar 1$0000300skye 1$0000270ba 1$0000300min 1$0000270te 1$0000300med 1$0000270pa'i 1$0000300phyir 1$0000270nam mkha'i utpal bzhin no 1$0000300zhes 1$0000270

(187) 1$0000300'dod na1$0000270// de'ang mi 'thad de/ 1$0000300gsal ba 1$0000270sngar 1$0000300med par 1$0000270phyis gsar du 1$0000300skye bar ni/ khyod 1$0000270kyis 1$0000300mi 'dod kyang gnas pa nyid 1$0000270de 'bras bu thams cad sngar med gsar du skye ba yin no// gzhan du na sngar lha'i bde ba lta bu'i gnas skabs na yang dmyal ba'i sdug bsngal de yod pa yin na phyi ma dmyal ba'i sdug bsngal bzhin du sngar lha'i gnas skabs na yang de dmigs par thal bar 'gyur ro// ji ltar gsal ba sngar med pa skyes pa de bzhin du phyi nang gi dngos po gzhan yang yin pa de'i tshe 'gal ba cung zad kyang yod pa ma yin no// gnyis pa la ha cang thal ba dngos dang*/ nyes spang gi lan dgag pa gnyis las dang po ni/ 'di la gnod pa gzhan yang yod de/ 1$0000300gal 1$0000270te 1$0000300rgyu 1$0000270gtso bo'i klong 1$0000300la 'bras 1$0000270bu rnam 'gyur mtha' dag 1$0000300gnas 1$0000270par lta 1$0000300na// zan za 1$0000270ba'i tshe 1$0000300mi gtsang 1$0000270ba 1$0000300za bar 'gyur 1$0000270zhing*// 1$0000300ras kyi rin gyis ras bal gyi// sa bon nyos la 1$0000270ras bal de nyid lus la 1$0000300bgo bar gyis 1$0000270shig /rgyu ras bal la 'bras bu ras de yod pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa la nyes spang dang*/ lan gnyis las/ dang po ni/ gal te 1$0000300'jig rten rmongs 1$0000270pa ste mi

(188) shes 1$0000300pas 1$0000270rgyu la 'bras bu gnas pa 1$0000300ma mthong 1$0000270ngo snyam 1$0000300na1$0000270// gnyis pa la rmongs pa mtshungs pa/ ma rmongs pa mtshungs/ 'jig rten pa'i rnam pa brdzun na grub mtha' 'jig cing rang gi 'dod pa grub pa gsum mo// dang po ni/ 1$0000300de 1$0000270kho na 1$0000300nyid shes 1$0000270shing ma rmongs pa drang srong ser skya la sogs pa rnams 1$0000300kyis 1$0000270kyang 'jig rten pa rmongs par 1$0000300bzhag 1$0000270pa 1$0000300de nyid 1$0000270rang la'ang gnas pa nyid de// rgyu la 'bras bu gnas pa mthong ba ma yin no// 'di ltar zan za ba dang ras bal las ras yug 'thag nas lus la bkon pa'i phyir ro// 'gyur la la ltar/ de nyid nyer lnga shes pa'i drang srong la'ang rmongs pa de gnas pa nyid do zhes snang ste don la grangs can pa dag kyang zan za ba dang*/ ras nyid nyo ba la 'jug gi gzhan ni ma yin no zhes pa'i don no// gnyis pa ni/ tha snyad du rgyu dang 'bras bu la rtog pa'i 1$0000300shes 1$0000270pa 1$0000300de 'jig rten 1$0000270tha mal pa rnams 1$0000300la yang ni// yod pa 1$0000270nyid yin 1$0000300pas 1$0000270rgyu la 'bras bu gnas pa de 1$0000300ci ste mthong 1$0000270ba 1$0000300ma yin1$0000270// gsum pa ni/ gal te 1$0000300'jig rten 1$0000270pa'i shes pa rgyu 'bras yod med rtog pa yod kyang 1$0000300tshad ma nyid min 1$0000270pas don dam par rgyu la 'bras bu yod pa ma mthong ngo zhe 1$0000300na1$0000270// 'jig rten pa'i (189) shes pas sgra dang gzugs la sogs pa shes pa tshad mas 1$0000300gsal ba mthong ba'ang 1$0000270khyed ltar na 1$0000300bden 1$0000270pa 1$0000300ma yin 1$0000270pas med pa nyid do// de lta bas na dngos po'i de kho na nyid kyi grangs nyer lnga'i rnam par bzhag pa ma thob pa yin pas 'di kho bo cag gi 'dod de tha snyad pa'i tshad ma thams cad don dam par tshad ma ma yin pa'i phyir ro// thal 'gyur bas tha snyad tshad grub mi 'dod ces pa'ang bab bcol tsam du zad de/

tha snyad tshad grub mi 'dod na tha snyad bden pa'ang mi 'dod dgos pa'i phyir ro// gnyis pa rtsod spong la rtsod lan gnyis/ dang po la rig shes tshad ma min na gzhal bya stong nyid brdzun par thal ba/ 'dod na don dam pa'i sgom byung gtan med du thal ba gnyis/ dang po ni/ de la rgol bas smras pa/ 1$0000300gal te 1$0000270tha snyad pa'i 1$0000300tshad ma 1$0000270yang don dam par 1$0000300tshad 1$0000270ma 1$0000300min na1$0000270// tha snyad tshad ma 1$0000300des gzhal 1$0000270pa thams cad 1$0000300brdzun par mi 'gyur ram 1$0000270ci ste 'gyur ro// gnyis pa ni/ 1$0000300de 1$0000270kho na 1$0000300nyid 1$0000270de don 1$0000300du na 1$0000270chos thams cad rang bzhin med pa'i 1$0000300stong pa nyid// sgom pa 1$0000270yang tha snyad tshad mas nges pa thams cad brdzun pa yin pa 1$0000300de'i phyir mi 'thad 1$0000270par 1$0000300'gyur 1$0000270ro (190) zhe na// gnyis pa lan la gnyis/ gnas lugs don la spang gnyen ye nas ma grub/ tha snyad tsam du spang gnyen rmi lam lta bu'i dpe don gnyis/ dang po ni/ 'di la lan bstan pa 1$0000300brtags pa1$0000270ra bya ba1$0000300'i 1$0000270chos kyi 1$0000300dngos 1$0000270po rang mtshan grub pa zhig 1$0000300la ma reg par 1$0000270ram ma ston (rtog )par dngos po 1$0000300de yi dngos 1$0000270po 1$0000300med 1$0000270pa yan gar ba'ang 1$0000300'dzin 1$0000270pa 1$0000300ma yin 1$0000270te rten 'brel yin pas dngos po la ltos nas dngos med 'dzin dgos pa 1$0000300de 1$0000270yi 1$0000300phyir 1$0000270dngos po cung zad kyang bden par ma grub pas 1$0000300brdzun pa'i dngos 1$0000270po 1$0000300gang yin 1$0000270pa// 1$0000300de yi dngos 1$0000270po 1$0000300med 1$0000270par 'dzin pa de yang 1$0000300gsal bar 1$0000270te nges par 1$0000300brdzun 1$0000270pa yin no// de'ang mtha' bzhi skye ba med pa dang*/

mtha' bzhi spros pa bral ba sogs ma grub snyam du 'dzin pa mtha' dag kyang med dgag gi 'dzin stangs yin pas phyin ci log ste med dgag gi 'dzin pa mtha' dag dang po yod pa la ltos nas de med snyam du 'dzin dgos te ri rwa med par 'dzin pa yang ba glang gi rwa yod pa la ltos dgos la/ nam mkha'i me tog kyang thang las skyes pa'i me tog la ltos nas de 'dra med ces brjod dgos pa'i phyir/ des na tha snyad tsam du dgag bya shes bya (191) la srid pa ba lang gi rwa med dang*/ dgag bya shes bya la mi srid pa ri bong gi rwa med gnyis kyang don brdzun pa 'dra ste ltos pa ba lang gi rwa dngos po de brdzun pas de 'dra med snyam pa yang brdzun pa yin no// des na ri rwa sogs med pa yin snyam pa yang log rtog ste yod pa brdzun pa yin pas de med pa brdzun pa yin te pha ri ma grub na tshu ri ma grub pa bzhin no// gnyis pa ni/ 1$0000300des na 1$0000270dper na gnyid kyis non pa'i 1$0000300rmi lam 1$0000270na 1$0000300bu 1$0000270skyes te 1$0000300shi 1$0000270ba rmis pa 1$0000300la1$0000270// bu 1$0000300de med 1$0000270do 1$0000300snyam pa'i rnam rtog ni1$0000270// thog mar bu 1$0000300de yod 1$0000270par 'dzin pa'i 1$0000300rnam par rtog pa 1$0000270brdzun pa de 1$0000300yi// gegs yin 1$0000270mod kyi bu med par 'dzin pa 1$0000300de yang brdzun pa yin 1$0000270te// rmi lam gyi bu ni ma skyes pa dang ma 'gag pa'i phyir ro// de ltar na chos thams cad kyi skye ba dang 'gag pa rtog pas brtags par blta bar bya'o// de'ang sad pa'i gnas skabs kyi bu skye shi dang rmi lam gyi bu skye shi gnyis/ tha snyad bden pa la ltos na bden brdzun khyad par yod de bag chags brtan mi brtan khyad yod pa'i phyir/ don dam bden pa la ltos na khyad med de bden brdzun gnyis kyang ltos grub yin pas don

(192) dam par bden brdzun gyi spros pa las 'das pa'i phyir ro// bden pa don la ma grub na brdzun pa lta ci smos/ des na nyan rang gi lta ba ni bden pa'i spros bral te bden pa yod med sogs mtha' gang du'ang mi 'dzin te/ bden 'dzin mtha' dag spangs pa'i phyir/ bden med du 'dzin pa yod de theg chen ltar bden brdzun gyi spros bral kun ma rtogs pa'i phyir/ theg pa chen po'i lta ba ni 'dzin pa mtha' dag las grol ba ste rig ngor mtha' gang yang mi grub cing theg chen mnyam bzhag gi ngor ci yang mi gzigs te bsam brjod las 'das pa'i phyir/ des na theg pa mchog dman gyi lta ba'i khyad par bden med rtogs ma rtogs kyi sgo nas byed pa rang rgyud pa'i grub mtha' drang don yin la thal 'gyur ltar nges don gyi dgongs pa bden med 'dzin pa'i spros pa yod med sgo nas khyad med par shin tu 'thad do// gnyis pa rgyu la 'bras bu med par 'dod pa dgag pa la gnyis/ rgyu med kyi 'bras bu kun rdzob tsam du'ang mi grub/ rgyu med rtag pa'i 'bras bu don dam par mi grub pa gnyis/ dang po ni/ 1$0000300de bas 1$0000270na brjod ma thag par 1$0000300de ltar rnam 1$0000270par 1$0000300dpyad pas 1$0000270phyi nang gi dngos (193) po 1$0000300'ga' yang rgyu med 1$0000270pa las skye ba dang skyes bu dang dus la sogs pas sngar gsar du byas pa 1$0000300yod 1$0000270pa 1$0000300ma yin 1$0000270zhing*// gnyis pa la don dam par ma grub pa dang*/ tha snyad snang tsam mi 'gog pa gnyis/ dang po la rgyu so so ba dang 'dus pa las 'byung mi srid pa dang*/ dus gsum du brtags na 'gro 'ong ma grub pa gnyis/ dang po ni/ rgyu 1$0000300so so 1$0000270re re 1$0000300ba'am 1$0000270thams cad 1$0000300'dus pa yi/ rkyen rnams la yang 1$0000270sngar med gsar du skye ba'i ngo bor 1$0000300gnas 1$0000270pa 1$0000300ma yin 1$0000270no// gnyis pa ni/
